title: Sales Development Rep for US Based Marketing Agency
description:
US-Focused Niche Marketing Agency | Outdoor & Fishing Industry

Remote | Part-Time to Full-Time | US Hours Required



About Us

We are a US-based marketing agency that works exclusively in the outdoor sports and fishing industry. This is all we do. We don't work with anyone outside this niche, and our clients trust us because we speak their language and understand their world.



We run a proven marketing system that helps small business owners in the fishing and coastal tourism space get found online and fill their calendars with paying customers. We have 30+ five-star reviews, documented case studies, and a product that genuinely delivers results.



If you love fishing or the outdoors, this role will feel like a natural fit.



The Opportunity



We have a pipeline of warm leads — small business owners in the fishing and outdoor tourism industry who have already opted in to learn about our services and see our pricing. They raised their hand. They watched our video. They know who we are.



We need one reliable, motivated person to follow up with these leads, have genuine conversations, and guide interested prospects toward getting started.



This is not cold calling. This is warm outreach to people who already asked to hear from us.



What You'll Do

- Call, text, and
 warm leads through our CRM system (training provided)

- Follow a proven outreach sequence and conversation guide

- Have friendly, honest conversations with small business owners in the US

- Book appointments or help leads get started directly

- Keep pipeline notes clean and updated in the CRM

- Participate in brief weekly check-ins with the team



What We're Looking For

- Excellent spoken and written English — you will be on the phone with Americans

- Previous outbound sales, SDR, or customer-facing experience preferred

- Self-motivated and reliable — you'll be working independently during US business hours

- Honest and straightforward — our clients are salt-of-the-earth small business owners and they will see through anything that feels like a sales pitch

- A genuine interest in fishing or outdoor sports is a real plus

- Familiarity with Go High Level CRM tools helpful but not required — we will train the right person



What You'll Get

- Hourly base pay (flexible based on experience and fit)

- Performance bonus per closed client — this is where the real earning potential is

- Full training on our product, our industry, and our proven sales process

- Access to a knowledge base and AI tools built specifically for this role

- All calls routed and recorded through our system — you'll always have support

- A small, focused team that treats people well and rewards results



Important

You must be available during US Central or Eastern business hours — mornings and early afternoons preferred. 



To Apply

Send us a voice introduction — 60 to 90 seconds — telling us who you are, why you're a fit, and what sales experience you've had.

title: Job Title: Elite B2B Outbound Sales Closer (Graveyard Shift) – Industrial Packaging & Logistics
description:
# Job Title: Elite B2B Outbound Sales Closer (Pacific Shift) – Industrial Packaging & Logistics



**Compensation:** $10.00 / Hour + Annual Raises 



**Schedule:** Full-Time, 40 hours/week (Fixed Shift: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Standard Time)



**Location:** Remote (The Philippines)



---



### Overview:



We are seeking an elite, high-performance **B2B Outbound Sales Representative** to join our global team. We are a direct manufacturer and converter specializing in industrial packaging, corrugated products, chipboard, and jobsite protection materials.



In this role, you will execute high-volume outbound campaigns using **CloudTalk’s parallel dialer system** to connect with key U.S. industrial decision-makers (Procurement Managers, Operations Directors, and Construction Project Leads), validate buyers, send product samples, and drive deals to close.



We pay a top-of-market rate because we demand absolute excellence, meticulous attention to detail, and a fierce work ethic. Time tracking and activity monitoring will be managed via **Hubstaff**.



---



### Key Responsibilities:



* Execute high-volume daily outbound calling using **CloudTalk** parallel dialing software.

* Navigate complex corporate gatekeepers to reach direct decision-makers.

* Validate prospect needs for our industrial packaging and paper converting lines.

* Coordinate with our shipping department to dispatch product samples.

* Follow up aggressively, present customer pricing, and close sample orders/deals.

* Maintain clean CRM records and log call dispositions with speed and precision.



---



### Required Qualifications & Rigid Tech Setup:



* **Experience:** Minimum 5+ years of dedicated B2B outbound cold calling and closing experience targeting the U.S. market.

* **Dialer Mastery:** Prior hands-on experience with multi-line parallel dialers (CloudTalk experience strongly preferred).

* **Time Tracking:** Comfortable working with **Hubstaff** active time-tracking software enabled during all working hours.

* **Communication:** Near-native English speaking and listening skills with a polished, professional, and confident corporate tone.

* **Infrastructure:** High-speed, reliable fiber internet connection, a functional backup power source/UPS, a high-end **noise-canceling headset**, and a clean, distraction-free home office environment.



---



### Compensation & Growth Structure:



* **Base Pay:** Starting at $10.00/hour.

* **Annual Raises:** $1.00/hour raises per year (scaling up to $20.00/hour).

* **Stability:** A long-term, stable career opportunity with room to grow into senior sales leadership.



---



## Application Instructions (Please Read Carefully):



To be considered for this premium position, please submit your application with the following:



1. A brief summary of your 5+ years of B2B outbound phone sales experience and your familiarity with multi-line dialers like CloudTalk.

2. A link to a **60-second audio or video recording** (using Vocaroo or Loom) introducing yourself and explaining why you excel at high-volume B2B phone sales. *(Applications without an audio/video link will be automatically declined).*

3. **Mandatory Tech Proof:** You must attach real photos/screenshots proving your setup. We require pictures showing your computer/workstation, your internet connection speed test, your backup power supply (UPS or power station), and your professional **noise-canceling headset**.

4. To prove your attention to detail, start your cover letter or top of your message with the exact phrase: **"Ready to hit the dialer."**

- Fluent written English for reporting and cross-team communication

Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience managing SEO across multiple sites or brands at once

- Experience in SaaS or other B2B software companies

- Basic HTML/CSS literacy for diagnosing technical issues without needing a developer for everything

title: Basic Headline Editor
description:
Basic Headline Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Graphic Designer and Print Production Support
description:
Part-Time Graphic Designer & Print Production Support



Remote – Philippines | 10–15 Hours per Week Initially | Long-Term Opportunity



About Us



We are an established commercial print, design, logistics and campaign fulfilment business based in Brisbane, Australia.



We work with a wide range of Australian businesses, including SMEs, corporate and government clients, producing business cards, brochures, booklets, labels, signage, direct mail, marketing collateral and other commercial print products.



We are looking for an experienced Graphic Designer with strong Adobe and print-production skills to become a long-term remote member of our team.



This is NOT a full-time position initially.



We expect approximately 10–15 hours per week to start, with work spread flexibly across the week depending on customer jobs.



There will be opportunities to increase hours as our workload grows and during busy periods. For the right person, the role can gradually expand into additional design, database, marketing and administrative responsibilities.



Working Hours



* Approximately 10–15 hours per week initially

* Part-time and flexible

* Work will generally be required Monday–Friday

* You must have some availability during Brisbane, Australia business hours (AEST)

* Some jobs may require same-day turnaround

* Hours may increase during busy periods

* We are looking for someone comfortable with a part-time arrangement and not someone who requires an immediate full-time 40-hour position



We understand you may work with other clients. However, when you accept an MBE task, we expect clear communication and commitment to the agreed deadline.



Your Main Responsibilities



Graphic Design & Print Production



You will assist with:



* Creating and modifying business cards, flyers, brochures, booklets, labels, posters, banners and signage

* Preparing customer artwork for commercial printing

* Setting up correct document sizes, bleed, trim and safe margins

* Checking artwork resolution, fonts, images and colour setup

* Making customer-requested artwork amendments

* Creating designs from customer briefs

* Preparing print-ready PDF files

* Working with existing Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop files

* Preparing labels and other artwork where **dimensions and positioning must be extremely accurate**

* Variable-data and data-merge projects where required

* Checking supplied customer artwork before production



This position requires accuracy and production discipline, not just creative design ability.



Secondary Responsibilities



As the relationship develops, there may also be opportunities to assist with:



* Online database research and extraction

* Excel/Google Sheets data preparation

* CRM data entry and updating

* Basic marketing support

* Preparing
 campaign assets

* General administrative work

* File and folder organisation

* Other day-to-day business support



Experience in these areas is beneficial but commercial graphic design and print-production capability is our immediate priority



Essential Skills



You should have strong practical experience with:



* Adobe InDesign – essential

* Adobe Illustrator – essential

* Adobe Photoshop – essential

* Commercial print artwork preparation

* Print-ready PDF creation

* Bleed, trim, margins and resolution

* CMYK/RGB and basic colour-management principles

* Microsoft Excel and Word

* Google Workspace

* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail



Experience with variable-data printing, data merge, labels, signage or direct-mail production will be highly regarded.



The Person We're Looking For



Technical ability is important, but reliability is equally important.



We are looking for someone who:



* Pays exceptional attention to detail

* Follows instructions carefully

* Asks questions when a brief is unclear rather than making assumptions

* Communicates proactively

* Meets agreed deadlines

* Is comfortable handling multiple small jobs

* Can estimate how long a task will take before starting

* Understands that production artwork must be technically correct, not simply visually attractive

* Wants to develop a **long-term working relationship** with an Australian business



Typical Turnaround Expectations



As a general guide:



Simple artwork amendments:Same business day where possible, generally within 2–4 working hours.



Standard artwork/design jobs:Approximately 1 business day.



Complex projects: You will review the brief and provide an estimated number of hours and turnaround time before commencing.



We understand workload varies and will agree on realistic deadlines for each job.



 Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical trial



The trial may include:



1. Correcting and preparing supplied customer artwork for commercial printing.

2. Creating or adjusting a label/artwork file to exact dimensions.

3. Completing a small creative design task from a supplied brief.



We are interested in assessing accuracy, Adobe skills, print knowledge, speed, communication and ability to follow instructions



 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with commercial print production, not just digital/social-media design.

3. Your experience with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.

4. Examples of print work you have personally produced.

5. Your current availability and confirmation that 10–15 hours per week initially suits you.

6. Your normal working hours in Philippine time.

7. Your expected hourly rate in AUD

8. Whether you currently work with other clients.

9. Your internet connection and computer specifications.

10. When you could commence.



Please start your application with the words "PRINT READY" so we know you have read the complete job description.



Applications that only provide social-media portfolios without examples of commercial print/design work may not be shortlisted.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are not looking for someone to complete one project and disappear.



Our objective is to find a reliable offshore team member who can learn our business, customers, production standards and workflows.



The position will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential for increased hours and broader responsibilities as the relationship develops and our business grows.

title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-commerce)
description:
Maison Cosmetics is a fast-growing DTC skincare brand focused on premium, ingredient-led products for women 40+. We launched in the DACH market in January and have already converted more than 100,000 customers. We recently opened the US and our next phase is to keep growing steadily in DACH while cracking and scaling the US.



Creative is the engine behind our growth. Paid social is our main acquisition channel and we are scaling across Meta, TikTok, Google and other channels. We produce a high volume of creative every week, supported by an AI-driven production team.



The role



We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist who owns the creative pipeline end to end: from research and angle development, to scripts and briefs, to clear visual direction for our production team, to reading performance data and d
 what gets iterated next.



This is not a copywriting role and not a designer role. You are the person who d
 what we say, to whom, and why it will convert.



What you will do



Develop new direct response angles based on customer research, survey data, reviews and competitor intelligence

Write high-converting scripts.



Brief and give clear visual direction to our AI-driven production team

Build and maintain a testing roadmap: hooks, angles, formats, hierarchy of what to test next

Analyze creative performance and turn learnings into the next round of concepts

Localize and adapt winning concepts across DACH and US markets



Who we are looking for



3+ years of hands-on creative strategy for DTC brands with meaningful paid social spend

Proven track record of concepts that scaled, ideally in beauty, skincare, supplements or health

You think in angles and mechanisms, not in taglines

Strong writing in English, native-level tone for the US market

Comfortable working from data: post-purchase surveys, reviews, ad account performance

Fast, high volume, iterative. You would rather ship ten concepts and learn than polish one for a week

Self-directed. You bring the roadmap, we do not hand you a task list



What we offer



Full ownership of creative strategy for a brand that is already scaling, not a startup looking for product market fit

Long-term, full-time contract with room to grow into creative leadership as we expand internationally

Performance-based bonus on top of your base rate

Direct line to the founders, no layers, decisions made same day

Real budget behind your ideas, so your work gets tested at scale within days



Details



Type: long-term contract, full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: fully remote



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, include the following:



Two or three ads you personally conceptualized that scaled. Tell us the angle behind each one and why you believe it worked.

One angle you would test for us in week one, in three sentences. Look at our brand first: 

Your availability and your rate.



Applications without a specific angle in point 2 will not be reviewed.

Video Editing & Creative Production

Edit and produce video ads (1–5 minutes) for paid advertising campaigns, landing pages, VSLs, podcasts, and other marketing assets.

Create engaging, story-driven content that captures attention and drives purchases.

Combine storytelling, pacing, emotional triggers, and persuasive visuals to maximize retention and conversions.

Work with UGC, voiceovers, b-roll, motion graphics, and on-screen text to build compelling narratives.

Collaborate with creative strategists and copywriters to bring scripts and concepts to life.

Continuously iterate and improve creatives based on performance data and testing results.



Google Veo 3 & AI Video Production

Create, test, and optimize prompts to generate high-quality video ads using Google Veo 3.

Manage the full AI production workflow from concept development to final deliverables.

Blend AI-generated content with UGC and traditional creative assets.

Review, refine, and quality-check all AI-generated outputs to ensure they are polished, on-brand, and launch-ready.

Stay current with Google Veo 3 updates, AI video trends, and emerging best practices.

Maintain organized documentation for prompts, revisions, workflows, and creative assets.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Maison Cosmetics is a fast-growing DTC skincare brand focused on premium, ingredient-led products for women 40+. We launched in the DACH market in January and have already converted more than 100,000 customers. We recently opened the US and our next phase is to keep growing steadily in DACH while cracking and scaling the US.



Creative is the engine behind our growth. Paid social is our main acquisition channel and we are scaling across Meta, TikTok, Google and other channels. We produce a high volume of creative every week, supported by an AI-driven production team.



The role



We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist who owns the creative pipeline end to end: from research and angle development, to scripts and briefs, to clear visual direction for our production team, to reading performance data and d
 what gets iterated next.



This is not a copywriting role and not a designer role. You are the person who d
 what we say, to whom, and why it will convert.

Write high-converting scripts.



Brief and give clear visual direction to our AI-driven production team

Build and maintain a testing roadmap: hooks, angles, formats, hierarchy of what to test next

Analyze creative performance and turn learnings into the next round of concepts

Your availability and your rate.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---

If you want to develop into a marketer and not just stay behind the timeline, this is the place to do it.

title: Government Projects AutoCAD Drafter – Architectural Metal & Glazing
description:
Government Programs & Contract Projects



Snappath is looking for an experienced AutoCAD Architectural Metal & Glazing Drafter to support construction-related projects connected to government programs and contracting opportunities.



Our company works with various government programs and service providers. As part of this work, we need an experienced drafter who can review architectural plans and prepare detailed shop drawings for projects involving glass, glazing systems, storefronts, windows, railings, and architectural metalwork.



You do not need previous government contracting experience. We are primarily looking for someone with strong technical drafting experience who can learn our processes and apply their existing skills to these projects. Previous experience working with government, municipal, or public-sector projects is a plus.



Responsibilities

Develop detailed and accurate shop drawings, elevation plans, section views, and fabrication details using AutoCAD.

Prepare drawings for storefronts, window systems, shower doors and enclosures, architectural metalwork, glass railings, and related systems.

Review architectural blueprints, specifications, scopes of work, and other project documentation.

Ensure drawings accurately reflect project requirements, field measurements, and applicable specifications.

Assist with technical documentation for construction-related government program and contract projects.

Make revisions based on feedback, updated specifications, field information, or project requirements.

Identify discrepancies or missing information within architectural plans before drawings are finalized.

Coordinate with our internal team and relevant project stakeholders throughout the drafting and revision process.

Maintain organized and accurate project files and documentation.

What We're Looking For

Strong professional experience using AutoCAD.

Previous experience creating architectural or construction shop drawings.

Experience with glass, glazing, storefront systems, windows, architectural metal, or glass railings is highly preferred.

Strong ability to read and interpret architectural blueprints and construction documents.

Understanding of elevations, sections, dimensions, fabrication details, and field measurements.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and manage assigned projects.

Strong written communication skills.

title: Graphic Designer / AI Creative Designer – Jigsaw Puzzle Studio
description:
Final Piece Puzzles is a new, design-forward puzzle company based in Colorado, USA. We create modern, visually distinctive jigsaw puzzles with an emphasis on great artwork, color, and design.



We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented designer to help develop original artwork for our growing in-house puzzle studio.



This role combines strong graphic design skills with AI image-generation experience. You’ll take concepts from idea to finished, print-ready puzzle artwork—using AI as part of the creative process, then refining, compositing, retouching, and polishing the artwork in Photoshop or similar tools.



What You’ll Do



Develop original puzzle artwork from concepts and creative direction

Use AI image-generation tools to create and iterate on imagery

Composite, retouch, extend, and refine AI-generated artwork

Adjust color, composition, detail, and contrast to make images work especially well as jigsaw puzzles

Prepare high-resolution, print-ready artwork

Work across a wide variety of styles, themes, and subjects



What We’re Looking For



Strong Photoshop and graphic design skills

Hands-on experience with AI image-generation tools

Excellent eye for composition, color, and detail

Ability to turn rough ideas into polished finished artwork

Comfortable working quickly, experimenting, and taking creative direction

Strong portfolio demonstrating both design ability and AI-assisted creative work



Experience designing for puzzles, games, consumer products, packaging, or print is a plus.



Hours: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Mountain Time

Website: 



Please send a portfolio along with examples of work that incorporated AI into your creative process.



After an initial interview, selected candidates may be invited to participate in a paid working session where we can see your creative process, design skills, and AI workflow in action.

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:


/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc



Notice: Please mention in your application message that you have completed the questionnaire. We will conduct preliminary screening by combining your questionnaire information and resume. Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via
 for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.



Company Information

Company 
/



Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Remote Accounting & QuickBooks Assistant
description:
This is a high-volume, multi-entity bookkeeping role supporting a group of healthcare and optical clinics. The group is made up of several companies with a head office structure, so you will not be keeping one set of books - you will be keeping several, and making sure they stay accurate and separate. Day to day you will enter and categorize transactions in QuickBooks, process invoices with their supporting documentation, review coding for sales tax compliance, and reconcile roughly 40 bank and credit card accounts against their monthly statements, investigating anything that does not match. You will also assist with bi-weekly payroll for the doctors at the clinics and prepare payroll summaries, reconcile insurance payments and claims across locations, and keep the monthly insurance records accurate. At month end you will post intercompany journal entries and reconcile the practice management system against QuickBooks to find and resolve differences between entities. The organization is Canadian, so its books carry GST and QST. Direct experience with Canadian sales tax is welcome but not essential - if you have worked with VAT or a similar system, the concepts transfer. What matters far more is that you can carry this volume across several companies without losing accuracy, and hit recurring payroll and month-end deadlines on your own. This is a fully remote position for a candidate based in the Philippines, working U.S. business hours.



What you’ll do

Enter and categorize transactions in QuickBooks across several company files

Process invoices with their supporting documentation and ensure accurate expense categorization

Review transactions for GST and QST compliance

Reconcile approximately 40 bank and credit card accounts each month against their statements

Investigate and resolve transactions that do not match the statement

Assist with bi-weekly doctor payroll and prepare payroll summaries

Reconcile insurance payments and claims across multiple clinic locations

Maintain accurate monthly insurance records

Track accounts receivable

Post intercompany journal entries at month end

Reconcile the practice management system against QuickBooks and resolve differences between entities



What we’re looking for

Hands-on QuickBooks experience, working across more than one company file

Bookkeeping experience

Bank and credit card reconciliation

Invoice processing and categorization

GST and QST knowledge, or transferable experience with VAT or a similar sales tax system

Payroll support

Intercompany journal entries

Accounts receivable tracking

Insurance reconciliation

Comfort with a high volume of transactions across multiple entities

Able to work independently and meet recurring payroll and month-end deadlines without close supervision



Nice to have

Experience with Wink or another practice management system

Familiarity with Canadian tax regulations (GST and QST)

title: Video Editor - Volume Lane
description:
Client Background

Our client is a Los Angeles–based creator-powered media company and TikTok Shop agency specializing in high-volume, founder-led short-form content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and
.

The team operates within clearly defined content lanes, where each editor owns a specific lane and works efficiently using established templates, brand presets, and references, allowing for speed and consistency without reinventing the wheel for every piece.



Their tech stack includes Descript, Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Notion, and Claude.

They are currently hiring for three roles. Across all positions, they value individuals who are reliable, coachable, and proactive in owning well-defined responsibilities. The roles are intentionally structured to help team members perform at their best, balancing speed, storytelling, and sound judgment where each matters most.





Role Title: Video Editor - Volume Lane 



High-throughput short-form editor who owns one content lane and produces clean, on-brand cuts fast, to a template. 





Primary Goal 

Turn raw footage, talking-head, creator calls, simple scripted pieces, into polished short-form videos at high volume, following established templates, brand presets, and references. Success is measured by consistent daily output at a reliable quality bar, not by creative reinvention. 



Where This Role Sits 

You are assigned one primary content lane (for example: scripted talking-head, reply-to-comment clips, or creator-call highlight clips). A producer hands you organized footage, a template, and a reference; you execute. This is a focused, repeatable role for someone who likes to get into flow and ship. 





Key Responsibilities 

• Edit raw footage into finished short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) using provided templates and brand presets. 

• Apply captions, basic text overlays, clean cuts, and audio cleanup to a consistent standard. 

• Hit a daily output target without dropping below the quality floor. 

• Multiply each approved cut into platform-native variants,  turning one finished piece into several posts across TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn, and
 (aspect ratio, length, caption style). 

• Keep project files, exports, and assets organized and named per our system. 

• Use AI tools (Claude, OpusClip, 
) to speed up culling, rough cuts, and reformatting. 





Required Skills & Tools 

• Core editing: Descript and/or CapCut (required); Adobe Premiere a plus. 

• Captioning workflows and platform-native formatting for TikTok / Reels / Shorts. 

• AI-assisted editing: OpusClip, 
; comfortable working alongside Claude. 

• Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack / Lark, Loom. 





Experience 

1–2+ years editing short-form social content. Hungry, fast-learning editors early in their career are welcome, we would rather build good habits than undo bad ones. 







What We Screen For 

• Speed with consistency: a high volume of clean edits per day, every day, to a template. 

• Lane discipline and coachability: thrives inside a defined system; does not need creative control or to make the content their own. 

• Reliability: predictable daily throughput we can build a pipeline around. 





Not a fit if: you want a creative-director track, heavy input on concept/strategy, or get restless doing the same content type repeatedly. That is a different role, see Story / Hero Editor.





Rate: $800.00 USD

Work Schedule: Full-time:40 hours per week

Preferred: Overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

We are not looking for someone who needs to be told:



"Make a flyer."



We are looking for someone who can receive:



"Here is the campaign. Here is the audience. Here is the offer. Here is the CTA. Here is the timeline."



…and determine what creative assets need to be produced to execute it.



We need someone who thinks in terms of campaigns—not isolated graphics.







 Required Skills

* Canva

* Graphic design

* Social media creative production

* Campaign production

* Content repurposing

* Visual storytelling

* Marketing collateral

* Lead magnet creation

* Document/PDF formatting

* Short-form video editing

* Social media content formatting

* File and asset organization

* Brand consistency

* Project management

* Deadline management

* Quality control



Experience with CRM platforms, social scheduling tools, Google Workspace, project-management software, and AI-assisted creative tools is a plus.







 Who We're Looking For



You should be:



* Creative

* Fast

* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Deadline-driven

* Resourceful

* Coachable

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously

* Able to follow established brand guidelines

* Able to work from campaign briefs and directives

* Able to anticipate what assets will be needed

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Interested in marketing, community building, and revenue—not design alone



You should understand that:



Creative is not decoration. Creative is part of the revenue engine.







 Performance Expectations



This is an **outcome-driven role



Performance will be evaluated based on areas such as:



* Creative deliverables completed

* On-time completion rate

* Campaign readiness

* Turnaround time

* Quality of execution

* Brand consistency

* Community content production

* Revenue-supporting assets produced

* Accuracy

* Revision rate

* Organization of creative assets

* Ability to execute with limited hand-holding



Performance Standard



95%+ of assigned creative deliverables should be completed accurately and by deadline with minimal revisions.



Campaigns should not be delayed because required creative materials were not ready.







 The Person We Need



We need someone who sees a strong idea and immediately starts thinking:



What needs to be created?



What does the audience need to see?



What assets will support the CTA?



What needs to be ready before this goes live?*



How do we turn this into something people will stop, notice, engage with, and act on?



If you are someone who can take direction and transform it into organized, polished, high-converting creative execution, this may be the right role for you.

Take the strategy. Build the assets. Support the campaign. Bring it to market.
