title: EXPERIENCED META ADS MEDIA BUYER — U.S. LOCAL SERVICE LEAD GENERATION
description:
EXPERIENCED META ADS MEDIA BUYER — U.S. LOCAL SERVICE LEAD GENERATION



Yonisa Tints is hiring an experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer to build and manage our
 and Instagram advertising from the ground up.



We are looking for a performance marketer who has personally generated qualified leads, booked appointments and profitable customers for appointment-based local service businesses in the United States.



This is not an entry-level position. We are not looking for a general virtual assistant, social media manager, boosted-post specialist or someone whose experience comes primarily from courses.



ABOUT YONISA TINTS



Yonisa Tints is an established window-tinting business in Massachusetts with:



• A physical shop

• More than 179 five-star reviews

• Carbon, hybrid ceramic and premium Ceramic IR packages

• A CRM and automated follow-up system

• Real shop, installation, vehicle and customer-result content

• Financing options through Afterpay, Affirm and Klarna

• A team that can respond to leads, book appointments and complete jobs



Another company manages our Google Ads. This role is specifically focused on
 and Instagram advertising.



We have not previously run Meta ads for the business. The selected candidate must be capable of building the advertising foundation, tracking and campaign strategy from scratch.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



• Reviewing and properly organizing our Meta advertising assets

• Building a clear launch and testing strategy

• Configuring or overseeing Meta Pixel and Conversions API

• Connecting Meta lead data with GoHighLevel

• Building and launching lead-generation campaigns

• Developing compelling offers without depending entirely on deep discounts

• Testing creative angles, hooks, offers, formats and audiences

• Providing clear creative briefs for videos and images our team should produce

• Building retargeting campaigns when sufficient data is available

• Monitoring and optimizing campaign performance

• Analyzing lead quality—not just cost per lead

• Connecting campaign data with booked appointments, completed jobs and revenue

• Maintaining organized campaign and ad naming conventions

• Providing concise weekly reports explaining what was tested, what happened, what was learned and what should happen next



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE EVALUATED



We will not evaluate performance based only on impressions, clicks, engagement or cheap leads.



The outcomes that matter are:



• Qualified leads

• Cost per qualified lead

• Booked appointments

• Appointment show rate

• Cost per booked appointment

• Completed tint jobs

• Cost per completed customer

• Revenue generated from Meta

• Return on ad spend

• Lead quality

• Performance by offer, creative and service package



Our team is responsible for responding to leads, following up, scheduling appointments, closing sales and completing the service.



The media buyer is responsible for generating and tracking quality opportunities while helping us identify whether performance issues are coming from the advertising, lead quality or sales process.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have hands-on experience with:



• Meta Ads Manager

• U.S. local service lead generation

• Appointment-based campaigns

• Building Meta campaigns from scratch

• Meta Pixel

• Conversions API

• CRM integrations

• Campaign testing and optimization

• Creative performance analysis

• Retargeting

• Lead-quality analysis

• Attribution and reporting

• Connecting ad performance with booked appointments, completed jobs and revenue



Experience with GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.



Experience with window tinting, automotive detailing, PPF, wraps, auto restyling, home services or similar appointment-based businesses is an advantage.



ADVERTISING ASSET OWNERSHIP



All campaigns must be created and managed inside assets owned and administratively controlled by Yonisa Tints.



Yonisa Tints will retain ownership of the:



• Meta Business Portfolio

•
 Page

• Instagram account

• Ad account

• Pixel and datasets

• Audiences

• Creative assets

• Leads

• Campaign history

• Reporting data



The selected candidate will receive the appropriate employee or partner access. Our campaigns may not be run through an ad account owned by the media buyer or their agency.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit the following:



1. A two-to-five-minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through one Meta campaign you personally managed for a U.S. local service business.

2. Verifiable campaign evidence showing:



• Industry and market

• Campaign dates

• Amount spent

• Number of leads

• Cost per lead

• Booked appointments, completed jobs and revenue when tracked



You may hide private client information, but the campaign dates, spend and relevant performance data must remain visible.



3. Explain:



• What you personally handled on the campaign

• Whether you built it from scratch or inherited it

• What was not handled by you

• One decision you made that materially affected performance



4. Briefly explain how you would approach building Meta advertising for Yonisa Tints from scratch.

5. Provide:



• The U.S. local-service industries you have personally managed

• Your approximate lifetime Meta ad spend personally managed

• Your experience with GoHighLevel, Meta Pixel and Conversions API

• Your availability

• Your required compensation

• Your earliest available start date

• Your ability to attend scheduled meetings during U.S. Eastern Time when needed



Do not represent an agency’s total ad spend or results as work you personally managed.



Do not submit a generic cover letter. We are looking for specific, verifiable experience and clear thinking.



Applications without the Loom video and campaign evidence will not be considered.



POSITION STRUCTURE



This position will begin with a paid 60-day trial and may develop into a long-term role.



Strong performance may lead to increased responsibility, performance-based compensation and the opportunity to manage additional advertising accounts.



Performance incentives will not be based solely on cost per lead. Lead quality, booked appointments, completed jobs and profitable revenue are the outcomes that matter.



If you have personally generated measurable results for U.S. local service businesses and can verify your work, we look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Sales Representative — Setter & Closer
description:
About the Role

We partner with e-commerce wellness brands to sell high-ticket coaching programs to their existing product buyers. Our leads are warm — these are people who have already purchased a product and are looking for the next step. You are not cold calling strangers.



We have two sales tracks. You will be placed based on your strengths:

Track A — Setter: Contact warm leads, build rapport, qualify the buyer, and book a discovery call. You are the first voice the customer hears.

Track B — Closer: Run the discovery call, identify the buyer's goals and pain points, present the right coaching offer, and close the sale. You are the last voice before payment goes through.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to warm product buyers on behalf of our brand partners

Follow proven call scripts while adapting naturally to each conversation

Run discovery conversations to identify buyer goals and obstacles

Present coaching offers clearly and confidently

Handle objections with empathy and logic — no pressure tactics

Send SMS checkout links immediately after verbal agreement on the call

Log every call outcome in the CRM accurately and on time

Participate in daily team huddles and weekly performance reviews



What We Are Looking For

1+ year of outbound sales, phone sales, or call center experience

Confident, warm, and natural on the phone — not robotic or scripted

Resilient — you do not take rejection personally

Coachable — you listen to feedback and implement it immediately

Reliable — you log your calls, you show up, you do the work

Experience in health, wellness, or coaching sales is a plus

Fluent English — additional languages (French, Spanish, Italian) are a bonus



What You Get

Base pay + uncapped commission on every close

Full training provided — scripts, objection handling, product knowledge

Clear career path: top setters become closers, top closers become team leads

Remote — work from anywhere

Weekly performance bonuses for top converters



To Apply

title: Credit Repair fullfiment operation lead (white label)
description:
Karia Growth Solutions provides private-label / white-label backend fulfillment for credit repair companies. Our business partners keep their own brand, sales process, and client relationships. Our fulfillment desk supports the documented back-office workflow: secure intake coordination, case tracking, approved dispute-workflow production, quality control, reporting, and partner-ready client updates.



We are not hiring a general virtual assistant. We are hiring an experienced operations leader who can help us run a secure, repeatable, detail-oriented fulfillment desk under the Karia Growth Solutions brand.



This role does not involve promising client outcomes, score increases, deletions, financing approvals, or fixed credit-reporting timelines. We work only within approved company SOPs, documented workflows, and assigned responsibilities.



The opportunity



You will own the daily operations rhythm for a growing private-label fulfillment desk. You will organize queues, protect quality, keep cases moving, prepare clear Slack updates, and help create a system that can support multiple partner companies without confusion or missed steps.



You will report directly to the Founder / Partner Success Lead. You will not communicate directly with Karia’s business partners unless specifically authorized for an internal meeting. All partner-owner communication, scope changes, escalations, pricing, approvals, and relationship management remain with Karia’s Founder / Partner Success Lead.



Core responsibilities



You will manage and improve the internal workflow for partner-specific case queues. This includes checking that every assigned file has the required documents, assigning and tracking work, maintaining accurate statuses, identifying delays, and escalating incomplete or unusual files through the approved process.



You will supervise or coordinate the internal production team responsible for case-workflow production, client onboarding support, reporting, and tracking. You will verify that all work follows Karia’s approved SOPs and templates before it is marked complete.



You will build a dependable communication rhythm in Slack. Every business day, you will post a concise internal operations update that covers completed work, blocked files, missing documents, quality-control items, priorities for the next shift, and any decisions needed from the Founder. You will keep information organized in the correct partner channel and never move consumer information into personal chats,
 accounts, or unapproved tools.



You will prepare partner-ready weekly reports using approved templates. Reports must be clear, accurate, factual, and free of promises about score changes, deletions, approvals, or timing.



You will help document and continuously improve workflows for intake, production, QA, reporting, security, and escalation. You will help onboard additional internal team members after the process is proven.



What you will not do



You will not make legal claims or offer legal advice. You will not promise, imply, or guarantee any credit-reporting outcome. You will not make up dispute reasons, submit unsupported information, or tell anyone that accurate information will be removed.



You will not directly negotiate pricing, approve scope changes, bill partners, or take partner-owner communications outside the approved Karia channel. You will not share passwords, use personal storage for work files, use personal WhatsApp for case data, or download consumer documents to an unapproved device or location.



Required experience



You have at least two years of experience in credit repair operations, credit-report workflow support, financial-services back-office operations, or a highly comparable document-heavy case-management environment. You have experience working with client files, task queues, SOPs, trackers, quality-control checklists, and recurring reporting.



You have used Slack daily in a professional operations environment and can write brief, clear, action-oriented updates. You are comfortable with spreadsheets, Google Workspace, project-management tools, CRM-style pipelines, and documenting work in a consistent format.



You communicate fluently in written English, are highly organized, notice missing information quickly, and can follow strict process rules. You are comfortable raising a blocker instead of guessing.



Previous experience managing remote team members, reviewing work for quality, or building SOPs is strongly preferred.

title: Cold Caller
description:
# Cold Caller Needed for Website Design Service – HVAC Leads



We are looking for a confident and reliable cold caller to contact HVAC businesses in the United States and offer our website design service.



We have a prepared list of approximately 5,500 HVAC businesses that currently do not have a website.



## Our Offer



* We build the business a free website sample before they pay.

* The business owner can review the website and see exactly what they are getting.

* They only pay if they like the sample and want to publish it.

* The price to publish the completed website is $1,000.



## Compensation



* Hourly pay at an agreed-upon rate

* An additional **$10 commission for every website sold** from a lead you contacted

* Commission is paid after the customer completes payment for the website



Please include your desired hourly rate in your application.



## Responsibilities



* Work eight hours per day calling businesses from the provided lead list.

* Complete a daily target of approximately **400 call attempts**.

* Clearly explain our website offer and determine whether the owner or decision-maker is interested.

* Follow the provided script while sounding friendly, confident, and natural.

* Update every lead immediately after the call.

* Select the correct call status, such as:



  * No answer

  * Voi

  * Wrong number

  * Gatekeeper

  * Call back

  * Not interested

  * Interested

  * Appointment scheduled

  * Do not call

* Write a brief summary of what happened during the call in the call-status section.

* Add objections, requested callback times, contact information, and any other important details to the notes column.

* Follow up with leads when instructed.

* Maintain complete and accurate records.



## Definition of an Interested Lead



An interested lead should be the business owner or another qualified decision-maker who:



* Agrees to receive a free website sample

* Agrees to attend a scheduled follow-up

* Provides accurate contact information, including their name and
 address

* Understands that the website costs $1,000 if they approve the sample and choose to publish it



As soon as a qualified decision-maker is interested, you must notify me immediately by *
**. The
 should include the business name, decision-maker’s name, contact information, scheduled follow-up time, and a brief summary of the conversation.



## Schedule



Monday through Friday, from **9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Daylight Time**.



This is approximately **10:00 p.m.–6:00 a.m. Philippine time**, so you must be comfortable consistently working an overnight shift.



## Dialing System and Equipment



The caller must provide their own:



* Dialing system or power dialer capable of supporting the daily call target

* Calling number and calling service

* Computer

* Professional-quality headset

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Quiet working environment



Please mention the dialing system you plan to use when applying.



## Requirements



* Strong and clear spoken English

* Confident, friendly, and professional telephone voice

* Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or sales experience preferred

* Ability to make approximately 400 call attempts per day

* Ability to handle rejection and common sales objections

* Accurate data-entry and note-taking skills

* Dependable attendance and punctuality

* Ability to consistently work the required overnight schedule

* Ability to notify us immediately when an interested lead is identified



We will provide the lead list, offer details, call script, training, and instructions for tracking results.



## Calling Compliance



The caller must:



* Follow all applicable calling and telemarketing rules

* Respect all opt-out and do-not-call requests

* Immediately mark leads who request not to be contacted again

* Avoid repeatedly calling businesses that have declined the offer

* Use honest language and never misrepresent our company, services, price, or offer

* Avoid recording calls unless the recording process complies with the applicable laws of every state being called

* Follow any calling-time restrictions that apply to the businesses being contacted



Failure to follow these requirements may result in immediate termination.



## Paid Trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a brief **paid trial** using a small portion of the lead list.



The trial will be paid at the agreed-upon hourly rate. During the trial, we will evaluate:



* Voice clarity and professionalism

* Ability to follow the script naturally

* Call volume

* Ability to reach decision-makers

* Handling of objections

* Quality of interested leads

* Accuracy of call statuses and notes

* Reliability and communication

* Compliance with opt-out requests and calling requirements



Continued employment will depend on the results of the paid trial.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A 30-second audio or video recording introducing yourself so we can hear your speaking voice.

2. A brief description of your cold-calling, appointment-setting, or sales experience.

3. The dialing systems or power dialers you have previously used.

4. The dialing system you would use for this position.

5. Your internet speed and a description of your computer and headset.

6. Confirmation that you can consistently work from 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. CDT.

7. Confirmation that you can make approximately 400 call attempts per day.

8. Your desired hourly rate.

9. The word **“HVAC”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description.

title: Digital Marketing EXPERT
description:
================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will work side by side as an executive assistant to the CEO of an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency, turning half-formed ideas into clear plans, organized projects, and finished work.



If you already understand how paid ads, funnels,
, and CRM workflows fit together, and you are the kind of person who moves projects forward without being chased, keep reading.



If you are looking for calendar management and inbox cleanup, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients. We move fast. Priorities shift. The work is real and it shifts too.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



The CEO generates more ideas and priorities than any one person can execute. Your job is to catch them, structure them, and drive them to done.



In a typical week, you might:



- Take a rough concept from a voice note or a five-minute call and turn it into a scoped plan with owners, deadlines, and deliverables

- Build out and maintain projects in ClickUp, then keep them honest as things change

- Manage the agency's
 marketing calendar and coordinate the assets that feed it

- Push a funnel or landing page project forward across designers, copywriters, and media buyers

- Follow up with team members and contractors, surface what is stuck, and unblock it

- Research and evaluate a new tool, then write a short recommendation

- Clean up an internal workflow or document a process that only lives in someone's head

- Prep briefs, agendas, and materials so the CEO walks into every meeting ready



The mix changes based on what the business needs most that month. Flexibility is part of the job description.



======================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

======================



FIRST 30 DAYS

You know our tools, our clients, our team, and our project structure. Nothing the CEO hands you gets dropped.



BY 90 DAYS

The CEO stops tracking status manually because you already know it. Projects have owners and dates. Follow-ups happen without reminders.



BY SIX MONTHS

You are catching problems before they surface and proposing solutions rather than waiting for direction. You own entire workstreams end to end.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



REAL DIGITAL MARKETING DEPTH

You need to understand how the pieces connect: paid ads, funnels, landing pages,
 marketing, lead generation, ecommerce, CRM workflows, automation, reporting, creative strategy, and campaign planning. You should be able to sit in a strategy conversation and follow it without a glossary and be able to contribute.



EXCELLENT WRITTEN & SPOKEN COMMUNICATION

You can write a clear update in four sentences. You can explain what is done, what is blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.



GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with people who outrank you. You chase the thing you were told about three weeks ago. You do not go quiet.



COMFORT WITH SOFTWARE

You can open a platform you have never used, figure out what it does, and be productive in it quickly.



STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Project management experience. Team leadership experience. Direct experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, Klaviyo and other
 platforms, funnel and landing page builders, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting dashboards, Canva, Figma, CapCut, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and Shopify is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,500/month to start, increasing to $2,500/month on successful completion of the 90-day probationary period

- 13th month pay after 6 months

- Paid holidays

- Flexible paid time off, approved in advance with the CEO

- Direct, daily access to the CEO of a growing Inc. 5000 agency

- A clear path into broader responsibility and ownership as you prove yourself



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the starting pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============



Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. YOUR RESUME

2. PROOF OF WORK

Portfolio, case studies, project examples, campaign results, or anything that shows what you have actually built or run.

3. A PERSONALIZED VIDEO INTRODUCTION, 2 TO 4 MINUTES



ABOUT THE VIDEO

Do not read from a script. We are not evaluating your polish, we are evaluating how you think and how you communicate. A phone camera or laptop camera in a quiet room is completely fine.



Cover these points:



- Your name and your digital marketing background

- Agency experience, if you have it

- Project management or leadership experience, if you have it

- The types of marketing projects you have personally helped manage or execute

- The tools and platforms you have worked in

- WHY SHOULD WE HIRE YOU?? PITCH YOURSELF.



================================

BEFORE YOU APPLY - PLEASE READ THIS

================================



This role asks for real commitment.



Most weeks are a normal 40 hours. Some are not. When a launch is live, a client deadline is on the line, or something breaks, there will be long days and the occasional weekend. We need someone who steps up in those moments instead of going quiet.



We are telling you this now because we would rather lose you today than in month three.



What you get in return is real. You will work directly with the CEO of a multi-million dollar performance marketing agency and see how the entire business actually runs: client strategy, sales, operations, hiring, and growth. That is an education you cannot buy, and it does not exist in a role where you are managing one channel for one brand.



Your pay moves to $2,500/month at 90 days. After that, your ceiling is set by the impact and value you bring, not by a job title. The people who grow fastest here are the ones who took on more before anyone asked them to.



If this sounds like the role you have been waiting for APPLY TODAY!!

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI-Enabled Development



Please read through this in it's entirety to apply for the job correctly.



About the Role



We’re looking for a highly capable Senior Application Developer to design and deliver business applications using modern development technologies and AI-assisted development tools.



This is not a traditional coding role. We need someone who can understand a business objective, see the big picture, determine what should be built, and architect the right solution. You’ll use tools such as Claude Code and Codex to accelerate development while owning the decisions that determine whether an application is secure, maintainable, practical, and valuable to the business.



What You’ll Do

• Translate business requirements into well-designed software solutions.

• Own application architecture and technical direction from concept through production.

• Use Claude Code and Codex a core part of the development process.

• Review AI-generated implementations and make sound decisions around architecture, complexity, security, and maintainability.

• Design full-stack applications using technologies such as Node.js, Python, .NET, APIs, databases, and modern web frameworks.

• Design and deploy applications using AWS infrastructure and services.

• Manage development workflows using GitHub, including source control, pull requests, releases, and CI/CD.

• Integrate applications with APIs, SaaS platforms, and third-party services.

• Apply appropriate application security practices, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, data protection, and API security.

• Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes, and make practical decisions about refactoring, rebuilding, or improving systems.

• Balance business value, development speed, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.



What You Bring – Areas of Experience

• 3+ years of enterprise software development, software engineering, or application architecture experience.

• Strong full-stack understanding across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

• Experience with Node.js/TypeScript, Python, .NET/C#, or similar modern development technologies.

• Strong working knowledge of GitHub, modern source-control practices, and CI/CD workflows.

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar.

• Solid understanding of application security and secure development practices.

• Ability to understand unfamiliar code and quickly evaluate architecture, quality, risk, and maintainability.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to turn an objective into a practical technical solution.

• Excellent English communication skills—both written and spoken.

• A strong sense of ownership, professionalism, and accountability.



Schedule

Worksite Requirements

• A quiet, secure work room or office



Benefits

• 13th month annual bonus

• Health insurance

• US paid holidays

• PTO



Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Join a high-performing, collaborative team that values our people first.

• Work with modern technologies in dynamic cloud and hybrid environments.

• Access to mentorship, certifications, and professional development support.

• A culture that values character, a servant attitude, and enjoyable work.



How We Work

We believe great technology comes from great people - those who care about doing things the right way, not just the fast way. You’ll have the freedom to take ownership of your work, contribute ideas, and build solutions that last. If you’re driven by serving clients, security, and continuous learning, you’ll feel right at home here.

Application Process

1 – Confirm you have experience in designing and building enterprise-grade applications without AI.

title: Retail Design Support - Fixture Development
description:
Retail Design Support – Fixture Development

Tank Stream Design | Part-time | Remote | 2–3 days per week

About Us

At Tank Stream Design we live to explore out and to help people experience the world. For over 25 years we have successfully designed and created apparel, hats, sunglasses and accessories that support everyone in their travel and adventures in nature.

We are looking for a technically minded Retail Design Support person to join our team on a part-time basis, supporting the development, documentation and production of retail fixtures and merchandising systems.

This role is focused on the detail between design concept and finished product — turning ideas, sketches and existing designs into accurate drawings, specifications and practical documentation that can be confidently manufactured, assembled and rolled out.

You will work remotely as part of our Retail Design and Visual Merchandising team, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, across our suite of brands.

The Role

The Retail Design Support role will be responsible for supporting the technical development and documentation of retail fixtures, displays and merchandising systems.

You will help take concepts and briefs through to production-ready drawings, specifications and visual guides, while also supporting the creation of planograms, assembly instructions and sales tools.

This role would suit an Industrial Designer, Retail Fixture Designer, Product Designer or technically skilled Retail Designer who enjoys understanding how things are made and solving practical design problems.

Key Responsibilities

Fixture Design & Development

• Develop and refine retail fixtures, displays, stands and merchandising systems from concept through to production.

• Translate sketches, concepts, measurements and visual references into accurate CAD drawings and 3D models.

• Develop practical design solutions that consider materials, manufacturing, assembly, packaging and installation.

• Support the development of modular and repeatable retail fixture systems.

• Review existing fixtures and identify opportunities to improve functionality, construction and efficiency.

• Refine designs based on prototypes, samples, supplier feedback and testing.

Technical Documentation

• Produce detailed CAD drawings including plans, elevations, sections, details and component drawings.

• Prepare production-ready drawings and specifications for suppliers and manufacturers.

• Document materials, finishes, hardware, fixings, dimensions and assembly requirements.

• Prepare clear build notes and production instructions.

• Maintain organised drawing files, templates, specifications and revision control.

• Check drawings and documentation for accuracy, completeness and buildability.

Visual Guides & Sales Tools

• Create clear visual assembly and installation guides for suppliers, sales teams and field teams.

• Develop planograms and merchandising layouts that clearly communicate fixture and product configuration.

• Assist with the creation of Visual Merchandising and fixture standards.

• Develop simple diagrams and visual instructions that can be easily understood by non-technical users.

• Support the creation of sales tools and presentation materials for retail fixture solutions.

Production & Supplier Support

• Prepare and issue production-ready documentation to suppliers and manufacturers.

• Work with suppliers to clarify drawings and resolve technical questions.

• Support prototype and sample reviews and incorporate feedback into final documentation.

• Identify potential production or assembly issues and propose practical solutions.

• Help ensure finished fixtures meet design, specification and functional requirements.

Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain organised libraries of fixture drawings, components, hardware and specifications.

• Support the development and maintenance of retail fixture standards and systems.

• Contribute to improving documentation templates, workflows and design processes.

• Help develop scalable systems that make future fixture development, production and rollout more efficient.

About You

We are open to the right person and value technical capability, practical thinking and attention to detail as much as years of experience.

You will ideally have:

• A qualification in Industrial Design, Product Design, Retail Design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline.

title: Software QA Tester – Mobile Apps & Web
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Software QA Tester to join our international team on a full-time remote basis.



You will be responsible for testing iOS and Android applications, websites, and web-based products. Your main goal is to identify bugs, verify product requirements, and ensure that every release is stable, user-friendly, and ready for launch.



Responsibilities



1. Test iOS and Android applications, websites, and web-based products.

2. Review product requirements, UI designs, and user flows before testing.

3. Create and execute test plans, test scenarios, checklists, and test cases.

4. Perform functional, UI, usability, compatibility, regression, and exploratory testing.

5. Test applications across different devices, operating systems, screen sizes, languages, and network conditions.

6. Verify that the developed product matches the requirements, Figma designs, and expected interactions.

7. Identify, reproduce, and report bugs with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, screenshots, videos, device details, and severity levels.

8. Track reported bugs and conduct regression testing after fixes are completed.

9. Test important user flows, including registration, login, subscriptions, in-app purchases, payments, content creation, file uploads, downloads, and account management.

10. Check for crashes, slow loading, broken layouts, incorrect content, data errors, and other stability issues.

11. Conduct final quality checks before submitting applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

12. Verify app icons, screenshots, descriptions, permissions, privacy links, subscription information, and other store-listing details.

13. Test production versions after release and help verify issues reported by users.

14. Work remotely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and developers to resolve issues efficiently.

15. Prepare clear test reports, release checklists, and quality summaries.

16. Attend online meetings and provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and unresolved issues.



Requirements



1. Previous experience in software testing, mobile app testing, website testing, or a related QA role.

2. Good understanding of iOS, Android, and web application testing processes.

3. Ability to independently create test cases, execute tests, and prepare clear test reports.

4. Experience with functional, compatibility, regression, usability, and exploratory testing.

5. Strong ability to identify, reproduce, document, and communicate software issues.

6. Ability to compare the implemented product with requirements and Figma designs.

7. Strong attention to detail, patience, and a responsible working attitude.

8. Familiarity with bug-tracking or project-management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, TAPD, or similar platforms.

9. Ability to provide complete bug reports with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, screen recordings, device information, and expected results.

10. Basic knowledge of App Store and Google Play release processes is preferred.

11. Experience testing subscriptions, in-app purchases, payment flows, and third-party login systems is preferred.

12. Familiarity with tools such as Postman, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Android Studio, or Xcode is an advantage.

13. Experience with API, performance, or automated testing is an advantage.

14. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

15. Good written and spoken English for daily communication with an international team.

16. A reliable internet connection and personal computer are required.

17. Must be available during the working hours agreed with the company.



Preferred Qualifications



1. Experience testing consumer mobile applications from development through final release.

2. Experience testing subscription-based, utility, photo, video, or content-creation applications.

3. Experience assisting with App Store or Google Play review and compliance issues.

4. Basic ability to review API responses, crash reports, application logs, or device logs.

5. Basic knowledge of automated testing tools or scripting is a plus.



Employment Details



* Employment Type: Full-time

* Work Arrangement: Fully remote

* Position Type: Long-term

* Location: Southeast Asia

* Communication Language: English

* Working Hours: Based on the company’s agreed time zone and schedule



Application Requirements



Please provide the following information when applying:



1. Your updated CV or résumé.

2. A short introduction about your QA or software-testing experience.

3. Examples of mobile applications or websites you have tested.

4. The devices you currently own for testing, including phone models and operating-system versions.

5. The testing and project-management tools you have used.

6. Your current location and time zone.

7. Your English proficiency level.

8. Your expected monthly salary.

9. Your earliest available start date.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT - CUSTOMER SERVICE AND SALES SUPPORT

Simply Divine Signs & Wraps, LLC | Bloomington, Illinois, USA | Remote, Philippines





THE BASICS



Schedule: Monday to Friday, 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central). Shifts to 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila time from November to March, when US Central Time falls back.



Hours: 40 hours per week, plus a [30]-minute unpaid break each shift.



Pay: based on experience. 



Type: Independent contractor, direct hire. No agency in between.



Time off: [10] paid days off per year, plus [5] paid sick days. You choose which Philippine holidays you take.



Bonus: 13th month bonus paid every December after your first full year.



Start date: August 2026, following a paid 2-week trial.



Reports to: The owner, directly.





ABOUT US



Simply Divine Signs & Wraps is a sign and vehicle wrap company in Bloomington, Illinois. We make vehicle wraps, fleet graphics, storefront signs, dimensional lettering, wall and window graphics, and exterior signs for businesses, schools, churches, nonprofits, contractors, and restaurants across Central Illinois.



We are a small company. We win work by answering quickly and following up when our competitors do not. That is the job.



This is a long-term role. We are looking for one person to grow with us, not a short project.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



You are often the first person a customer talks to. Your job is to make sure no inquiry goes unanswered, no estimate goes cold, and nothing gets forgotten.



CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION (about half your time)

- Monitor incoming
, website inquiries, and text messages, and reply the same shift

- Answer and return phone calls to US customers

- Gather the details we need to quote a job: vehicle year, make, and model, sign sizes, photos, deadlines, install location, and scope

- Schedule consultations, site visits, vehicle drop-offs, and installations

- Keep customers updated on where their project stands

- Send pricing, design, and production questions to the right person and make sure they get answered



LEAD AND ESTIMATE FOLLOW-UP (about a quarter of your time)

- Enter every new lead into our system with the source, contact details, and next action date

- Follow up on open estimates on a set schedule until we get a yes or a no

- Flag urgent or high-value opportunities to the owner the same day

- Keep notes and project status current so anyone can open a file and know where it stands



SCHEDULING AND ADMINISTRATION (about a quarter of your time)

- Manage the owner's calendar, confirm appointments, and send reminders

- Keep digital files, customer records, and project documents organized

- Prepare draft
s, estimates, and invoices for review

- Organize receipts, purchase records, and vendor paperwork

- Ask for reviews after finished projects and handle follow-up

- Maintain our templates, checklists, and written procedures, and improve them when you find gaps

- Send a short written report at the end of each shift: what you finished, what is still open, what worries you



MARKETING SUPPORT (when your workload allows)

- Schedule approved social media posts and organize project photos

- Keep our business listings accurate

- Research local businesses, associations, and events worth our time





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After 30 days: You handle routine inquiries without asking how. Every lead in the system has a source and a next action date.



After 90 days: No inquiry waits more than one business day for a reply. Every open estimate has a documented follow-up. The owner spends his time on estimating and production instead of chasing messages.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Strong written English. Most of this job happens in writing, and you are writing to business owners, school administrators, and pastors

- Clear spoken English on the phone. You will talk to US customers directly

- Follow-through. You finish what you start, and you circle back on what you are waiting for

- The ability to hold twenty open items in a system instead of in your head

- Comfort learning new software from written instructions

- Working knowledge of
, calendars, spreadsheets, and cloud storage

- A reliable setup: at least 25 Mbps home internet, a backup connection such as mobile data, a backup power source for outages, a working computer with a headset, and a quiet place to take calls

- Discretion with customer and company information. You will sign a confidentiality agreement and use a company password manager

- The willingness to tell us when something is unclear, late, or going wrong. We would much rather hear a problem early than find it later. Nobody here gets in trouble for asking a question or for saying they are stuck





HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED



- Previous work as a VA, admin assistant, customer service rep, or sales coordinator for a US client

- Experience supporting a small business, contractor, print shop, or other service business

- Microsoft 365 and Outlook, Zoom Phone, or any CRM or estimating system

- Experience following up on leads and quotes

- Experience writing or maintaining standard operating procedures



You do not need sign or wrap experience. We will teach you the product.





WHAT WE OFFER



- Steady hours and on-time pay, twice a month, every month

- One point of contact. You work directly with the owner, not through layers

- Written procedures and templates, not guesswork

- Real say in how the office runs, and more responsibility as we grow

- A long-term position with a company that plans to keep you





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 address] with this exact subject line:



Signs VA 2026 - [your full name]



Include all four items below. Applications missing any part will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume.



2. A short note about why this role fits what you are looking for. Please do not send a generic cover letter, and please do not use AI to write it. We can tell, and we are hiring for your judgment, not a chatbot's.



3. Your written answers to these three questions:

   a. A customer
s asking how much it costs to wrap a van. They give you no other information. Write the exact reply you would send.

   b. You have followed up twice on an estimate and heard nothing back. What do you do next?

   c. Describe how you keep track of open tasks across a week.



4. A 60-second voice recording, attached as an audio file or sent as a Loom link, introducing yourself and telling us about one time you fixed a problem for a customer.



Please also include your internet speed test result and confirm you can work the 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila shift, five nights a week, long term.

title: Designer for signs and vehicle wraps
description:
About Simply Divine Signs & Wraps

Simply Divine Signs & Wraps is a growing sign and vehicle-wrap company based in Bloomington, Illinois. We serve businesses, schools, churches, nonprofits, contractors, restaurants, dealerships, and other organizations throughout Central Illinois.

Our work includes commercial vehicle wraps, fleet graphics, storefront signs, dimensional lettering, wall graphics, window graphics, banners, decals, and other custom branding solutions.

We are looking for a talented remote designer who combines strong creative skills with a practical understanding of sign and vehicle-wrap production.

Position Summary

This is not a general social media or logo-design position.

We need a designer who understands how artwork will be printed, cut, laminated, tiled, seamed, and installed in the real world. The successful candidate must be able to develop original concepts, create accurate customer mockups, vectorize low-resolution artwork, and prepare clean, organized, production-ready files.

Vehicle-wrap designs must account for door handles, hinges, windows, wheel wells, bumpers, mirrors, fuel doors, body lines, curves, recessed areas, panel breaks, and other vehicle features. Important text, logos, and visual elements must be positioned for readability and successful installation.

The designer will work remotely from the Philippines during U.S. Central Time business hours.

Work Schedule

The selected designer must be available during our normal U.S. Central Time working hours.

Because of the time difference, this will generally be an overnight schedule in the Philippines:

Approximately 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine Time while the United States observes Central Daylight Time

Approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Philippine Time while the United States observes Central Standard Time

The exact schedule and number of weekly hours will be confirmed before hiring. Candidates must be comfortable adjusting their schedule when U.S. daylight saving time changes.

Primary Responsibilities

Creative Design and Concept Development

Develop original design concepts from customer briefs, brand guidelines, photos, measurements, and project requirements

Create visually strong designs for vehicle wraps, fleet graphics, signs, storefronts, windows, walls, banners, decals, and other printed graphics

Present multiple concepts when requested

Select appropriate colors, fonts, imagery, layouts, and visual hierarchy

Balance creative impact with readability and practical production requirements

Follow established customer branding while improving the overall presentation

Make revisions based on customer, production, and installation feedback

Avoid copying protected designs or using unlicensed graphics, fonts, photographs, or other assets

Adobe Illustrator and Vector Artwork

Use Adobe Illustrator as the primary program for layouts and production files

Recreate low-resolution logos and graphics as clean, accurate vector artwork

Identify or closely match fonts when original files are unavailable

Create clean paths with appropriate anchor points

Remove unnecessary clipping masks, stray points, duplicate objects, and hidden artwork

Prepare cut paths, outlines, masks, and other production elements

Convert fonts to outlines when required for final production

Organize files using clearly named layers and logical groups

Create production files for both printed graphics and plotter-cut vinyl

Adobe Photoshop and Image Preparation

Use Adobe Photoshop for photo editing, retouching, masking, compositing, color correction, and image preparation

Remove or replace backgrounds when required

Improve customer-supplied images when possible without creating misleading results

Confirm that raster images have adequate effective resolution at final output size

Build Photoshop files efficiently so they remain usable and editable

Prepare images in the appropriate color space and format for large-format printing

Link or package high-resolution images correctly for production

Vehicle Wrap Design

Design commercial vehicle wraps, partial wraps, spot graphics, fleet graphics, color-change accents, and related vehicle graphics

Work from accurate vehicle templates, customer photographs, and real-world measurements

Build artwork at the correct scale and clearly identify that scale

Confirm vehicle year, make, model, body style, wheelbase, roof height, and other relevant specifications

Account for differences between vehicle templates and the actual vehicle

Position logos, phone numbers, web addresses, services, and calls to action for maximum visibility and readability

Keep critical text and graphics away from:

Door handles

Hinges

Door gaps

Fuel doors

Wheel wells

Windows

Mirrors

Bumpers

Moldings

Lights

Sensors

License plates

Deep recesses

Sharp curves

Difficult installation areas

Consider how graphics will distort, wrap, or disappear around vehicle curves and body features

Maintain visual continuity across doors, panels, and body lines

Avoid placing important information where it will be divided by panel gaps or become unreadable when a door is opened

Plan practical panel divisions and seam locations based on available material width and installation requirements

Include sufficient bleed and overlap for production and installation

Understand when artwork must be extended, repositioned, or simplified to install correctly

Prepare files that allow the production team to make final tiling adjustments when necessary

Create accurate and professional customer mockups without misrepresenting the finished result

Print-and-Cut and Plotter-Cut Vinyl

Prepare files for printed graphics with contour cutting

Create clean, closed contour-cut paths

Apply the company’s required spot-color names and cut-path settings

Confirm cut paths do not contain unintended fills, strokes, gaps, or overlaps

Prepare kiss-cut, die-cut, weed-border, and plotter-cut artwork when requested

Account for necessary bleed outside contour-cut paths

Build files for layered or multiple-color cut vinyl

Simplify artwork when small details will not cut, weed, mask, or install successfully

Confirm minimum letter sizes and line thicknesses are appropriate for the selected production method

Separate print, cut, and reference layers clearly

Signage Design and Production

Design artwork for flat signs, dimensional lettering, storefront graphics, window graphics, wall graphics, banners, decals, panels, and other signage

Work from provided site photographs, measurements, elevations, and customer requirements

Create scaled layouts with dimensions when required

Account for trim areas, margins, mounting locations, panel breaks, frames, hardware, and visible obstructions

Prepare tiled files for oversized graphics and panels

Include appropriate bleed, overlap, crop information, and installation references

Ensure sign designs remain readable at the expected viewing distance

Prepare customer proofs that accurately show placement, scale, colors, and overall appearance

File Preparation and Quality Control

Deliver clean, organized, print-ready files

Use the correct document scale, dimensions, bleed, and color mode

Verify effective image resolution at the final printed size

Outline or package fonts according to company requirements

Embed or properly link required artwork

Remove unused artwork, hidden objects, stray points, and unnecessary layers

Check transparency, gradients, clipping masks, effects, and overprint settings

Confirm that cut paths and production notes will not print a

Proofread all names, phone numbers, websites, addresses, services, and other customer information

Compare final production files against the approved customer proof

Use consistent file names, folder structures, and revision numbers

Package source files, linked images, fonts when permitted, proofs, and final production files

Maintain editable master files for future revisions and fleet additions

Complete an internal preflight checklist before submitting files for production

Communication and Project Coordination

Communicate with the owner, production team, installers, and administrative staff during U.S. Central Time

Ask questions when project information, measurements, artwork, or vehicle specifications are incomplete

Provide realistic time estimates for assigned work

Inform the team immediately if a deadline may be missed

Respond professionally to design feedback and revision requests

Track assigned projects and keep their status current

Clearly identify anything the production or installation team must verify before printing

Participate in video meetings, screen-sharing sessions, and design reviews when requested

Maintain confidentiality regarding customers, projects, pricing, files, and company information

Required Qualifications

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop

Demonstrated experience creating vector artwork from low-resolution files

Strong typography, composition, color, and visual-hierarchy skills

Experience developing original design concepts from customer requirements

Ability to create professional and accurate presentation mockups

Experience preparing large-format, print-ready files

Understanding of CMYK color, raster resolution, linked images, outlined fonts, bleeds, overlaps, and production scaling

Experience preparing files for contour-cut and plotter-cut vinyl

Understanding of vehicle-wrap layout and installation considerations

Ability to work accurately from vehicle templates, photographs, and measurements

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to follow file-naming, revision, proofing, and approval processes

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

Reliable high-speed internet

A computer capable of efficiently handling large Illustrator and Photoshop files

Availability during U.S. Central Time business hours

A quiet, professional remote-working environment

Preferred Qualifications

At least three years of professional sign, vehicle-wrap, large-format printing, or production-design experience

Previous experience working for a sign shop, wrap company, print company, or graphics-production business

Experience designing commercial vehicle wraps and fleet graphics

Experience preparing artwork for wide-format printers and vinyl plotters

Knowledge of common vehicle-template systems

Understanding of vinyl paneling, seams, overlaps, installation direction, and material-width limitations

Experience with storefront signs, dimensional lettering, wall graphics, window graphics, and exterior signage

Familiarity with RIP software and large-format print workflows

Experience working remotely with U.S.-based customers or businesses

Experience using project-management, cloud-storage, and online communication systems

What Success Looks Like

A successful designer will:

Produce creative work that supports the customer’s brand and business goals

Create vehicle graphics that look good on the actual vehicle, not just on a flat template

Submit files that can move into production with minimal corrections

Avoid placing critical graphics in areas that interfere with installation or readability

Follow dimensions, scales, bleeds, overlaps, and file-setup requirements accurately

Catch spelling, sizing, placement, and production errors before approval or printing

Complete revisions promptly and accurately

Communicate questions and concerns before they become production problems

Keep source files organized and easy for other team members to use

Meet agreed-upon deadlines consistently

Portfolio Requirements

Applicants must provide a portfolio containing relevant professional work. The portfolio should include:

At least three vehicle-wrap or fleet-graphics designs

Examples of original concept development

Before-and-after examples of vectorized or recreated artwork

Signage or large-format print designs

Customer-facing mockups

Examples of final production files, with confidential customer information removed if necessary

At least one example showing how a design was adapted around vehicle doors, handles, curves, windows, wheel wells, or panel breaks

Applications consisting primarily of logos, social media graphics, or web designs will not demonstrate the production experience required for this position.

Skills Evaluation

Final candidates may be asked to complete a short paid skills evaluation. The evaluation may include:

Recreating a low-resolution logo as vector artwork

Developing a vehicle-graphics concept from a project brief

Correcting an intentionally flawed wrap layout

Preparing a print-and-cut production file

Identifying production or installation risks in an existing design

The evaluation will be used to assess design quality, production knowledge, file organization, attention to detail, communication, and completion time.

The Project Workflow



We want someone who can help us build a repeatable structure like:



Plans



?

?

?

?



Estimate & Budget

?



Project Delivery



Rather than setting every job up differently, we want to create a strong master system that can be duplicated and adjusted for each new project.



Scope of Works



A big part of the role will be helping create clear and detailed scopes for each trade.



For example:



Excavation

Concrete

Formwork

Steel

Carpentry

Roofing

Windows and doors

Plumbing

Electrical

HVAC

Waterproofing

Tiling

Cabinetry

Painting

Flooring

Landscaping



Each package should clearly identify what is included, what isn't included, relevant plan references and any project-specific requirements.



Trade Packages



You'll help us create structured trade packages that can be issued to subcontractors for pricing and then used throughout construction.



We want to develop a library of repeatable trade packages so future projects become faster and easier to set up.



Construction Scheduling



You'll also help build and maintain project schedules.



You should understand:



Construction sequencing

Dependencies between trades

Lead times

Procurement timelines

Long-lead items

Critical milestones

Practical completion

Handover



You should be comfortable looking at a residential project and understanding roughly what needs to happen, in what order, and when each trade needs to be involved.



Estimating & Purchase Orders



You'll also assist with:



Quantity take-offs

Supplier pricing

Subcontractor quotes

Estimates

Budgets

Purchase orders

Cost coding

Committed costs

Actual costs

Variations



You don't need to be a senior quantity surveyor, but you do need a solid understanding of how construction costs are structured.



Experience We're Looking For



Ideally, you've previously worked with:



An Australian residential builder

Custom home builder

Renovation builder

Construction estimator

Quantity surveyor

Project administrator

Contract administrator

Construction procurement team



Experience working with Australian builders is highly preferred.



Software Experience



Experience with Wunderbuild would be fantastic but is not compulsory.



We're also interested in candidates who have used:



Buildxact

Buildertrend

Databuild

Cubit

CostX

Bluebeam

Planswift

Procore

JobTread

CoConstruct

Simpro

Excel

Google Sheets



We're happy to teach Wunderbuild.



We don't want to teach someone how a construction project works from scratch.



You Should Understand



You should be familiar with terms such as:



Scope of Works

Trade Packages

BOQ

Take-offs

Cost Codes

Purchase Orders

RFQs

Estimates

Variations

Prime Costs

Provisional Sums

Job Costing

Project Budgets

Construction Programs

Construction Milestones

Plans and Specifications

What Success Looks Like



Within the first few months, we'd like to have:



A standard Wunderbuild project template

Standard project stages

Standard cost codes

Standard scopes of work

Standard trade packages

A reusable construction schedule

Purchase order templates

A supplier and subcontractor database

A repeatable process for setting up every new project



The end goal is that when we win a new project, we aren't starting from scratch.



We duplicate the system, adjust it for the project and get moving.



Website Integration



Separate to the construction setup work, we also want our website to communicate with Wunderbuild.



For example:



Website enquiry ? Wunderbuild lead/client/project workflow



This isn't the main responsibility of this role, but experience with APIs, Zapier, Make, webhooks or CRM integrations would be a bonus.

A short introduction.

Your construction experience.

WUNDERBUILD PROJECT SETUP

RobsWunderExpert2026

title: Partner Payments & Accounts Receivable Coordinator
description:
We need a persistent, organized person to own our partner payment process, keep every balance accurate, and follow up until every payment is received in full.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This job involves following up with business partners for payment.



Sometimes a partner will:



- Ignore your messages

- Promise to pay but miss the promised date

- Send only part of the requested payment

- Ask you to wait

- Try to discuss another business issue instead of paying



Your responsibility is to remain calm, keep accurate records, and continue following up.



You must be comfortable sending a fourth or fifth reminder when necessary.



You will not negotiate with partners. The manager handles negotiations privately.



SCHEDULE



- Monday to Friday

- Approximately 2 hours of actual work per day

- Work is spread across the day

- Monitor
 from 
 to 
 Philippine time

- When a partner messages, you should normally respond within 30 minutes

- This is not an eight-hour desk job



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will be responsible for keeping the partner payment area organized and under control.



At any time, you should know:



- Which partners need to pay

- How much each partner needs to pay

- Which invoices remain open

- Whether a payment was complete or partial

- Which payments are late

- When each partner promised to pay

- When you need to follow up again

- Whether a partner’s prepaid balance is becoming too low

- Which problems need the manager’s attention



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Check partner balances every working day

- Track payment requests and open invoices

- Follow up with partners through

- Continue following up until the complete payment arrives

- Ask for a specific payment date or time

- Follow up when a promised payment is missed

- Check whether the correct amount was received

- Identify partial and missing payments

- Confirm received payments

- Keep our payment records updated

- Alert the manager before a balance becomes urgent

- Escalate ignored messages, missed promises, and payment disputes

- Send the manager a short weekly payment summary

- Make sure no payment is forgotten



HOW WE COMMUNICATE



-
 is used with business partners

- Lark is used with the manager and internal team

- The manager is available when you need information or a decision

- Normal daily work should be handled without waiting for reminders

- Problems should be reported early, not after they become emergencies



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- You will not negotiate deals

- You will not negotiate prices or payment terms

- You will not discuss whether a partnership should continue

- You will not debate campaign or lead performance

- You will not make promises about future business

- You will not perform sales or cold calling

- You will not manage bank accounts

- You will not do advanced accounting



When a partner wants to discuss the business relationship, you will pass the conversation to the manager and remain focused on the outstanding payment.



THE PERSON WE NEED



You may be a strong fit if you:

- Keep organized records

- Ask the manager when a real decision is required



Previous payment collections or accounts receivable experience is helpful, but not required.



Intelligence, persistence, accuracy, judgment, and reliability matter more to us than a specific job title or degree.



PAY



- $350 USD per month ($300 for first month of trial)

- The first 30 days are a fully paid trial

- Long-term position for the right person

- Written performance and pay review after six months



CONFIDENTIALITY



- You will handle private business information

- Partner names, payments, balances, and company records must remain confidential

- You will sign a confidentiality agreement before starting



HOW TO APPLY



Your application must follow every instruction below.



Applications missing an item will not be considered.

title: Revenue-Driven Content & Conversion Strategist
description:
Event Marketing | Engagement | High-CTA Content | Conversion



Remote | Performance-Based | Revenue + Commission



We are hiring a Revenue-Driven Content & Conversion Strategist to build momentum, engagement, demand, and ultimately ticket sales for a major 2027 Early Childhood Education implementation summit.



This is NOT a traditional Social Media Manager position.



We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is posting consistently, making graphics, increasing followers, or filling a content calendar.



 This position has a revenue objective.



Your content should cause people to:



STOP ? ENGAGE ? RESPOND ? CLICK ? INQUIRE ? BUY



We need someone who understands how to take a movement, event, founder, speakers, industry problems, partnerships, solutions, and ticket offer and build a strategic content campaign that converts attention into action and action into revenue.



YOUR FIRST MISSION: BUILD MOMENTUM



Your first major assignment will be developing and executing a complete 30-Day Event Momentum & Conversion Campaign.



We do NOT want 30 random social media posts.



We want a strategically sequenced campaign where every piece of content has an objective.



You will develop:



* Educational authority content

* High-CTA conversion content

* Bold and controversial conversation starters

* Industry pain-point content

* Polls and audience questions

* Founder-led video concepts and scripts

* Short-form video/Reel concepts

* Speaker/session tie-ins

* Partner and sponsor spotlights

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Implementation challenges

* Audience participation campaigns

* Community engagement posts

* Social proof content

* Ticket-focused campaigns

* Urgency and scarcity messaging

* Lead-generation content

* Retargeting/reactivation concepts

* Direct-response CTAs



The goal is to intentionally move our audience through:



ATTENTION ? ENGAGEMENT ? INTEREST ? INTENT ? CONVERSION ? REVENUE



 THIS ROLE IS MEASURED DIFFERENTLY



We are not hiring someone simply to report:



"We posted 25 times this month."



"Engagement increased."



"We gained 300 followers."



Those numbers may matter, but they are not the finish line.



We want to know:



How many people took action?



How many qualified conversations did the content generate?



How many people clicked?



How many entered the ticket pipeline?



How many converted?



How much attributable revenue did the campaign generate?



 Activity alone is not performance.



YOUR SCORECARD



Performance will be evaluated through measurable indicators including:



* Content-generated leads

* CTA responses

* Qualified DMs/conversations

* Landing-page/ticket-page traffic

* Link clicks

* Ticket inquiries

* Ticket purchases

* Conversion rate

* Audience reactivation

* Campaign-attributed revenue

* Revenue generated from organic content

* Engagement that progresses into the sales pipeline



 COMPENSATION



This is a performance-driven revenue and commission-based opportunity.



Compensation is designed around measurable conversion and revenue performance.



The stronger your content performs and the more attributable revenue your campaigns help generate, the greater your earning opportunity.



This opportunity is best suited for someone who is confident in their ability to produce more than vanity metrics.



If you need guaranteed compensation regardless of campaign performance, this may not be the right opportunity for you.



If you understand direct-response marketing, conversion content and performance-based compensation—and you're confident you can help turn attention into revenue—we want to talk to you.



 WHO WE NEED



You may have experience as a:



* Content Marketing Strategist

* Conversion Copywriter

* Direct-Response Content Strategist

* Event Marketing Strategist

* Social Media Conversion Strategist

* Organic Growth Strategist

* Community Conversion Strategist



Your exact previous title matters less than your ability to produce measurable results.



You should understand:



Content Strategy



How individual pieces of content work together as part of a larger campaign.



Direct-Response Copywriting



How to write hooks, build tension, communicate value, overcome objections and create strong CTAs.



Conversion



How to move an audience from passive consumption into measurable action.



Event Marketing



How to build anticipation and demand around a future live experience.



Community Engagement



How to create conversations rather than simply broadcast information.



Buyer Psychology



How awareness, pain, desire, urgency, trust and social proof influence purchasing decisions.



Analytics



How to determine what's working, what's not and what needs to change.



 YOU MUST BE ABLE TO THINK BEYOND ONE POST



If we tell you:



 “ECE school owners are struggling with staffing, leadership accountability, payroll, funding and outdated technology.”



We expect you to immediately begin thinking:



What's the strongest hook?



What conversation could we start?



What's the founder video?



What's the poll?



What's the controversial angle?



Which speaker connects to the problem?



Which partner provides a solution?



What's the lead-generation opportunity?



What's the CTA?



How do we move the engaged person toward purchasing a ticket?



That's the level of strategic thinking this position requires.



FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLE



You will develop and execute a 30-Day Event Momentum & Conversion Campaign, including:



* 30-day strategic content calendar

* Daily content concepts

* Finished captions/copy

* High-impact hooks

* Content objectives

* Recommended formats

* Founder video scripts/topics

* Engagement questions

* Polls

* Speaker integrations

* Partner integrations

* Behind-the-scenes concepts

* Implementation challenges

* Lead-generation opportunities

* High-CTA conversion posts

* Ticket-sales CTAs

* Weekly conversion review

* Campaign optimization recommendations



Every piece of content should answer:



 What do we want this person to DO next?



HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications will not be considered.



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction explaining your experience with conversion-focused content, direct-response marketing, event marketing, lead generation or revenue-producing social media.



2. Three examples of content or campaigns you personally created or strategized.



3. At least one example of a campaign where your work contributed to leads, registrations, purchases or revenue.



Numbers matter.



Whenever possible, include:



Audience Size ? Campaign ? Leads/Clicks ? Conversions ? Revenue



4. Explain how you determine whether content is producing business results rather than vanity metrics.



5. Tell us about your experience working under a performance/commission-based compensation structure.



 REQUIRED MINI ASSIGNMENT



We want to evaluate how you THINK.



Imagine you are marketing a major Early Childhood Education implementation summit.



The central message is:



The industry has talked about its problems long enough. It's time to start implementing solutions.



Create three concepts:



 A. CONVERSATION



One bold post designed to generate meaningful discussion.



 B. FOUNDER VIDEO



One short-form founder video/Reel concept.



 C. CONVERSION



One high-CTA post designed to move an engaged follower closer to purchasing a ticket.



For each provide:



HOOK ? CONTENT IDEA ? CTA ? DESIRED ACTION



Do not spend more than 20–30 minutes completing this assignment.



We aren't evaluating graphic design.



We're evaluating your ability to create:



ATTENTION.

CONVERSATION.

ACTION.

CONVERSION.

REVENUE.



 ONE FINAL QUESTION



Finish your application by answering:



 If you had 30 days to turn an engaged but non-buying audience into paying event attendees, what would you do first—and why?



We are looking for someone who doesn't wake up asking:



What should I post today?



We want someone who asks:



 “What does the audience need to see, hear, believe or experience today that will move them closer to taking action?”



If you understand that difference, we want to hear from you.

title: Medical billing assistant for medicaid
description:
Position Summary

The Medical Billing Assistant supports the primary billing staff by ensuring accurate claim reconciliation, resolving reimbursement issues, and driving timely collections. This role focuses on following up on unpaid or partially paid claims, tracking reprocessing efforts, monitoring authorization status, and reporting key performance metrics to help maximize revenue for the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Perform monthly reconciliation of claims to identify unpaid, denied, or underpaid accounts.

Investigate and resolve reimbursement discrepancies by reviewing EOBs/ERAs, payer contracts, and documentation.

Contact insurance payers (via phone, portal, or written correspondence) to determine reasons for non-payment or partial payment and take corrective action.

Follow up on partially paid claims and manage the full process required to secure complete payment (corrected claims, appeals, additional documentation, etc.).

Track and provide weekly progress updates on claims currently being reprocessed or under appeal.

Monitor and report the status of pending authorizations, ensuring timely follow-up to prevent claim delays or denials.

Calculate and report monthly collection percentages and other key billing performance metrics.

Maintain accurate notes and documentation in the billing system for all follow-up activity.

Assist with general billing support tasks as assigned by the primary billing person.

Maintain strict confidentiality of patient and financial information in compliance with HIPAA and company policies.

Required Qualifications

Previous experience in medical billing, claims follow-up, or accounts receivable (home health, long-term care, or similar preferred).

Working knowledge of insurance claim processes, denials, appeals, and common payer requirements.

Strong phone communication and problem-solving skills.

Ability to organize and prioritize a high volume of follow-up work.

Proficiency with billing software, payer portals, and Microsoft Office (Excel strongly preferred).

High attention to detail and ability to meet weekly and monthly reporting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Medicaid, Medicare, or managed care claims.

Familiarity with authorization workflows and prior authorization requirements.

Experience generating collection percentage and aging reports.

This role is designed to provide dedicated support so the primary billing person can focus on higher-level billing oversight while ensuring claims are worked thoroughly and collection performance is tracked consistently.
