title: Experienced Sales Representative / Sales Closer — FULLY REMOTE
description:
Experienced Sales Representative / Sales Closer — FULLY REMOTE — $1,000–$1,200 USD / ?61,600–?74,000 PHP Monthly + Bonuses



Company: Shah Equity / Shah Quantum Fund

Location: 100% Fully Remote

Employment Type: Short-Term / Project-Based with Potential for Long-Term Employment

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6–8 hours per day

Working Window: 9:00 AM–9:00 PM U.S. Central Time

Shifts: Morning and evening shifts available

Base Salary: $1,000–$1,200 USD/month (approximately ?61,600–?74,000 PHP/month)

Performance Bonus: $50 USD (approximately ?3,080 PHP) per successful Nominee Director



ABOUT SHAH EQUITY



Shah Equity is an investment and trading firm focused on quantitative trading and technology-driven financial strategies.



Our trading operation is different from a traditional investment firm. Rather than primarily holding a small number of large positions for months or years, our quantitative trading operation uses highly automated strategies that can execute a very large number of trades across multiple accounts and account types.



Capital is allocated across the portfolio using mathematical and quantitative factors.



One of our current growth initiatives is the Nominee Director Program, which requires us to recruit and onboard qualified individuals into the program.



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for an experienced Sales Representative / Sales Closer to help us rapidly grow this program.



This is a fast-paced, performance-driven sales position.



Your job is to speak directly with candidates, explain the opportunities, answer questions, handle objections, and close qualified candidates.



You will not be responsible for trading or managing brokerage accounts. Those responsibilities are handled by other parts of the organization. Your responsibility is the candidate-facing sales and onboarding process.



Your two primary responsibilities:



1. CAMPUS RECRUITER INTERVIEWS



You will interview candidates interested in becoming Campus Recruiters.



You will:



Explain the Campus Recruiter opportunity

Explain what they will be recruiting for

Answer their questions

Explain the compensation structure

Determine whether they are interested

Get qualified candidates onboarded

Have them complete and sign the Campus Recruiter onboarding/offer letter



2. NOMINEE DIRECTOR INTERVIEWS & CLOSING



Campus Recruiters refer potential Nominee Director candidates to us.



You will:



Interview referred candidates

Confirm they meet the required requirements

Explain the Nominee Director role

Explain the Nominee Director program

Answer questions

Explain the onboarding agreement

Walk candidates through the onboarding process

Close qualified candidates

Obtain the signed Nominee Director onboarding contract

Hand the candidate off to the next stage

YOUR JOB IN ONE LINE



SCREEN ? EXPLAIN ? ANSWER ? CLOSE ? SIGN ? HANDOFF



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



You will not be responsible for:



Opening brokerage accounts

Managing brokerage accounts

Executing trades

Managing trading strategies

Handling post-onboarding operational work



Your responsibility is to communicate, sell, close, and onboard candidates.



COMPENSATION

Base Salary



$1,000–$1,200 USD/month



Approximately:



?61,600–?74,000 PHP/month



Nominee Director Closing Bonus



You will receive:



$50 USD / approximately ?3,080 PHP



for every successful Nominee Director you personally close and onboard.



The $50 bonus is paid approximately 2 weeks after the Nominee Director signs the onboarding contract, once the candidate has entered the trading stage and the company can confirm the candidate is successfully onboarded.



Our current objective is to successfully onboard 240 Nominee Directors.



If you personally close 240 successful candidates:



240 × $50 = $12,000 USD in potential bonuses



in addition to your base salary.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

SALES EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have previous experience in one or more of the following:



Sales

Sales closing

High-ticket sales

Telesales

Business development

Appointment setting + closing

Direct sales

Inside sales

Customer acquisition

Performance-based sales



We strongly prefer candidates who can demonstrate measurable sales results.



Applicants without previous sales or closing experience will not be considered.



ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



Fluent English

Excellent spoken English

Clear, natural English pronunciation

Strong professional communication skills

Ability to confidently lead conversations in English

Ability to explain information clearly and simply

Ability to build trust with candidates



A 30–60 second English voice recording is REQUIRED with your application.



PERSONALITY WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is hungry to succeed.



You should be:



Ambitious

Competitive

Driven

Self-motivated

Fast-paced

Accountable

Extremely reliable

If we give you a task, we expect you to understand it, execute it, and complete it without unnecessary delays.



We are looking for people who want to move fast and produce results.



SHORT-TERM WITH POTENTIAL FOR LONG-TERM



This is initially a short-term, high-volume project-based sales position with potential for long-term employment.



Our current objective is to rapidly onboard 240 successful Nominee Directors.



Strong performers who consistently close candidates, work efficiently, meet deadlines, and perform well may have the opportunity to continue with the company as our operations develop.

title: Executive Operations Coordinator / Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Operations Coordinator / Executive Assistant



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote



Starting Salary: $1,100 CAD/month



90-Day Performance Review + Opportunity for Increase



We are a hospitality company based in Toronto, Canada seeking a highly organized, proactive, reliable Executive Operations Coordinator / Executive Assistant to work directly with the Owner.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant position.



Your primary responsibility will be making sure things get done.



You will act as the central point between the Owner and our management team—tracking tasks, following up with managers, monitoring deadlines, verifying completion, documenting results, managing reminders, and providing the Owner with a clear daily overview.



Our goal is for the Owner to no longer have to personally chase multiple staff members to determine what has or has not been completed.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Task & Staff Accountability

Receive instructions directly from the Owner.

Assign tasks to the appropriate managers/supervisors.

Set and track deadlines.

Follow up consistently until tasks are completed.

Request proof of completion when appropriate.

Document missed deadlines and recurring issues.

Ensure unfinished tasks are never forgotten.

Track who is reliable and who consistently requires reminders.

Daily Operations



Help monitor operational responsibilities including:



Staff schedules.

Opening/closing responsibilities.

Inventory and ordering.

Maintenance.

Events.

Security confirmations.

Reservations/VIPs.

Required pickups.

Operational issues.

Special projects.



You will not physically perform these tasks. Your responsibility is to make sure the appropriate team member completes them.



Daily Owner Report



A structured report must be delivered to the Owner by 12:00 PM Toronto time every day.



It will summarize:



What happened the previous night.

What was completed.

What was not completed.

Today's staff lineup.

Today's priorities.

Outstanding tasks.

Important deadlines/reminders.

Events or major reservations.

Problems currently being handled.

Decisions requiring Owner approval.

Calendar & Reminders



You will help manage important business and personal:



Dates.

Deadlines.

Meetings.

Appointments.

Payroll reminders.

Payment reminders.

Follow-ups.

Events.

Travel-related dates.



Once something important is communicated to you, the Owner should not have to remember it again.



Events



You will help ensure operational preparation is completed before events, including:



Staffing.

Security.

Inventory.

Required purchases.

Special requests.

Event readiness.



Our standard is:



Event Day = Execution, Not Preparation.



Projects



You will track renovations, repairs, improvements, research, quotes, and other special projects assigned by the Owner.



Documentation



Important tasks and information must be properly documented and easily retrievable.



Our main systems include:



Connecteam

WhatsApp

Google Drive




You should already be experienced and confident working with organized task-management, communication, documentation, and reporting systems. Experience with Connecteam, WhatsApp, Google Drive, and
-based reporting is an advantage. You must be comfortable quickly learning any Sheba-specific processes or systems you have not previously used.

Authority



You will be communicating with managers and supervisors on behalf of the Owner.



You must therefore be confident enough to follow up repeatedly when necessary while remaining respectful and professional.



You will not have authority to make major business decisions, purchases, financial commitments, policy changes, or agreements without Owner approval.



Safety and legal emergencies must be escalated immediately.



Who We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized.

Proactive.

Reliable.

Detail-oriented.

Persistent.

Excellent at follow-up.

Strong in written and spoken English.

Confident communicating with experienced managers.

Professional and respectful.

Comfortable holding people accountable.

Able to manage multiple deadlines.

Good at identifying what is urgent.

Able to work independently.

Solution-oriented.

Comfortable asking for proof of completion.

Strong at documentation.

Interested in a long-term position.



Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Operations VA, or similar position is strongly preferred.



Schedule — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Seven-day availability is required.



Our business operates seven days per week, and Friday, Saturday and Sunday are particularly important. Weekend availability is non-negotiable.



Typical coverage is approximately:



12:00 PM–9:00 PM Toronto Time



This means overnight working hours in the Philippines.



The position averages approximately 40–45 working hours per week.



This does NOT mean you will actively work nine hours every day. Some days will be lighter than others.



However, you must be dependable and available throughout the week based on operational needs.



If you are looking for a traditional Monday–Friday Philippine daytime position, this role is not the right fit.



Compensation



Starting Salary: $1,000 CAD/month



There will be a formal 90-day performance review.



Strong performance may result in increased compensation and additional responsibilities.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the company long-term.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:



Important tasks stop being forgotten.

The Owner is no longer chasing managers for routine updates.

Managers become more accountable to deadlines.

Inventory and ordering happen consistently.

Daily reporting becomes reliable.

Outstanding tasks are followed until completion.

Important information is documented.

Preventable last-minute problems decrease.

The Owner can spend less time physically at the business while still knowing exactly what is happening.



Our long-term goal is to build systems that allow the company to operate efficiently without depending on the Owner being physically present every day.



The Owner provides direction. Management executes. You ensure accountability, follow-through, documentation, and visibility.



HOW TO APPLY

6. Give an example of something you identified and handled proactively before your employer asked you to do it.



7. Are you fully comfortable working overnight Philippine hours and having availability seven days per week, including weekends?



8. Are you currently working another full-time job or supporting other clients? If yes, explain your current commitments.



9. Do you have reliable internet, backup internet, a reliable computer, and a backup plan for power/internet outages?



10. Are you comfortable with the starting salary of $1,100 CAD/month?



11. Why do you believe you would be good at a position where follow-up, accountability, organization, and persistence are the most important responsibilities?



12. When are you available to start?



Important Application Instruction

Applications that do not follow the instructions or answer the required questions may not be considered.

title: Virtual Assistant — Processing & Coordination | Simpro Experience Mandatory | Full-Time
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on Simpro experience will be prioritised — this is a mandatory, non-negotiable requirement for this role.



A large-scale, multi-state trade services operation is hiring one full-time Virtual Assistant to serve as a processing and coordination counterpart to their Australian-based Customer Relations Officers (CROs). The VA will pick up the same scope, responsibilities, and coverage previously split across the team. The primary objective is to handle the high-volume "processing" side of the business — including data entry, supplier coordination, and back-end administration — allowing the local Australian team to focus on direct customer-facing interactions.



Given the volume this role covers across multiple regional locations, the business needs someone who can dedicate their full, undivided attention to the role during the working hours, with no competing demands or interruptions during that window.



Working Hours: 8:00am–4:30pm AEST, Monday to Friday



What You'll Own



Simpro & Financial Processing



Handle the primary back-end of Simpro; hands-on Simpro experience required, with additional platform training provided for day-to-day data entry and reporting

Manage data entry for packing slips and supplier invoices

Predominantly focused on bank reconciliation, with potential growth into debt collection (Accounts Receivable)



Supplier & System Coordination



Connect with a set of main suppliers for quotes, part availability, and order follow-ups

Monitor automation triggers (e.g. invoice payment triggers for reviews) and manage soft-phone/text-based interactions recorded in the system

Utilise the CRM platform for remote task management and tracking



Documentation & Onboarding



Assist in creating a permanent company "blueprint" and maintaining a customised Employee Handbook with training links

Participate in a mandatory daily session with core staff for the first month to ensure business assimilation



Day-to-Day Task List



Prepare initial stages of pending / progress / completed jobs

Prepare quotes from failed SLAs

Prepare quotes from breakdown jobs

Prepare a monthly report for underperforming jobs, ready for review

Raise POs for equipment as directed by the CRO

Prepare a list of quote follow-ups ready for the CRO to phone the customer

Data integrity checks (customer details, duplicate sites)

Prepare a list of outstanding POs and action with the supplier

Allocate overtime from the previous day

Receipt packing slips in Simpro

Receipt supplier invoices in Simpro

Reconcile supplier statements in Simpro



What We're Looking For



Experience



Minimum 2 years of experience in administrative or general virtual assistant roles, specifically within trade, construction, or high-volume service industries

Familiarity with the "processing" side of a trade business, focused on back-end coordination to support high-level operational growth



Software Proficiency



Hands-on Simpro experience is mandatory — non-negotiable given the immediate operational demands and the fact the VA is stepping into an established workflow

High proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and Xero, particularly for consistent bank reconciliations and potential debt collection tasks

Familiarity with similar project management systems (e.g. Aeroflow, ServiceM8) is a bonus but does not substitute for direct Simpro experience



Communication Skills



Exceptional verbal and written English, with a neutral accent suitable for professional daily interactions with Australian suppliers

Interpersonal skills necessary to "take the heat off" onshore Customer Relations Officers by confidently handling direct coordination with external stakeholders



Non-Negotiables

title: Billing & Claims Specialist
description:
TSGBH is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented  Billing & Claims Specialist to support our behavioral health billing operations.



This position is ideal for someone who has experience working with  U.S. healthcare claims, insurance billing, Medicaid, claim follow-up, and payment reconciliation .



Your primary responsibility will be making sure services that have been provided are properly billed, claims are followed through to payment, and billing problems are identified and resolved quickly.



This is  not simply a data-entry position.  We need someone who can review a claim, identify why it has not been paid, and take the appropriate next step.



Key Responsibilities



* Submit and monitor insurance claims

* Review claims for accuracy before submission

* Track unpaid, pending, rejected, and denied claims

* Follow up with insurance companies and managed care organizations regarding claim status

* Review EOBs, ERAs, and payment information

* Identify claim denials and rejection reasons

* Correct and resubmit rejected or denied claims when appropriate

* Maintain an organized list of outstanding claims

* Post or reconcile insurance payments as assigned

* Verify that services documented have been billed

* Identify missing documentation that may prevent billing

* Identify authorization or eligibility problems affecting claims

* Communicate billing issues to management and clinical/administrative staff

* Maintain accurate notes regarding claim follow-up activity

* Assist with accounts receivable and aging reports

* Escalate claims that require additional intervention

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Healthcare billing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand or have experience with:



* U.S. healthcare insurance billing

* Behavioral health or mental health billing

* Medicaid claims

* CMS-1500/professional claims

* Claims submission

* Denials and rejections

* EOBs and ERAs

* Accounts receivable

* Insurance eligibility

* Prior authorizations

* Claim status follow-up

* Payment reconciliation





Skills Needed



The right person must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching billing problems

* Able to follow a claim from submission through payment

* Comfortable communicating professionally by
 and telephone

* Able to document their work clearly

* Able to recognize when something does not look correct

* Reliable and consistent with attendance

* Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours



Strong written English and professional communication skills are required.



Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the billing process.



You should not simply report that a claim was denied.



We expect you to determine:



Why was it denied?

Can it be corrected?

What information is missing?

Who needs to take action?

What is the next step?



Our goal is to maintain clean claims, reduce denials, follow up aggressively on outstanding balances, and make sure the company receives payment for services that have been properly provided.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour with Bonus



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate. Performance, reliability, accuracy, and demonstrated ability to manage claims independently will be considered during future compensation reviews.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe your previous U.S. healthcare billing experience.

3. What types of insurance or Medicaid claims have you worked with?

4. Have you worked with behavioral health or mental health billing?

5. What billing or EHR systems have you used?

6. Describe how you would handle a claim that was submitted but has not been paid after 30 days.

7. Describe a denial you have handled in the past and how you resolved it.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during **U.S. Eastern Time**.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn our organization, take ownership of our claims, and become a dependable long-term member of our administrative team.

title: Contracts Coordinator (Estimating & Accounts) — NZ Renovation Company
description:
**About us**



We are Refresh Renovations Rodney, a residential renovation company north of Auckland, New Zealand. We design, manage and build kitchens, bathrooms, extensions and full home renovations, and we are known locally for projects that are properly planned and properly run.



Small close knit team plus our trades, growing steadily and ready to welcome our next team member.



**The role**



This is a new role, and it exists because we are growing.



We are taking on more projects each year and bigger ones. The commercial side of a build, pricing it, costing it, controlling the cost and pricing the changes, has been shared between our directors up to now. It has outgrown that. We want one person who owns it end to end.



From the moment a design is signed off through to the last variation, the numbers on that project are yours.



You will:



- Send scopes of work out to our trades for pricing, and chase every quote until it lands

- Check each quote against the scope and tell us what has been left out

- Build the project costing in our construction software 

- Put the client proposal together once our director has set the margin

- Raise purchase orders and track cost against budget on every live job

- Price variations when the job changes, and make sure none are missed

- Work out what we can claim each month

- Own the accounting: supplier bills coded to the right job, bank reconciliations, accounts payable, month end, 



We have good systems and we keep investing in them. Our construction platform already tracks costings, variations and purchase orders across every job, and we are building the reporting on top of it. So this is not a spreadsheet building job. Your work is what the systems cannot do: picking up the phone to a trade who has not come back, and spotting what a quote is missing.



**Who we are looking for**



Above everything else, someone who genuinely likes numbers. Not someone who puts up with them. Someone who reconciles a thing because it is bugging them.



You are the person who spots what everyone else missed. One quote is priced excluding GST and the other two include it. A bill has been coded to the wrong job. A variation was signed in March and never invoiced. You see those.



And you have judgement. On a Friday you have noticed twelve things, and you know which three actually matter. You tell us those three.



That combination is rare and it is the whole job.



**You need**



- Real accounting capability. You can own bills, reconciliations, payables, month end and GST workings without supervision

- Construction job costing experience

- The ability to read a scope of works against a quote and see what is missing

- Willingness to ring a supplier and push for a price. This is not an
 only role

- Xero experience, and the ability to pick up new software fast. We use Wunderbuild. If you have used Buildxact, Buildertrend or similar you will be at home

- Enough organisation to hold a chase list without being chased yourself

- Clear written English

- Availability in New Zealand business hours



**Nice to have**



- You have worked for an Australian or New Zealand residential builder. Contracts Administrator and Estimator are known roles there and this will look familiar

- Renovation rather than new build

- You have run a pricing process end to end, not just entered data



**This is not**



- A legal or procurement contracts role. We are not managing contract documents, we are pricing building work

- Only a bookkeeping role. The accounting is real and it is yours, but so is the pricing, and the pricing is the bigger half



---



**What we pay**



**NZD 2,400 per month** to start (about USD 1,420), paid directly to you with no agency taking a cut.



We review at three months against clear criteria that go in your agreement, so you know exactly what you are working toward rather than hoping for a conversation. The role grows from there, and we would rather walk you through that properly than put a ladder in a job advert.



**Also**



- Full time, permanent, working from home

- New Zealand hours

- Salary is agreed and paid in New Zealand dollars. The USD figure is a guide, so the exact USD amount moves a little with the exchange rate. We review pay annually

- A small team where you talk to the owners every day, not a call centre



---



**Before you apply**



We are hiring someone who catches what other people miss. So rather than ask whether you are detail oriented, we would rather see it.



Three short things. None should take more than a couple of minutes.



---



**One. Three trades have quoted the same bathroom.** New Zealand GST is 15 percent, and all figures are New Zealand dollars.



> Trade A — $4,200, including GST

> Trade B — $3,750, plus GST

> Trade C — $4,100, including GST



Which one is cheapest, and which is the most expensive? Show us how you got there.



---



**Two. Here is a costing for that same bathroom.**



> Plumbing ............ $6,580

> Electrical .......... $2,340

> Tiling .............. $4,120

> Waterproofing ....... $890

> **Total ............. $14,930**



Something is wrong with it. Tell us what, and what the number should be.



---



**Three. Tell us about something you noticed at work and deliberately did not raise.**



Two or three sentences. We are interested in why you left it alone.



---



**How to apply**



Send your CV and your answers to the three questions above.



**Use this exact subject line:**



> Contracts Coordinator — [the amount that total is out by]



So if you think the total is out by four hundred dollars, your subject line is "Contracts Coordinator — 400".



We read applications with the correct subject line first. Applications with no answers will not be read at all.



Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short practical exercise before we set up an interview.

title: Compliance Coordinator
description:
TSGBH is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Compliance Coordinator to support our behavioral health operations.



This position will help ensure that required documentation, employee files, client records, credentialing information, training requirements, and internal compliance processes are completed accurately and on time.



This is not simply an administrative assistant position. We need someone who can review records, identify missing or expired items, follow up with staff, maintain compliance trackers, and escalate concerns before they become larger problems.



Key Responsibilities



* Review employee and contractor files for required documentation

* Monitor expiration dates for licenses, credentials, certifications, trainings, and other required documents

* Maintain compliance tracking spreadsheets and internal systems

* Review client records for missing or incomplete documentation

* Monitor required signatures, assessments, treatment documents, and administrative forms

* Follow up with employees regarding missing or overdue compliance items

* Track onboarding and annual compliance requirements

* Assist with employee credentialing and recredentialing documentation

* Assist with payer and provider enrollment documentation as assigned

* Organize documents for internal and external audits

* Conduct routine file audits using established checklists

* Document compliance findings and corrective actions

* Monitor deadlines and send reminders before items become overdue

* Maintain organized electronic compliance files

* Assist management with policy and procedure tracking

* Review records for consistency with company requirements

* Report significant compliance concerns to management

* Assist with corrective action follow-up

* Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:



* Healthcare compliance

* Behavioral health administration

* Medical records

* Credentialing

* Human resources compliance

* Quality assurance

* Healthcare documentation

* Medicaid provider operations

* HIPAA-related administrative work



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare or behavioral health organization** is a major advantage.



Skills Needed



The successful candidate must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly organized

* Comfortable reviewing large amounts of documentation

* Able to identify missing, incomplete, or expired information

* Comfortable following up repeatedly when required

* Able to maintain accurate tracking systems

* Able to meet deadlines without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating professionally with employees and management

* Able to protect confidential information

* Comfortable learning new systems and processes

* Strong in written English

* Reliable and consistent with attendance



 What Success Looks Like



We do not want someone who simply checks boxes.



We need someone who asks:



**What is missing?

What is expiring soon?

Who is responsible for correcting it?

Has the issue been resolved?

What creates a risk for the organization?

What needs to be escalated to management?**



The goal of this position is to help prevent compliance problems before they become audit findings, payment issues, employee credentialing problems, or operational risks.



Daily Compliance Expectations



The Compliance Specialist should maintain a clear record of:



* Items reviewed

* Deficiencies identified

* Employees or departments contacted

* Items corrected

* Items still outstanding

* Upcoming expiration dates

* Issues requiring management attention



Every compliance issue should have a clear status and next action.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Employees who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, accuracy, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage compliance responsibilities with limited supervision may be considered for future compensation reviews and expanded responsibilities.



Schedule



Candidates must be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable internet, a dependable computer, and a quiet professional workspace are required.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe any experience you have with healthcare, compliance, credentialing, medical records, or quality assurance.

3. Have you previously worked for a U.S.-based healthcare company?

4. What systems or software have you used?

5. Describe how you would manage 50 employees with certifications and licenses that expire on different dates.

6. If you discovered that an employee's required credential expired two weeks ago, what steps would you take?

7. Describe how you stay organized when managing multiple deadlines.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during U.S. Eastern Time.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



Important



This position requires someone who is comfortable holding others accountable for completing required documentation.



You must be willing to follow up, document your efforts, identify risks, and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our compliance and administrative infrastructure—not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.

title: Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (ISA) – Full-Time
description:
We are a growing independent real estate brokerage in Texas looking for an experienced Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (ISA) to join our team full-time.



This is not an entry-level VA or administrative position. Your primary responsibility is to create conversations, identify opportunities, nurture leads, and turn prospects into qualified appointments for our real estate agents.



We are specifically looking for someone with extensive experience in U.S. residential real estate, real estate lead conversion, cold calling, database management, CRM organization, and appointment setting.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be working and converting our existing and new lead database through consistent outbound calling, texting,
, and systematic follow-up.



You will:



-Work a large aged real estate database and identify buyers and sellers who are ready to re-engage.-

-Prospect expired and withdrawn listings and convert homeowners into listing appointments.

-Call expired rental listings to identify potential sales and property management opportunities.

-Respond quickly to new inbound buyer and seller leads.

-Conduct outbound cold calling and prospecting.

-Qualify buyer and seller motivation, timeline, needs, and readiness.

-Nurture long-term prospects who aren't ready today.

-Set qualified buyer consultations and listing appointments for our agents.

-Maintain accurate notes, statuses, tags, tasks, and follow-up plans inside the CRM.

-Clean, organize, segment, and systematically work a large cold/aged database.

-Build, implement, and optimize automated lead-nurture campaigns using calls, texts,
s, tasks, and other touchpoints.

-Create and manage Brivity Plans and/or Real Geeks Drip Campaigns designed to be engaging, natural, and conversion-focused.

-Evaluate existing nurture campaigns and improve messaging, timing, segmentation, and follow-up based on lead response and conversion.

-Develop and follow scripts while communicating naturally and confidently.

-Develop and document business processes related to the ISA role for future ISAs as we are a growing team.

-Understand when the lead could be a buyer, a listing, a property management opportunity or an investment opportunity.



What We're Looking For



Extensive U.S. real estate experience is required.



The ideal candidate has previous experience as a:



Real Estate ISA

Real Estate Appointment Setter

Real Estate Inside Sales Representative

Real Estate Lead Manager

Real Estate Cold Caller / Prospector

Lead Conversion Specialist for a real estate team or brokerage



You should already understand buyer leads, seller leads, expired listings, listing appointments, buyer consultations, lead nurture, database follow-up, lead stages, and real estate CRM pipelines.



Technology Experience



Experience with the following is a strong plus:



Brivity CRM — especially Plans and lead follow-up workflows

BrokerMint — transaction management

Buildium — property management 

Real estate dialers and calling platforms

Other major U.S. real estate CRMs and lead-management systems



**We're especially interested in candidates who have personally built or improved CRM nurture campaigns, rather than simply used campaigns created by someone else.**



The Personality We're Looking For



We need someone who is:



Highly influential and persuasive

Assertive and appropriately dominant

Confident asking for the appointment

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

Energetic and engaging on the phone

Persistent without sounding aggressive

Comfortable handling objections and rejection

Organized and disciplined with follow-up

Analytical enough to recognize what's working and what isn't

Coachable and comfortable working from measurable KPIs

An excellent English communicator with clear, professional spoken and written English



We want someone who can build rapport quickly but is also comfortable taking control of a conversation, uncovering motivation, handling objections, and asking for the appointment.



Success in This Role



We are results-oriented. Activity is important, but the goal isn't simply to make calls.



The goal is qualified appointments and ultimately closed business.



Performance will be measured using metrics such as:

-Outbound calls and conversations

-Contact rate

-Speed-to-lead

-Follow-up completion

-Leads qualified

-Appointments set

-Appointment show rate

-Database organization and CRM accuracy

-Opportunities generated from aged and cold leads

-Nurture campaign engagement and conversion

-Leads moved from nurture into active opportunities

-Position Details



Type: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Central Time business/prospecting hours

Location: Remote

Industry: U.S. Residential Real Estate

Position: Long-term



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of our sales organization—not someone looking for a short-term VA assignment.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume highlighting your U.S. real estate experience.

A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your real estate ISA/cold-calling experience.

A list of the real estate CRMs and dialers you've used. Specifically tell us about any experience with Brivity, Real Geeks, and BrokerMint.

Describe a drip campaign, Brivity Plan, or automated nurture sequence you've personally created or improved. What was the audience, what types of touches did you use, and what results did you see?

Tell us your expected monthly compensation for a full-time position.



Finally, begin your application with the words:



"I KNOW REAL ESTATE ISA"

AT MERIDIAN, WE FOCUS ON PEOPLE OVER PROFITS



Overview

title: DM Appointment setter
description:
# DM Appointment Setter – Instagram, TikTok &



MESSAGE ME ON 
 (317)
## About the Role



I am looking for a motivated and experienced **DM Appointment Setter** to join my online fitness coaching business.



You will be responsible for managing conversations across my **Instagram, TikTok, and
 accounts**, identifying qualified prospects, starting genuine conversations, following up with leads, and ultimately converting qualified prospects into **booked sales calls**.



This is NOT just a copy-and-paste messaging position. I need someone who can communicate naturally, understand people, ask good questions, recognize buying signals, overcome basic objections, and move conversations toward a booked call without sounding pushy or robotic.



## Your Main Goal



**Turn social media conversations into qualified booked appointments.**



New Lead ? Conversation ? Qualification ? Follow-Up ? Booked Call



## Responsibilities



* Manage DMs across Instagram, TikTok, and

* Reach out to new followers and potential prospects

* Respond to inbound leads and people engaging with our content

* Start conversations naturally without immediately pitching

* Build rapport and uncover the prospect's goals and struggles

* Qualify prospects before booking calls

* Follow up consistently with leads who stop responding

* Re-engage older leads

* Keep conversations and follow-ups organized

* Track leads and booked appointments

* Learn our offer, ideal client, messaging, and sales process



## Who We Help



Our coaching primarily helps **busy men 35+ who want to lose weight, improve their health, increase their energy, regain confidence, and become more consistent with fitness despite demanding careers and schedules.**



Qualified leads typically have a clear fitness or weight-loss goal, recognize they need help, are ready to make a change, and are willing and able to invest in professional coaching.



## What I DON'T Want



Please do not apply if your strategy is:



* Sending hundreds of identical copy-and-paste messages

* Immediately pitching people

* Sounding like a bot

* Booking anyone who agrees to a call

* Ignoring follow-ups

* Being overly aggressive

* Focusing on DM volume instead of results



I care about **qualified conversations and booked appointments**, not meaningless activity.



## Ideal Candidate



You would be a great fit if you:



* Have DM setting or appointment-setting experience

* Understand sales conversations

* Write and speak excellent English

* Can communicate naturally with American prospects

* Understand rapport and qualification

* Are comfortable handling basic objections

* Are organized with follow-ups

* Take coaching and feedback well

* Are reliable and consistent

* Are motivated by performance



Experience with **online coaching, fitness, high-ticket sales, or social media sales** is a major plus.



## Performance



Your performance will primarily be measured by:



* Meaningful conversations

* Qualified leads

* Qualified calls booked

* Follow-up consistency

* Appointment show rate

* Quality of appointments

* Sales generated from your appointments



**Booked calls alone are not enough.** Quality matters.



## 3-Day Trial Period



The **first 3 days will be a trial period** to determine whether you can effectively handle the position, follow our system, communicate properly with prospects, stay organized, and produce quality conversations.



During these three days, I will be evaluating your:



* Communication skills

* Ability to follow instructions

* Work ethic and consistency

* DM conversation quality

* Qualification ability

* Follow-up

* Overall fit for the position



If you successfully complete the trial and demonstrate that you can handle the role, **we will move forward into the ongoing paid position.**



I am looking for someone who wants to earn a long-term position, not someone looking for something temporary.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**“I READ THE FULL POST.”**



Then answer these **5 questions:**



1. What experience do you have with DM setting or appointment setting, and what types of businesses have you worked with?

2. What platforms have you used, and approximately how many qualified appointments were you booking per week?

3. How do you determine whether a prospect is qualified before booking them for a sales call?

4. How would you respond to a prospect who says, **“I know what I need to do, I just need to be more consistent”?**

5. What hours are you available, what is your expected hourly rate, and why do you believe you would be a good fit for this position?



Please also send a **short voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining your previous appointment-setting experience.



**Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.**

title: Sales Closer - UK Property Software (Live Video Demos)
description:
### Sales Closer — UK Property Software (Live Zoom Demos)



**About us**



Propell is an FCA Agent regulated property management platform for UK landlords. We give landlords one dashboard for their whole portfolio - live property valuations from Hometrack and HM Land Registry, automated compliance tracking for EPCs and gas safety certificates, live mortgage rate comparisons, and one-click insurance quotes. We currently look after over £761m of UK property and we're rated Excellent on Trustpilot.



We have three plans: Basic (£19/mo), Standard (£39/mo) and Premium (£159/mo, which includes a dedicated Property PA).



**The role**



This is a closing role. You are not cold calling and you are not setting appointments - we already have someone doing that.



**Your job is to take that booked demo, run it brilliantly, and close the sale.**



A typical day: 3–7 live Video demos with UK landlords (anywhere from 1 property to 50), plus follow-up on anyone who didn't buy on the call, didn't show up, or started a free trial and went quiet.



**What you'll actually do**



- Run live Video demos of the Propell platform to UK landlords — screen share, real product, real conversation

- Ask proper discovery questions before you demo, so you show the parts of the platform that matter to *that* landlord

- Handle objections on price, on "I already use a spreadsheet", on "I need to speak to my accountant"

- Take Payment and close on the call wherever possible

- Follow up by
, WhatsApp and phone on every deal that doesn't close first time

- Recommend the right plan for each landlord — including spotting who should be on Premium

- Log everything accurately in our CRM Hubspot and hand closed customers cleanly to onboarding

- Feed back to the founders on what objections you're hearing, so we can fix the product and the ads



**Who we're looking for**



Three things matter more than anything else on your CV:



1. **Flawless spoken English.** You will be talking to UK landlords, many of them over 50, many of them sceptical about software. If they have to ask you to repeat yourself, we lose the sale. Your English needs to be clear, natural, confident and easy for a British ear — neutral accent, correct grammar, comfortable with small talk.



2. **You understand UK property.** You know what a BTL mortgage, an EPC, a gas safety certificate, a Section 21, an LTV and a letting agent are — or you can prove you'll learn all of it inside two weeks. Direct UK lettings, estate agency or UK property VA experience is a big advantage.



3. **You learn software fast.** You will be demoing a platform that changes every few weeks. We need someone who can be shown a new feature once and demo it confidently the next day.



**Also required**



- 2+ years in a genuine closing role (SaaS, real estate, insurance, financial services or high-ticket B2C — not appointment setting, not lead gen)

- A track record you can talk about with real numbers: how many demos, what close rate, what you did to improve it

- Reliable fibre internet (minimum 25 Mbps), a quiet room, a good headset and a working webcam — you will be on camera

- Comfortable working 9am–6pm UK time, Monday to Saturday

- Coachable. We will record your demos and review them with you every week. If that sounds like criticism rather than help, this isn't the role for you.



**Nice to have**



- Experience demoing SaaS on Zoom or Google Meet

- HubSpot or similar CRM experience

- Any UK-facing sales background at all



**What we offer**



- **?50,000/month base salary**

- **?1,000 commission per conversion**, paid monthly with no cap

- Warm, pre-qualified, pre-booked demos — you never have to cold call

- Direct access to the founders. Small team, no layers, decisions made same-day

- Weekly demo coaching and a proper onboarding into the product

- Long-term role with room to grow into a team lead as we scale the sales function

- Monday to Saturday, 9am–6pm UK time



**How to apply — please read carefully, we do reject applications that skip this**



Send your application to 
 with the subject line:



> **PROPELL CLOSER — [your close rate in your last sales role]**



For example: `PROPELL CLOSER — 34%`



Then, in the body of your message, answer these four questions in your own words. Keep the whole thing under 400 words:



1. In two sentences, what does Propell do and who is it for?

2. What was your close rate in your last sales role, out of how many demos or calls per month, and how do you know that number is accurate?

3. A UK landlord with 8 properties tells you he's "too busy to keep on top of the paperwork." Which of our three plans do you put him on, and what's your one-line reason?

4. What is the single most common objection you'd expect from a UK landlord looking at Propell, and how would you answer it?



Applications without the subject line, or that answer these with obviously AI-written text, go straight in the bin. We would much rather read your own plain English than a polished paragraph you didn't write.



Shortlisted candidates go to a short recorded video task, then a live Zoom roleplay, then a **paid** two-day product trial. We move fast — expect a decision within two weeks.

s or waits for instructions.

Shopify

title: Virtual Assistant — Document Control & Records Management | Notion Migration | Part-Time
description:
Role Overview



Candidates with genuine document control or records management experience will be prioritised — this is non-negotiable for the client.



A 100% Australian-owned Special Hazards Fire Systems supplier is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to take full ownership of a large-scale document clean-up and migration into Notion. The business has years of accumulated documentation — SOPs, contracts, data sheets, technical and safety documentation — spread across Google Drive, OneDrive, and other legacy locations, with no consistent structure and no prior ownership process. The same file often exists three, five, or even nine times over.



This is not a generalist admin or PA role, and it's not a "tag me 10,000 times" role. The Director has built (and will keep refining) the rules for how documents should be sorted, tagged, and archived — what he needs is someone who can take genuine ownership of a defined set of Notion databases, apply those rules with precision across thousands of documents, and be confident enough to escalate the ones that don't fit cleanly rather than guess.



Fire protection industry knowledge is not required and not expected on day one. A weekly review with the technical team exists specifically to sign off on anything uncertain, alongside daily team catchups and real-time group chat.



Working Days/Hours: Monday–Friday, part-time (hours may run heavier during the initial clean-up phase before settling into an ongoing upkeep rhythm) 

Reporting To: The Director, with weekly review/escalation touchpoints alongside the technical team



What You'll Own



Document Control & Records Management



Work through the business's existing document base and assess what needs to be kept, migrated, archived, or discarded

Apply the Director's tagging and categorisation rules to sort documents by type — e.g. marketing, technical, safety, HR

Identify and eliminate duplicate and triplicate copies of the same document

Assign an owner to each document as part of the filing process

Check document currency — e.g. confirming a safety data sheet's valid-until date before it's allowed to go out to customers — and flag or archive anything outdated

Archive rather than delete where a document may still be relevant to a site or design, even if outdated

Set reminders and follow a review cadence to keep documents current going forward, not just during the initial clean-up

Take full day-to-day ownership of a defined set of Notion databases



Notion Migration & System Management



Migrate documents from Google Drive / OneDrive into the company's Notion workspace

Build out and maintain database structure within owned databases, applying and refining the Director's validation rules for what belongs in each

Bring a "yes / no / maybe" pile to weekly reviews with the technical team for anything that can't be confidently classified alone



Marketing & Content Support (secondary, bonus scope — not the core hire)



Once document control is established, help assemble existing verified content (data sheets, specs, product information) into finished, external-facing pieces such as a LinkedIn post or a consultant-ready presentation

Support the sales team by pulling together relevant approved materials for a specific product or system on request



Team Communication & Collaboration



Join weekly review sessions with the technical team to resolve unclear document classifications

Stay responsive in real time on the team's group chat, in line with how the existing remote sales team already operates

Participate in daily team catchups



What We're Looking For



Experience



Demonstrated experience in document control or records management — non-negotiable

Understanding of document lifecycle concepts: ownership, verification, currency checks, and destruction/archiving plans

Contract administration background is a strong transferable-skill pathway into this role

Fire protection industry knowledge is not required, but would be a huge advantage



Technical Skills



Notion experience is a strong advantage — candidates with prior Notion experience won't need platform training

Comfortable navigating and extracting content from Google Drive and OneDrive

Marketing or design tool familiarity is a bonus for the secondary content-support scope, not a requirement



Non-Negotiables



High attention to detail — able to sift through thousands of documents without losing accuracy

Systematic, rules-based thinking — applies a consistent classification logic across a large, messy document set

Comfortable taking full ownership of a defined set of databases rather than working purely task-by-task

Confident escalating genuinely uncertain items rather than guessing

Comfortable working through some ambiguity in the early weeks while the full rule set is finalised (estimated 2–3 weeks)

Reliable and trustworthy — in it for the long haul, not a short-term task-taker

Calm under volume — processes high volumes of repetitive sorting work consistently, without cutting corners as the pile grows

Low-ego and confident enough to flag when something could be set up better — genuinely open feedback is welcomed, not just agreement



Why This Role



Real ownership: full day-to-day responsibility for a defined set of Notion databases, not a task-by-task tagging role

Work with a business that's serious about accountability, support over blame, and getting things right together

Room to grow: potential to expand into the content/marketing side of the role over time as the document base stabilises

Direct access to the Director and technical team for escalation — you're never left to guess alone



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — it helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Creative Designer
description:
Creative Designer

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time

Great design is still a human skill. The best creatives today just have better tools — and know exactly when to use them.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company

We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role

We're looking for a Creative Designer who understands that AI doesn't make great design — designers do. But the right tools, used well, make great designers faster, more prolific, and more creative than they'd be without them.

You'll own full creative production across marketing, brand, and content — static, motion, and video. You'll use AI where it genuinely helps: ideation, exploration, iteration, and production acceleration. And you'll apply your own judgment, taste, and craft to make sure the final output is something a machine could never produce on its own.



The Mindset We're Looking For

The best creative professionals we've worked with share a few traits:



They know that AI makes a great starting point, not a finished product. They use it to explore ideas faster, break through creative blocks, and accelerate production — then they take it the rest of the way themselves

They have strong creative instincts that no tool can replicate. They know when something is off, when something isn't good enough, and what it would take to make it right

They take ownership of quality. They don't ship work they're not proud of — regardless of how it was made

They're curious about new tools and genuinely open to learning them — not because someone told them to, but because staying sharp matters to them

They communicate clearly about creative decisions. They can explain why something works, take feedback without getting defensive, and push back when a direction isn't right





Who Thrives Here

People who are serious about the craft and smart about the tools. You believe a human designer will always make the work better — and you prove it in everything you ship. You're not resistant to AI, but you're not dependent on it either. You know the difference.

We're a growing MSP with expanding creative needs across marketing, brand, and content. For the right person, that's the opportunity to shape a creative function that produces exceptional work — not just efficient work.



What You'll Do

You'll walk into a business with real creative output needs across marketing, brand, and content — and the expectation that everything that ships is something you're proud to put your name on.

That looks like:



Producing the full range of marketing and brand creative — social graphics, digital ads,
 campaigns, presentations, and promotional materials — at a high standard, on time, every time

Using AI tools for ideation, concept exploration, and production support — then applying your own judgment and craft to take the output where it needs to go

Creating motion graphics, short-form video, and reels that drive real engagement — not just content that fills a calendar

Generating and refining AI imagery and integrating it into polished, on-brand work where it makes the piece stronger, not just faster

Maintaining brand consistency across every output — and flagging when guidelines need to evolve, not just following them blindly

Building reusable templates, asset libraries, and brand components that make the creative process more consistent and scalable

Collaborating with marketing and leadership to translate campaign objectives into creative that performs — not just looks good

Staying current on both design craft and emerging tools — bringing the best of both into the work





What We're Looking For



A strong portfolio demonstrating range across static, motion, and video creative — this is the first and most important filter

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro or equivalent) — your craft fundamentals are solid and don't depend on AI to cover gaps

Openness to and working familiarity with AI creative tools (image generation, AI video, AI-assisted workflows) — you've explored them, you use them selectively, and you understand their limits

Motion graphics and video production capability — concept, produce, and deliver independently

Strong understanding of marketing principles and branding — every design decision serves a purpose

Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; creative conversations and feedback feel easy, not formal

High attention to detail — you catch what's off before anyone else does

Self-directed — brief in, questions asked upfront, work delivered without hand-holding

Honest communicator — if a direction isn't working, you say so and come with a better idea



Nice to have:



Experience with AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, or equivalent) used as part of a broader creative process

UI/UX or web design experience

Photography or videography skills

Experience in a marketing team or agency environment





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our brand, our clients, our standards, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant creative latitude to shape how the brand looks, feels, and moves.

We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months: You're producing on-brand creative consistently and on time across static and motion formats. The work is clearly yours — AI may have helped, but the quality is unmistakably human. You've identified gaps in the creative library and started filling them.

At six months: Marketing campaigns have stronger visual execution than before you joined. Motion and video content is a regular part of output. You've introduced tools or workflows that made the team faster without lowering the creative bar.

At twelve months: The brand looks and feels measurably more polished. You've built systems and asset libraries that scale beyond your own output.



How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.

We're a growing MSP — not every creative process is built yet. That's part of why we need someone who brings craft and structure to the work, not just waits for direction.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You rely on AI to do all the creative thinking for you

You ship work that's technically complete but not something you're proud of

You treat brand guidelines as optional

Feedback makes you defensive rather than curious

You're not interested in learning new tools or evolving how you work

You separate craft from process — great output requires both



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Real Estate Seller Closer / Acquisition & Listing Specialist
description:
REAL ESTATE SELLER CLOSER / ACQUISITION & LISTING SPECIALIST



We are seeking an experienced **Real Estate Seller Closer** to work with warm, qualified U.S. property-owner leads and convert conversations into opportunities and deals.



**THIS IS NOT A COLD-CALLING OR APPOINTMENT-SETTING POSITION.**

### FOLLOW UP BOSS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED.  **You MUST already know how to use Follow Up Boss.**



Our prospecting and lead-generation team makes the initial contact with property owners. You will work primarily with sellers who have already expressed interest, requested information, spoken with our team, or require continued follow-up.



Your job is to own the seller conversation, uncover the seller's real motivation, discuss price and expectations, handle objections, explain available selling options, negotiate when appropriate, and move the seller toward a clear commitment.



### ABOUT OUR SELLER PROGRAMS:

We operate multiple real estate seller programs, including **Seller Options Now (SON)** and **Realty Offers Now (RON)**.



Unlike companies that offer homeowners only one solution, our business is designed to give sellers multiple ways to sell.



Depending upon the property and seller's objectives, potential solutions may include:

* Direct cash/investor purchase

* Competitive offer or accelerated-sale strategy

* Traditional real estate listing

* Competitive online sale / Offer-to-Sold strategy

* Continued nurture and follow-up when the seller is not ready today



The successful candidate must listen to the seller, understand what they're trying to accomplish, and guide the conversation toward the right solution.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Call warm and qualified seller leads

* Follow up consistently with previously contacted property owners

* Build rapport quickly with U.S. homeowners

* Determine seller motivation, timing, property condition, price expectations, and decision-making factors

* Ask strong discovery questions instead of simply reading a script

* Handle pricing objections professionally

* Discuss unrealistic seller expectations without losing rapport

* Negotiate with motivated property sellers

* Explain multiple selling options clearly and confidently

* Maintain control and direction of telephone conversations

* Ask for commitments and establish definite next steps

* Recognize when a seller should move toward a direct purchase, listing, competitive-sale solution, or continued nurture

* Maintain persistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready immediately

* Keep complete and accurate CRM notes after every conversation

* Create and manage follow-up tasks

* Maintain correct stages, tags, and pipeline status

* Communicate important opportunities to management

* Help move qualified seller opportunities from initial interest toward signed agreements and completed transactions



You should have hands-on experience using Follow Up Boss for:

* Contacts

* Notes

* Tasks

* Calling

* Text messaging

*

* Stages

* Tags

* Smart Lists

* Action Plans

* Follow-up

* Pipeline management



Please do not apply if you have never personally used Follow Up Boss.



### EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates will have previous experience with one or more of the following:

* Real estate acquisitions

* Motivated seller leads

* U.S. real estate investing

* Acquisition management

* Wholesale real estate

* Residential real estate sales

* Real estate ISA / inside sales

* Listing conversion

* Seller lead management

* High-ticket telephone sales

* Negotiation and objection handling



Experience speaking directly with U.S. property owners is strongly preferred.



You should be comfortable speaking with sellers in situations involving:

* Inherited properties

* Vacant properties

* Landlords

* Properties needing repairs

* Distressed properties

* Relocation

* Financial pressure

* Foreclosure situations

* Sellers considering a Realtor

* Sellers comparing cash offers

* Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

* Sellers who need repeated follow-up before making a decision



### THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU:

* Mainly schedule appointments

* Only have cold-calling experience

* Depend completely on a script

* Are uncomfortable discussing money

* Are afraid to challenge a seller's price expectations

* Give up after receiving an objection

* Do not follow up consistently

* Need someone to tell you every day who to call

* Fail to maintain detailed CRM records

* Have never worked with motivated property sellers



We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal.**



### COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand.



We care much more about your ability to communicate, listen, negotiate, and close than we do about having a perfect résumé.



### WORKING HOURS



You must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business and early-evening seller contact hours**.



The position is expected to begin at approximately **30 hours per week**, with the opportunity to expand based upon performance and lead volume.



### COMPENSATION

Base compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



Expected range:

**$800–$2,000 USD per month**



Exceptional candidates may qualify for additional **performance-based bonuses and transaction incentives**.

title: Creative Project Assistant
description:
Higher Education in Art Related Degree Required



I am looking for a Creative Project Assistant to support creative production tasks across different projects.



This role is mainly focused on AI image generation, visual quality control, light image editing, file preparation, and asset organisation. It is a hands-on execution role, not a senior creative strategy role.



I will provide the creative direction, references, and feedback. Your job is to help execute the workflow carefully, systematically, and with strong attention to detail.



Main Responsibilities



You will help with:



* Using AI image generation tools to create image options and variations

* Working with character references and style references

* Comparing AI-generated images against reference images

* Checking consistency in character design, colours, proportions, clothing, details, and overall style

* Running multiple rounds of edits and refinements based on feedback

* Preparing transparent PNG files for upload or use

* Removing backgrounds and cleaning up image edges

* Cropping, resizing, exporting, and renaming image files correctly

* Performing light Adobe/Canva/Figma production tasks

* Organising images, references, prompts, drafts, and final files into clear folders

* Tracking different versions, revisions, and final deliverables

* Preparing files for websites, product pages, social media, or internal review

* Creating simple comparison sheets or visual boards

* Helping prepare clear instructions for outsourced editing or design work

* Coordinating simple fixed-rate outsourced tasks when needed

* Supporting other miscellaneous creative project tasks



Light Adobe / Design Work



You should be comfortable with basic production tasks such as:



* Background removal

* Transparent PNG preparation

* Simple Photoshop touch-ups

* Cropping and resizing

* Basic colour correction

* Simple layout adjustments

* Exporting files in the correct format

* Preparing upload-ready files

* Basic Illustrator or Canva edits when needed



You do not need to be a senior graphic designer. However, you should have good visual judgement and be able to prepare clean, organised, usable files.



Requirements



The ideal candidate should have:



* Strong visual attention to detail

* Good taste and basic understanding of design theory

* Basic image editing skills

* Good file organisation habits

* Good written English

* Ability to follow detailed instructions carefully

* Ability to compare images and spot small differences

* Comfort using AI tools or willingness to learn quickly

* Reliable, organised, and systematic working style

* Patience for repetitive visual QC, editing, and file preparation work



Preferred Background



A background in any of these fields is preferred:



* Art

* Design

* Illustration

* Animation

* Visual communication

* Graphic design

* Fashion

* Media

* Photography

* Architecture



Formal education is helpful, but strong examples of visual work are more important.



Tools You May Use



You may work with tools such as:



* ChatGPT / GPT image generation

* Claude

* Milanote

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Canva

* Figma

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Background removal tools

* Other AI image or editing tools



You do not need to know every tool already, but you should be able to learn new tools quickly.



What This Role Is



This role is for someone who enjoys visual production, organisation, and careful execution.



You will help generate, edit, compare, organise, and prepare creative assets. A big part of the role is making sure images match the provided character and style references, and that final files are clean, properly named, and ready to use.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a senior creative director role.

This is not a pure admin virtual assistant role.

This is not a pure graphic design role.

This is not just prompt writing.

This is not a strategy role.



This is a mixed creative support role focused on AI image generation, visual QC, light Adobe production, file preparation, and organised execution**.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your creative or education background

3. Examples of design, illustration, editing, AI image, or visual work

4. Tools you are comfortable using

5. Your experience with AI image generation tools, if any

6. Your experience with Photoshop, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

7. Your availability and preferred working hours

8. Confirmation that you are comfortable with repetitive image QC, file organisation, and editing tasks



Please start your application with:



Creative Project Assistant Application

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry/e-com brand through animated AI series' and worldbuilding. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — guidance provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.
