title: LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement
description:
About Founders & Funders



Founders & Funders is a growing community that brings together high-potential founders, venture capital firms, and strategic partners through curated events, meaningful introductions, and relationship-driven experiences. We are looking for an experienced **LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement** who can help us identify, engage, and invite the right founders to our events.



This is not simply a high-volume outreach role. We need someone who understands how to find qualified founders, create communications that feel personal and relevant, and build outreach systems that consistently generate strong responses and event registrations.



What You’ll Own



Founder Research and Targeting

- Identify founders who match the specific criteria, audience, and goals of each event.

- Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, databases, AI tools, and other research platforms.

- Evaluate founder quality based on factors such as company stage, revenue, funding, industry, location, and overall event fit.

- Continuously improve targeting strategies based on registration quality and campaign performance.



LinkedIn Outreach and Engagement

- Create personalized LinkedIn outreach campaigns that capture founders’ attention and encourage meaningful responses.

- Write creative invitations, follow-ups, and engagement sequences that feel warm, relevant, and human.

- Adapt messaging for different founder segments, industries, funding stages, and event formats.

- Engage prospects through both automated and manual outreach while maintaining a high level of personalization.

- Build genuine relationships with founders—not simply send connection requests or generic messages.



Automation, AI, and Campaign Systems

- Use LinkedIn outreach and automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools to build and manage campaigns.

- Use AI strategically for research, personalization, message development, segmentation, and campaign optimization.

- Create repeatable outreach workflows that allow the team to scale without sacrificing message quality.

- Monitor platform limitations and LinkedIn best practices to maintain account safety and campaign effectiveness.

- Test new tools, systems, and approaches that can improve founder acquisition.



Lead Generation and Performance

- Own outreach performance from prospect identification through registration.

- Track key metrics such as connection acceptance, response rate, qualified conversations, registrations, approvals, and attendance.

- Run regular message and campaign tests to improve results.

- Identify why campaigns are performing well or underperforming and recommend solutions.

- Provide clear updates on results, challenges, learnings, and next steps.



Leadership and Team Development

- Help establish outreach standards, processes, templates, and best practices.

- Coach and support other team members involved in founder research and outreach.

- Review outreach quality and help the team improve targeting, messaging, and follow-up.

- Take increasing ownership of the overall founder outreach strategy as the organization grows.

- Develop into a future leader who can eventually manage and strengthen the Founder Outreach team.



What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience in LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, founder acquisition, business development, or a related role.

- Advanced knowledge of LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Experience using LinkedIn automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of outreach automation, AI-assisted workflows, CRM systems, and lead-generation platforms.

- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create communications that are engaging, personalized, and not overly sales-driven.

- Experience building and optimizing multi-step outreach campaigns.

- Strong research skills and the ability to distinguish qualified prospects from high-volume lists.

- Comfortable working with performance metrics and making decisions based on campaign data.

- Highly organized, resourceful, proactive, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once.

- Strong judgment when balancing automation with thoughtful, human engagement.

- Leadership potential and a genuine interest in coaching others and improving team performance.



What Success Looks Like

- We consistently attract the right founders for each event—not simply more registrations.

- Outreach messages generate strong connection, response, and conversion rates.

- Founder communications feel personal, thoughtful, and aligned with the F&F brand.

- Campaigns are organized, measurable, and continuously improving.

- The team has clear outreach processes, templates, reporting, and quality standards.

- You grow from a hands-on outreach expert into a strategic leader who can help build and manage the function.



Ideal Candidate

- You are both creative and analytical. You know how to write a message that gets a founder’s attention, but you also understand targeting, automation, conversion metrics, and campaign strategy.

- You are not looking for a role where you simply execute a list of daily tasks. You want to take ownership, improve systems, contribute ideas, coach others, and grow into a leadership position as Founders & Funders continues to expand.

title: DROPSHIPPING SUPPLY CHAIN & QUALITY CONTROL SPECIALIST
description:
Starting Salary: $600 USD/month

Salary Review After 3 Months Based on Performance

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced dropshipping operations specialist to manage product quality, supplier communication, inventory problems, customer feedback, and supplier billing.

You will work directly with our Chinese suppliers through 1688 and communicate daily with our Customer Service and Operations teams.

Your main goal is to make sure:

The product we advertise = The product the supplier ships = The product the customer receives.

When something doesn't match, you find out why and take action.

This is an experienced position, not a training position.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

PRODUCT & QUALITY CONTROL

You will constantly check and track the products we are selling and advertising.

You will identify:

Quality problems

Wrong sizes

Wrong colors

Wrong variants

Damaged products

Product changes

Differences between our product images and the actual product

Repeated customer complaints

Products causing excessive refunds or chargebacks

When you find a problem, you investigate it and communicate with the supplier immediately.

QUALITY CONTROL SHEET

You will maintain our Quality Control Sheet every day.

This is where we track the products we are currently running and important information about each product.

You will make sure information such as:

Supplier

1688 link

Product photos

Real product photos

Sizes

Colors

Variants

Product quality

Inventory

Supplier changes

Product issues

Resolutions

is always accurate and up to date.

If something changes, you update it.

SUPPLIER COMMUNICATION

You will communicate with suppliers in China every day.

You must be comfortable using 1688 and communicating directly with suppliers.

You will ask suppliers about:

Stock

Quality

Pricing

Sizes

Colors

Variants

Product changes

Photos

Replacements

Fulfillment

Alternative products

Alternative suppliers

You need to be comfortable following up repeatedly when necessary.

CUSTOMER SERVICE FEEDBACK

You will communicate closely with our Customer Service team.

They will provide you with feedback about:

Product complaints

Quality issues

Sizing problems

Color problems

Damaged products

Wrong products

Refunds

Replacements

Chargebacks

Repeated customer complaints

You need to identify patterns quickly.

If multiple customers are complaining about the same product, you investigate immediately and contact the supplier.

The goal is to solve the problem before it becomes a bigger problem for the company.

OUT-OF-STOCK PRODUCTS

When a product becomes unavailable:

Contact the supplier.

Confirm the inventory situation.

Look for alternative suppliers if necessary.

Check the alternative product and quality.

Inform the appropriate team.

Update the Quality Control Sheet.

Follow up until the issue is resolved.

We don't want someone who simply reports:

"It's out of stock."

We want someone who asks:

"What is our best solution?"

SUPPLIER BILLING

Every week, you will review supplier invoices.

You will compare supplier billing against our records and look for:

Incorrect prices

Incorrect quantities

Duplicate charges

Missing orders

Replacement charges

Shipping charges

Other discrepancies

If something doesn't match, you investigate it with the supplier and report it.

You are responsible for catching billing mistakes before they cost the company money.

THE TYPE OF PERSON WE NEED

We are looking for someone who is:

FAST

You take action immediately when something needs attention.

ORGANIZED

You can manage many products, suppliers, issues, and follow-ups without losing track.

A FAST LEARNER

You understand new products and processes quickly.

DETAIL-ORIENTED

You notice small differences that other people might miss.

PERSISTENT

You keep following up until the problem is actually solved.

PROACTIVE

You don't wait for someone to tell you there is a problem.

CONSISTENT

You maintain accurate information every day.

RESPONSIBLE

When you take ownership of something, you follow it through.

RESILIENT

You can handle several problems at once and stay focused.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

You must have:

2+ years of dropshipping experience

Shopify dropshipping experience

Experience working with Chinese suppliers

1688 experience

Product quality-control experience

Supplier communication experience

Experience handling inventory problems

Experience with fulfillment issues

Experience with refunds and replacements

Experience reviewing supplier invoices

Google Sheets experience

Strong English communication

Excellent attention to detail

If you have never worked in dropshipping, please do not apply.

If you have never worked with Chinese suppliers or 1688, please do not apply.

We are looking for someone who can already understand this type of operation.

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

You have no dropshipping experience.

You have less than 2 years of relevant experience.

You have never used 1688.

You have never communicated directly with suppliers.

You need basic training.

You are not comfortable solving problems independently.

You are slow to take action.

You are not highly organized.

You don't pay attention to details.

You don't like following up with suppliers.

You are looking for an easy administrative job.

You are looking for short-term employment.

SALARY & GROWTH

Starting Salary: $600 USD/month

After 3 months, we will review your performance.

Your salary can increase based on:

Performance

Accuracy

Speed

Reliability

Initiative

Problem-solving

Consistency

Additional responsibilities

Contribution to the company

We want to build a long-term team.

If you become more skilled and more valuable to the company, your compensation can grow with you.

APPLICATION

Use the subject:

DROPSHIPPING SUPPLY CHAIN – [Your Name]

Please answer all questions.

1. How many years have you worked in dropshipping? What were your main responsibilities?

2. How long have you used 1688? What did you personally use it for?

3. A product is receiving multiple complaints about sizing. What would you do?

4. A supplier suddenly changes the quality of a product that we are actively advertising. What is your process?

5. A product is out of stock. What are the first three actions you take?

6. You find that a supplier's weekly invoice is higher than our records. What do you do?

7. Tell us about a real supplier or product problem you personally solved.

8. How do you organize your daily work when you have many products and problems to manage?

9. What do you believe is the most important quality for someone working in dropshipping operations?

IMPORTANT

We are looking for someone who understands that this job is not simply about checking spreadsheets.

It's about:

Finding problems ? Taking action ? Communicating ? Following up ? Solving ? Documenting.

If you already have real dropshipping experience and you're fast, organized, persistent, detail-oriented, and comfortable working directly with Chinese suppliers, this could be a long-term opportunity for you.

title: Senior Accountant — NetSuite / Multi-Entity
description:
Senior Accountant with multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience in a multi-entity environment, joining an established accounting team at an energy industry company. Immediate-start contract, 2–3 months, extension possible. Remote, full-time, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific.





Summary

Senior Accountant — NetSuite, Multi-Entity Contract (2–3 months, extension possible) · Remote · Full-time, US Pacific hours · Immediate start



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote US accounting, tax, and fractional CFO firm. We are staffing a Senior Accountant for a client in the energy industry that runs NetSuite across a multi-entity structure.



The client has an established accounting department of roughly eight onshore staff. This role is additional capacity alongside that team — you will be working within their existing close process, standards, and review structure rather than building or running your own.



This is a hands-on production seat. You will be in NetSuite every day.



Scope

The exact task mix is being finalized as we determine which work moves to this role. It will draw from across the close cycle rather than sitting in one corner of the system, so what matters is that you can be handed any core piece of NetSuite.



You should have working command of, at minimum:



General ledger — journal entries, recurring and memorized entries, accruals, prepaids, allocation schedules

Period close — Period Close Checklist, A/P and A/R sub-period locking versus GL close, post-close corrections

Accounts payable — vendor bills, bill credits, payment runs, vendor records

Accounts receivable — invoicing, customer payments, credit memos, aging and collections

Banking and reconciliation — bank feeds and statement imports, account reconciliation, deposits, undeposited funds

Multi-subsidiary and consolidation — subsidiary hierarchy, intercompany transactions, eliminations, consolidated reporting

Segmentation — subsidiary, class, department, location, and custom segments, and when each should be used

Fixed assets — asset records, depreciation schedules, disposals

Reporting — standard financials, report customization, and saved searches (criteria, results, and formula fields)

System fundamentals — roles and permissions, audit trail and system notes, record hierarchy



Beyond the mechanics, we expect you to reconcile what you touch, document your workpapers so they stand on their own, and raise misclassifications, duplicates, and control gaps when you find them rather than booking around them.



Requirements

Multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience as a preparer — not a report consumer

Genuine multi-entity experience: multiple subsidiaries, intercompany activity, consolidated reporting

Strong month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation discipline

Advanced Excel at a workpaper-building level — pivots, lookups, clean tie-outs

Comfortable working in the Microsoft 365 environment — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint / OneDrive

Able to work effectively inside an established team: take direction, follow existing conventions, and communicate status without being chased

Written English strong enough to document your own work and escalate an issue clearly

Availability for the full US Pacific business day, Monday through Friday

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, a backup connection and power plan, and a private workspace



Nice to have

BS Accountancy; CPA or CPA candidate

Experience in energy, utilities, power generation, or another capital-intensive industry

Project or job costing experience

Prior experience supporting a US-based accounting department



Details

Independent contractor engaged directly by Bridged Financial Solutions

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Initial term of 2–3 months with an immediate start; extension possible

Compensation: competitive, depending on experience

You provide your own equipment; we provide all software access

NDA and background check required before any client data access





Three to five sentences on the largest multi-entity NetSuite environment you have worked in — number of subsidiaries, currencies, and what you personally owned in the close

Your expected hourly rate (USD) and earliest start date



Applications missing #2 will not be reviewed.



B. Screening questions

Questions

1) What NetSuite role did you hold (Accountant / Controller / Administrator / custom)? Could you post journal entries and close periods yourself?

Separates preparers from people who ran reports out of someone else's instance.

2) In the largest environment you worked in: how many subsidiaries, how many currencies, and was it NetSuite OneWorld?

The single highest-value filter. A meaningful share of applicants describe several separate QuickBooks files as "multi-entity."

3) Can you commit to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday, for the next three months? What other engagements would you be working around?

Moonlighting on top of an existing full-time job is the most common failure mode on contract hires.

4) Which of the following have you personally worked in: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, fixed assets, intercompany/eliminations, saved searches?

Breadth check, since the scope isn't fixed. Gaps aren't automatically disqualifying — clustering in only one or two is.

5) Describe the accounting team you last worked in. How many people, and where did your work go for review?

This role slots into an eight-person department. You want someone used to a review chain, not a sole-charge operator.

6) What is your internet speed, and what is your backup for outages?

7) Expected hourly rate in USD?





Technical screen 

1. "Walk me through your month-end close in NetSuite, day one to sign-off."



2. "How does NetSuite handle intercompany? Take one transaction from origination through elimination." 



3. "What's the difference between closing a period and locking a period? What do you do when a correction is needed after close?"



4. "Describe a saved search you built and why a standard report wouldn't do it.



5. "Tell me about a balance sheet account that wouldn't reconcile. How did you find the break?" 



6. "How do you d
 whether something should be tracked by class, department, location, or a custom segment?" 



7. "You're new to a team that already has its own way of doing things, and you think one of their reconciliation schedules is wrong. What do you do?"

title: PROFESSIONAL SERVICE FIRM PRACTICE MANAGER| Remote
description:
ABOUT US



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote boutique accounting, tax, and advisory firm. We serve a growing client base across tax preparation, fractional CFO engagements, bookkeeping, and back-office operations. Our team of 10 operates with a high degree of autonomy on a cloud-first stack. We are lean, fast-moving, and hold ourselves to institutional-quality standards.



---



THE ROLE



This is not a VA role. We are hiring a Practice Manager who will own the operational backbone of the firm.



You will serve as the connective tissue between the principal, the client service team, and our clients. You will work closely with our Accounting Senior Manager to coordinate production workflows, ensure clean handoffs, and keep the team running on schedule. You will hold the team accountable, manage day-to-day operations, own the client-facing operational experience, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



If you are a systems thinker who gets energy from bringing order to complexity, building repeatable processes, and taking full ownership of your domain — this role was built for you.



---



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Practice Operations

- Own the firm's production workflow — task management, client deadlines, team accountability, and monthly close tracking

- Monitor team workloads and flag capacity issues before they become problems

- Maintain and improve SOPs for recurring firm processes

- Serve as the internal escalation point for operational questions before they reach the principal



Client Experience

- Manage client-facing communications for operational matters — status updates, document requests, portal guidance

- Own the client onboarding workflow from proposal acceptance through first deliverable

- Ensure clients receive a consistent, professional experience regardless of which tea
mber is serving them



Team Coordination

- Collaborate closely with the Accounting Senior Manager on workflow coordination and cross-functional handoffs

- Run a weekly internal ops check-in — agenda, notes, follow-up tracking

- Hold tea
mbers accountable to deadlines without requiring principal involvement

- Support onboarding of new tea
mbers on firm tools and workflows



Billing and Admin

- Support the billing workflow — engagement tracking, renewal reminders, exception flags

- Manage recurring admin tasks: calendar coordination, document organization, file hygiene

- Track client engagement status and surface issues to the principal proactively



---



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- 3+ years in an operations, practice management, or senior administrative role — professional services or accounting-adjacent preferred

- Experience managing workflow tools at a team level (not just personal task management)

- Strong written English — you will represent the firm externally

- High accountability orientation — you follow up, you close loops, you do not wait to be reminded

- Comfortable operating with autonomy and making judgment calls independently



Strongly Preferred

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online

- Experience with proposal or billing platforms (Ignition or similar)

- Prior experience supporting a CPA, fractional CFO, or accounting firm

- Exposure to US-based professional services environments



This role is NOT for you if:

- You need detailed daily direction to prioritize your work

- You treat "it wasn't on my list" as a valid reason for something falling through the cracks

- You confuse task completion with problem ownership

- You are looking for a light VA role with limited responsibility



---



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Double (practice management), QuickBooks Online, Ignition, Google Workspace, Slack



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Day 30: Full command of our tools and workflows. Independently managing daily ops and team task tracking. Client portal responsiveness maintained without principal involvement.



Day 60: SOPs documented for at least 3 recurring firm processes. Weekly ops cadence running on autopilot. First billing cycle fully supported without escalations.



Day 90: Principal's operational involvement reduced by 50%+. Practice Manager is the first point of contact for all team operational questions. At least one workflow improvement identified and implemented.



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you must complete the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:



1. Complete the DISC assessment on OnlineJobs.ph and include your results with your application.



2. Answer this question in 150–300 words:



"Describe a time you identified a process that was breaking down in your team or organization. What specifically was failing, what did you do about it, and what was the result?"



Do not use AI to write your answer for you — we can tell the difference, and it will disqualify your application. We are looking for your actual thinking, not polished filler.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter / HR Specialist | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



You're not just filling seats. You're protecting the standard every hire either raises or lowers.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This is not a transactional recruiting role.



We're looking for an Executive Recruiter who operates as both a strategic hiring partner and trusted advisor — to clients, to leadership, and to the candidates moving through the process. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles while supporting the HR operations that keep the internal team running well.



You'll work directly with clients to understand their business and what a great hire looks like — then go build it. The judgment calls you make directly shape the teams clients trust us to build. We need someone who takes that seriously.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best recruiters we've worked with share a few traits:



They protect the bar. When a candidate is almost right, they don't talk themselves into a yes — they know a weak hire is never the safe option, just a delayed and more expensive problem.



They're honest even when it costs them. If a role brief is unclear, they push back. If a candidate isn't the right fit, they say so — directly, kindly, and early.



They're genuinely curious. They don't run the same interviewscript for every role — they study the business, ask questions other recruiters miss, and keep getting sharper at reading people over time.



They build systems, not just pipelines. Every hiring cycle produces something better than the last — tighter screening, cleaner processes, sharper evaluation criteria.



Who Thrives Here



People who care deeply about quality — in who they hire, in how they advise clients, and in how they work. You find satisfaction in identifying the right person. You take it personally when a weak candidate slips through. You're organized, direct, and comfortable making judgment calls without needing consensus.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is built yet. For the right person, that's the opportunity to build the systems that scale with the business, not just manage what already exists.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where clients need to hire well across multiple roles, industries, and seniority levels — and where the quality of every hire reflects directly on our company.



That looks like:



Managing full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles — from intake through offer, owning every step



Leading intake calls with clients — understanding their business, pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough to hire well against, and providing strategic hiring recommendations when needed



Proactively sourcing and headhunting candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networks, and AI-powered tools — not waiting for applications



Conducting structured interviews that assess mindset, ownership, communication, and cultural fit — not just credentials



Presenting candidates with clear, honest hiring recommendations so clients make better decisions faster



Writing and posting culture-fit job descriptions across all platforms that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones



Supporting HR operations — onboarding, contractor documentation, records management, and internal policy compliance



Tracking recruitment metrics and pipeline health — surfacing what's working and what needs to change



Building and improving recruitment SOPs, interview guides, scorecards, and onboarding checklists



Using AI tools to accelerate sourcing, screening, and communication without cutting corners on quality



What We're Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; clients and candidates always feel heard



Strong full-cycle recruitment experience — executive, technical, and specialized roles across multiple clients or industries



Proven client communication and stakeholder management skills — you run intake calls, push back on vague briefs, and advise with confidence



Sharp interviewing and candidate assessment ability — you probe for specifics and can tell the difference between someone who sounds good and someone who actually is



Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent) — daily use, not occasional



Strong proactive sourcing and headhunting skills — you build pipelines, you don't wait for them



Proficiency in ATS platforms and HR tools (Workable, ClickUp, or equivalent)



High integrity and sound judgment — honest calls, confidential information handled without exceptions



Self-directed once you understand the environment — but asks the right questions early



Nice to Have



Experience in executive search, agency recruitment, or outsourcing environments



Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how we hire, our clients, our tools, and how the business operates. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant latitude to shape how we hire and build the team.



We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months:



You've run multiple full-cycle searches end-to-end. Your candidate assessments are sharp, honest, and already what leadership and clients rely on. You know the business well enough to push back on a vague brief.



At six months:



Hiring is faster and more consistent. JDs are stronger. Screening is tighter. Onboarding is more structured. Recruitment metrics are visible and being used to improve the process.



At twelve months:



We hire better because of the systems you built. Weak candidates don't make it through. Strong ones move quickly. Clients trust your judgment — and we're investing in your continued growth.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You treat hiring as a numbers game — more applications, faster fills



You talk yourself into candidates who are almost right because the pipeline is thin



You present candidates without a clear, honest recommendation behind them



You need a fully built system handed to you



You're uncomfortable pushing back on clients or leadership when the direction isn't right



You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't intend to start



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

?

title: Client & Marketing Operations Coordinator (WordPress, SEO, GoHighLevel)
description:
Client & Marketing Operations Coordinator (WordPress, SEO, GoHighLevel)

Client support, membership site, publishing operations, and SEO



Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | Permanent | Semi-flexible schedule



ABOUT US



We are a small remote North American company providing online education and coaching programs. We run a YouTube channel with over 400k subscribers, deliver live events, maintain a client membership site, and publish written content on an ongoing schedule. Our team is long-tenured. This is an in-house seat: one company, one stack, permanent, not agency or client-rotation work.



THE ROLE



You keep two things running: our clients' experience of working with us, and the systems underneath it. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week.



On the client side, logistical questions get answered the same business day, sessions get booked and rescheduled without friction, and the recordings and materials our clients paid for reach them when they expect them. When something needs judgment rather than logistics, you route it to the right person rather than guessing.



On the publishing side, our marketing content goes out on schedule: social posts loaded and verified live,
s scheduled and sent, articles published to the websites. Whatever our team and outside partners produce, you get it out correctly and confirm it landed. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week.



Creative and build work is produced by our senior team and outside partners. Your work starts where theirs ends.



Day to day, you will:

• Resolve client logistics in our support inbox: scheduling, session links, reschedules, sending recordings, and access issues, using our documented reply guides

• Escalate anything that calls for judgment rather than logistics, routed to the right person on our team using our documented rules

• Manage our session and events calendar end to end: booking, rescheduling, cancelling, and rebooking through our approved process

• Administer our client membership site: recording uploads, content updates, member access, and setup for each new session

• Onboard and offboard clients to our checklist: access, calendar, and enrollment set up correctly at the start, and closed out cleanly at the end

• Load our weekly social publishing schedule from prepared asset packages across our platforms, write captions from our documented guides, and verify daily that every post actually published

• Assemble and send our weekly client
 and announcements from finished drafts, and load approved campaign sequences in GoHighLevel, verifying every send before it goes out

• Publish finished articles to WordPress and to our external article publishing platforms, applying our SEO specification to every website post and confirming it renders correctly

• Receive deliverables from our outside partners, check them against spec, and queue them

• Execute our SEO update plan across the existing site and content, to a written specification

• Make small updates to existing GoHighLevel pages, load approved
 sequences and broadcasts, and improve existing automations alongside our operations manager

• Monitor automation alerts, run first diagnosis, and escalate with a written report

• Collect weekly performance metrics across our platforms and prepare them for reporting



What success looks like in 90 days.

• Client logistics resolved same business day

• Every scheduled post verified as published, with any failure reported by you before anyone else notices

• The membership site current within 1 business day of any release

• Client
s and weekly articles out on schedule, every week

• The SEO update specification executed at 25 URLs per month



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



There are no full funnel builds, no graphic design, no video editing, no long-form copywriting, and no sales. Marketing content arrives already written. You load, format, send, and verify. Social media here means scheduling and verification, not content creation. If you are looking for a pure development seat or a creative seat, this is not it. The technical lane in this role is real, and it grows out of operations excellence.



WHO YOU ARE



• A technical foundation: a computer science, engineering, or related technical degree, or equivalent professional or self-taught depth. We can train depth in WordPress, GoHighLevel, and our other tools on the job, so specific tool experience is not required. Picking up new technical systems quickly, from documentation, is. Shown one worked example, you can produce the next twenty without constantly checking in.  

• An improvement habit. You understand tech and tools well enough to see where a process is weak, and you propose the fix rather than working around it. 

• Professional written English. Your writing goes to clients.

• Precision on repetitive, structured work. You follow checklists exactly, and you flag when a checklist is wrong.

• A verification habit. You confirm your output is live and you log it. "Scheduled" and "published" are different states to you.

• Proactive written communication. Blockers, anomalies, and your own mistakes surface early, from you. If you need to be chased, this will not be a good fit.



GROWTH



Promotion here follows demonstrated strength, and we have promoted from within before. Consistent precision in the core work earns expanded technical scope: building new automation workflows and pages under review, rather than only maintaining and optimizing existing ones.



COMPENSATION AND TERMS



$650 USD per month. Full-time and exclusive: we ask that this be your only professional commitment, and any current freelance clients or part-time work must be disclosed in your application. Semi-flexible schedule with 4 hours of overlap with North American Pacific business hours. Daily and weekly verification checkpoints are fixed.



APPLICATION PROCESS



1) Application review; 2) a live video interview with your camera on (no exceptions); 3) a paid trial task, 4) and a final interview. Identity and reference verification are completed before any offer.



TO APPLY



Send your CV with the subject line exactly: Application: Operations Coordinator (Verified)



In your message, answer these four questions:



1. Describe a process you ran for months without errors, and how you tracked that it stayed error-free.

2. Describe a mistake you caught that nobody else had noticed. What did you do next?

3. Describe something technical you taught yourself from documentation. What did you build or fix with it, and what part of the documentation was wrong or missing?

4. What does an ideal work week look like for you? 



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed.

title: Golf Video Editor | YouTube, Shot Tracers & Motion Graphics
description:
Long Term Golf Video Editor



We’re looking for an experienced GOLF video editor to join our team long term.



This position is specifically for someone who understands golf content and knows how to turn on course footage into polished, engaging YouTube videos and short form content.



This is not a basic social media editing position.



We need someone who understands golf, storytelling, pacing, shot tracers, score graphics, motion graphics, sound design, and cinematic editing.



Editing Style



You should be familiar with content from:



* Bryson DeChambeau

* Grant Horvat

* Adventures in Golf / Erik Anders Lang

* Skratch

* No Laying Up

* Peter Finch

* Rick Shiels



Our content can move between two different styles.



On Course Golf Content



Think Bryson DeChambeau or Grant Horvat.



* Golf matches and challenges

* Playing famous courses

* Hole by hole storytelling

* Shot tracers

* Yardages

* Club selections

* Score graphics

* Hole information

* Reactions

* Golf specific sound design

* Drone footage

* B Roll between shots



Cinematic Golf Films



Think Adventures in Golf, Skratch, and No Laying Up.



These videos focus more on:



* The golf course

* Course history

* Travel

* Architecture

* The overall experience

* Cinematic B Roll

* Drone footage

* Natural sound

* Music

* Storytelling

* Interviews and talking heads



You need to understand when a video should feel energetic and when the footage needs room to breathe.



Golf Editing Experience



Golf editing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand the natural flow of a golf video without needing every edit explained to you.



For example:



Tee shot ? tracer ? reaction ? second shot ? course B Roll ? approach ? putt ? score update ? next hole.



You should understand basic golf terminology and what viewers care about during a round.



Actually playing golf is a major plus.



Shot Tracers



This is extremely important.



You must be able to create professional looking:



* Ball tracers

* Shot tracers

* Curved shot shapes

* Drives

* Approach shot tracers

* Drone shot tracers when appropriate



The tracer needs to accurately follow the golf ball and shot shape.



We do not want random lines drawn into the sky.



Please provide examples of golf tracers you have personally created.



Golf Motion Graphics



You should be capable of creating clean, modern golf graphics such as:



* Hole number

* Par

* Yardage

* Player score

* Current score to par

* Club selection

* Shot distance

* Carry distance

* Pin location

* Hole maps

* Course maps

* Leaderboards

* Scorecards

* Lower thirds

* Animated typography

* Simple course information graphics



Think professional golf broadcast graphics mixed with modern YouTube golf content.



Nothing cheesy, outdated, or unnecessarily flashy.



Storytelling



We do not want someone who simply cuts clips together.



You should be able to watch footage and recognize:



“This shot needs more buildup.”



“This reaction should stay in.”



“We need B Roll here.”



“This hole is dragging.”



“This drone shot would establish the next hole.”



“This music doesn’t match the scene.”



“This moment needs natural sound instead of music.”



You should be helping build the story, not waiting for instructions on every cut.



Sound Design



Sound design is extremely important.



You should know how to use:



* Golf ball impacts

* Club sounds

* Natural course ambience

* Birds and wind

* Crowd reactions when applicable

* Dialogue

* Subtle risers

* Transitions

* Music

* Sound effects



The goal is immersion, not adding a sound effect every three seconds.



Cinematic Editing



We shoot high quality footage including:



* Sony cameras

* Sony S Log3

* DJI drones

* Multiple camera angles

* Slow motion

* Course B Roll

* Talking heads

* On course audio



You should know how to combine these into a polished golf film.



Color grading experience with Sony S Log3 and DJI footage is a major plus.



We prefer natural, premium looking color instead of aggressive LUTs.



Types of Content



Projects may include:



* Golf course documentaries

* Playing famous golf courses

* Golf challenges

* On course matches

* Course reviews

* Golf travel films

* Golf resort videos

* Equipment testing

* Golf product reviews

* Brand campaigns

* YouTube videos

* Reels

* Shorts

* TikToks



Most importantly, you need to understand golf content.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has professional video editing experience

* Understands golf

* Can create accurate shot tracers

* Can create golf specific motion graphics

* Understands long form YouTube storytelling

* Understands cinematic pacing

* Has strong sound design skills

* Can work with drone footage

* Can organize large amounts of footage

* Pays attention to small details

* Can take feedback without needing every change explained

* Wants consistent long term editing work



Portfolio Requirements



Please send your best relevant examples, especially:



1. Golf videos you have edited

2. Videos containing golf shot tracers

3. Golf motion graphics or score graphics

4. Long form YouTube videos

5. Cinematic or documentary style work



Do not send 20 random editing examples.



We would rather see 3 excellent, relevant projects than a large generic portfolio.



If you have never edited golf content, be upfront about it.



Application Instructions



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words:



“Grand Geneva”



If your application does not start with Grand Geneva, it will not be reviewed.



Then answer:



1. Link your portfolio.

2. Send your best golf video edit.

3. Send an example of a golf shot tracer you created.

4. What golf creators have you edited for, if any?

5. Do you personally play or follow golf?

6. What editing software do you use?

7. What software or method do you use for shot tracers?

8. Are you experienced with After Effects or similar motion graphics software?

9. How many years have you been editing?

10. How many hours are you available each week?

11. What is your expected hourly rate?

12. Which golf creator or golf channel best represents your editing style and why?



Skills Required



* Video Editing

* Golf Video Editing

* YouTube Video Editing

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Adobe After Effects

* Motion Graphics

* Shot Tracers

* Sound Design

* Color Grading

* Storytelling

* Short Form Video Editing



This is intended to become a long term position for the right editor.

title: Direct Response Video Editor | Graphics, Captions & Typography
description:
We’re looking for a high level video editor who knows how to take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content that keeps people watching.



Most of the videos we produce are between 2 and 5 minutes long.



These are longer form performance advertisements, talking head videos and direct response creatives where pacing and retention matter from the first second to the final CTA.



We need someone who understands that strong editing is more than cutting out pauses.



You should know how to use pacing, graphics, captions, typography, B roll, sound design and visual changes to keep a 2 to 5 minute video engaging without making it feel chaotic or overedited.



We’re especially interested in editors with a strong eye for graphic design and typography.



If your work feels clean, intentional and visually polished, we want to see it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit 2 to 5 minute direct response and performance videos

* Edit talking head and scripted footage

* Clean up mistakes, pauses and unnecessary sections

* Create strong pacing and maintain retention throughout the entire video

* Design and animate on screen graphics

* Create clean, engaging captions

* Use typography creatively to emphasize important ideas

* Add B roll and supporting visuals

* Create callouts, charts, screenshots and visual explanations

* Use punch ins, reframing and camera changes strategically

* Add music and sound design where appropriate

* Clean and balance audio

* Color correct footage

* Follow established branding while still bringing your own creative ideas

* Take feedback and turn revisions around efficiently



YOU’RE PROBABLY A GREAT FIT IF...



* You have experience editing videos in the 2 to 5 minute range

* You understand pacing, attention and viewer retention

* You know how to keep a video visually engaging beyond the first 30 seconds

* Your graphics look professionally designed and not like default templates

* You have a strong eye for typography, spacing, hierarchy and composition

* You know when captions should be subtle and when they should become part of the visual storytelling

* You understand how to use B roll without throwing random stock footage over every sentence

* You can create motion graphics that make ideas easier to understand

* You notice small details in timing, audio, alignment and animation

* You’re comfortable working in Adobe Premiere Pro

* Experience with After Effects is a major plus

* You can follow creative direction without needing every edit spelled out for you

* You’re organized and can manage projects with multiple assets, graphics and revisions

* You’re receptive to feedback and constantly trying to improve your work



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to operate editing software.



We care about taste.



We care about pacing.



We care about retention.



We care about whether your graphics actually improve the video.



We care about whether your typography looks intentional.



We care about whether you know when to add something visually and when to let the footage breathe.



A great editor understands how all of those decisions work together to keep someone watching for the full 2 to 5 minutes.



WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You’ll work alongside our creative and marketing team on a variety of performance driven video projects.



We move quickly, communicate directly and expect editors to take ownership of their work.



You’ll receive footage, scripts, brand assets and creative direction when needed, but we also want someone who can look at a section of a video and come up with a stronger visual solution on their own.



We want editors who are interested in becoming significantly better at their craft and want to grow with a team producing a high volume of creative.



PAID EDITING TEST



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test.



We’ll provide the footage and creative direction.



The purpose of the test is to see how you approach:



* Pacing

* Viewer retention

* Graphics

* Captions

* Typography

* B roll

* Sound design

* Visual storytelling

* Overall polish



We want to see your creative judgment, not just whether you can follow instructions.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



* Your portfolio

* Your 2 to 3 BEST examples of videos between approximately 2 and 5 minutes that you personally edited

* Links directly to the videos whenever possible

* Examples that showcase strong graphics, captions and typography

* A short explanation of exactly what you handled on each project

* The editing software you primarily use

* Your availability during US business hours



Please prioritize examples that show you can maintain strong pacing and visual interest for several minutes.



Short form reels and TikToks are fine to include as additional work, but we specifically want to see examples that demonstrate your ability to edit longer 2 to 5 minute videos.



Include the word LONGFORM somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire posting.

description:

Someone who thinks about what a business decision-maker actually cares about.

And someone who's comfortable saying:

"I understand the direction, but I think there's a stronger angle. Here's what I'd recommend and why."

If that's how you approach copywriting, we'd like to hear from you.



About US

We are a US-based managed IT and cybersecurity company serving small and midsize businesses.

Technology and cybersecurity can become complicated quickly. Our job is to make those subjects relevant and understandable to the business leaders we serve.

That's where you come in.

We're building a stronger, more consistent voice for our IT Services company and are looking for a copywriter who wants to have meaningful influence over how we communicate with the market.

Your core mission is simple:

Find the right message, then find the right words.



What You'll Do

You'll help develop the messaging and write the copy behind our marketing and sales efforts.

You'll be expected to understand the objective behind an assignment, research the audience and subject matter, identify compelling messaging opportunities, and turn those insights into persuasive copy.

You won't simply execute every idea you're given.

If you believe there's a stronger message, angle, hook, offer, or approach, we expect you to tell us and explain why.



Messaging Strategy

You'll:

	• Develop messaging angles based on the audience, objective, offer, and customer problem.

	• Identify customer pain points, desires, objections, motivations, and desired outcomes.

	• Recommend stronger messaging when you believe the initial direction can be improved.

	• Explain the reasoning behind your messaging and copy recommendations.

	• Develop value propositions, hooks, headlines, offers, and calls-to-action.

	• Adapt messaging for different audiences and stages of the buyer journey.

	• Help refine and maintain our messaging, positioning, and brand voice.

	• Recognize when messaging is too technical, generic, vague, feature-focused, or company-centered.



Copywriting

Depending on the project, you may write:

	• Website and landing-page copy

	• Cold and outbound
s

	•
 campaigns and nurture sequences

	• Newsletters

	• Social media copy

	• Digital and print advertising

	• Direct-mail campaigns

	• Brochures and one-sheets

	• Sales collateral

	• Lead magnets and guides

	• Case studies and customer stories

	• Blog and educational content

	• Video scripts

	• Event and webinar promotional copy

	• Presentation messaging

	• Sales and proposal messaging

	• Headlines, taglines, offers, and calls-to-action

	• Other marketing and sales copy as needed



Research & Message Discovery

Good copy starts with good research.

You'll be expected to:

	• Research target audiences, industries, and business decision-makers.

	• Understand the business problems behind the technical subjects you're writing about.

	• Research customer pain points, priorities, motivations, objections, and desired outcomes.

	• Conduct competitor and market messaging research.

	• Review available Voice-of-Customer material.

	• Identify the words and phrases customers use to describe their problems.

	• Research unfamiliar technical subjects before writing about them.

	• Verify claims and supporting information rather than inventing facts or statistics.

	• Build and maintain reusable Voice of Customer and messaging research.

You'll also have opportunities to conduct interviews with our leadership, subject-matter experts, and customers.

We expect you to ask thoughtful questions, dig beyond surface-level answers, and turn those conversations into useful messaging, campaigns, case studies, and copy.

If you don't understand something, ask.

We would much rather answer a question than receive confident sounding copy based on an assumption.



Copy Review & Editing

Not everything you work on will begin with a blank page.

You'll also review and improve existing copy for:

	• Clarity

	• Persuasiveness

	• Positioning

	• Audience fit

	• Brand voice

	• Structure

	• Accuracy

	• Strength of the call-to-action

You may receive copy written internally, generated as an early draft with AI, or provided by another source.

Your responsibility is to determine whether the message works and improve it when it doesn't.



What This Role Is NOT

This is a specialized copywriting and messaging position.

You will not be responsible for:

	• Managing social media accounts

	• Scheduling or publishing social media content

	• Graphic design

	• Creating graphics

	• Managing our CRM

	• Building
 automations

	• Campaign deployment

	• General virtual assistant or administrative duties

You own the messaging and the words.

Someone else will handle the systems, design, publishing, and implementation.



What We're Looking For

You should have:

	• 3+ years of professional copywriting experience with demonstrated experience developing messaging and strategy not simply producing content from a brief.

	• A strong portfolio demonstrating persuasive copy across multiple formats.

	• Excellent written English and the ability to write naturally for a US business audience.

	• Strong understanding of B2B copywriting fundamentals, including audience awareness, positioning, pain points, benefits, objections, hooks, offers, buyer motivation, and CTAs.

	• The ability to research unfamiliar industries, audiences, and subjects independently.

	• The ability to develop and recommend messaging angles without requiring a fully developed creative brief.

	• The ability to explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

	• Strong interviewing and information gathering skills.

	• Strong editing, proofreading, and rewriting skills.

	• The ability to receive feedback and revise your work.

	• The confidence to respectfully challenge a direction when you believe there's a better approach.

	• Strong attention to factual accuracy.

	• The ability to manage assignments and deadlines independently in a remote environment.



Your Portfolio Matters

We're interested in seeing work such as:

s, landing pages, website copy, advertisements, sales copy, campaign messaging, case studies, direct response copy, and other conversion oriented writing.

A portfolio consisting primarily of SEO articles or general blog content will not demonstrate everything we're looking for in this position.

Applications without relevant copywriting samples or a portfolio will not be considered.



Preferred Experience

It's a plus if you have experience with:

	• B2B technology, SaaS, IT, MSP, or cybersecurity copywriting

	• Small and midsize business audiences

	• Voice-of-Customer research

	• Customer interviews

	• Positioning and messaging frameworks

	• Direct-response copywriting

	• Professional-services marketing

	• IT and cybersecurity concepts

	• Working remotely with US-based companies

You don't need to be an IT or cybersecurity expert.

You do need to be curious enough to learn, comfortable asking questions, and disciplined enough to verify what you write.



What Success Looks Like

Initially, we'll provide more context, guidance, and feedback as you learn our services, our voice, and the market.

Over time, we expect you to become increasingly independent.

Eventually, we should be able to give you a business objective and context not dictate the angle, headline, structure, and CTA and trust you to help determine the strongest message.

You'll own assignments from:

Brief ? Research ? Messaging/Angle ? Draft ? Feedback ? Revision ? Proofreading ? Final Copy

A successful final draft should typically require refinement and feedback, not reconstruction.

Working Arrangement

	• Approximately 20 hours per week

	• Long-term opportunity

	• Majority of work may be completed asynchronously

	• Scheduled availability for collaboration during agreed-upon US Central Time windows

	• Customer and team interviews scheduled as needed

	• Opportunity for additional hours as the role and company grow

Because this is primarily a writing and research position, we don't require you to work an entire US overnight schedule from the Philippines.

We care about excellent work, reliable communication, meeting deadlines, and being available when collaboration is necessary.



Compensation

$12–$18 USD per hour, depending on experience.

For an exceptional candidate, compensation will reflect the quality of your portfolio, strategic copywriting ability, experience, and performance during our selection process.



A Note About AI

We don't expect you to pretend AI doesn't exist.

You're welcome to use AI thoughtfully as part of your research, brainstorming, outlining, and editing process.

But we're hiring your judgment.

You should be able to recognize generic AI copy, weak messaging, unsupported claims, clichés, poor positioning, and writing that doesn't sound human.

AI can assist your process.

It cannot replace your ability to think like a copywriter.



How to Apply

We're intentionally looking for quality rather than a large volume of applicants.

Please submit:

	1. A short introduction telling us about your copywriting background.

	2. Your résumé or relevant work history.

	3. A link to your copywriting portfolio.

	4. Three examples of work you believe best demonstrate your ability as a B2B copywriter.

	5. A brief explanation of why you chose those three pieces and what you were trying to accomplish with each.

Candidates who advance will be asked to complete a paid copywriting exercise before a final hiring decision is made.

We're not looking for someone who simply writes what they're told.

We're looking for someone who understands the audience, finds the message, challenges weak ideas, and then finds the words that make the message work.

title: AI Systems & Automation Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly capable AI Systems & Automation Specialist who can help us bring AI into different areas of our furniture business.



Showhome Furniture is a furniture store based in Calgary, Alberta. We are looking for someone who does more than simply use ChatGPT. We want someone who can **design, build, connect, and improve AI-powered systems that make our business faster, smarter, and more efficient.**



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys figuring out how a business operates, identifying repetitive or inefficient processes, and then building practical AI solutions to improve them.



## What You Will Be Doing



You will work with our team to identify areas where AI and automation can improve our day-to-day operations.



Your responsibilities may include:



* Building custom AI assistants and internal AI tools

* Creating AI-powered workflows for different departments

* Automating repetitive administrative tasks

* Connecting AI tools with our existing software and platforms

* Building systems using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms

* Creating AI systems for customer inquiries and customer service

* Developing AI tools to help our sales team

* Automating lead follow-up and lead qualification

* Building AI-powered systems for marketing and content creation

* Improving our SEO, social media, advertising, and content workflows with AI

* Creating systems that can analyze business data and produce useful reports

* Automating product information, descriptions, categorization, and merchandising workflows

* Creating internal knowledge bases that employees can search using AI

* Finding opportunities where AI can save employees time

* Testing new AI tools and determining whether they are useful for our business

* Documenting the systems you build so our team can understand and maintain them

* Monitoring existing automations and improving them over time



## Examples of Projects You May Work On



We are interested in building systems such as:



* AI sales assistant for our furniture sales team

* AI customer support assistant

* AI-powered internal company knowledge assistant

* Automated lead qualification system

* Automated follow-up system for customers and leads

* AI-generated marketing content workflows

* Automated social media content systems

* AI-assisted Google Ads and Meta Ads workflows

* AI SEO research and content optimization systems

* AI product-description and product-data automation

* AI reporting dashboards

* Automated review and reputation management workflows

* AI tools that help employees answer customer questions faster

* Systems that connect Shopify, CRM tools,
, spreadsheets, advertising platforms, and other business software



We are open to your ideas as well.



If you see an opportunity to improve the business using AI, we want you to be able to propose it, build it, test it, and improve it.



## Skills We Are Looking For



You should have strong experience with several of the following:



* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* Claude

* Gemini

* AI agents

* OpenAI API or other LLM APIs

* 

* n8n

* Zapier

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* Prompt engineering

* AI workflow design

* Automation architecture

* Google Sheets

* Shopify

* CRM integrations

*
 automation

* Databases

* Vector databases / RAG systems

* AI knowledge bases

* Python or JavaScript

* Data processing and reporting



You do **not** need to know every tool listed above.



We care more about whether you understand how to solve business problems using AI and automation.



## The Person We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



* Thinks like a problem solver, not just a task worker

* Can look at a manual process and figure out how to automate it

* Understands both AI and business operations

* Can research solutions independently

* Can build systems from start to finish

* Is comfortable learning new AI tools quickly

* Tests their work carefully before deploying it

* Pays attention to accuracy and reliability

* Understands that AI outputs must sometimes be verified

* Can explain technical systems in simple language

* Documents their work clearly

* Communicates well

* Takes ownership of projects

* Looks for ways to continuously improve systems



We especially value someone who can say:



**"I noticed your team is doing this manually. I think I can build a system that handles 80% of it automatically."**



That is the mindset we are looking for.



## Important



We are **not** looking for someone whose only AI experience is writing prompts in ChatGPT.



Using ChatGPT is useful, but this role requires someone who understands how to **build AI into actual business processes.**



You should be comfortable working with automation tools, integrations, APIs, and AI systems.



## Experience With Retail or E-Commerce Is a Plus



Experience in any of these areas would be helpful:



* Furniture

* Retail

* E-commerce

* Shopify

* Digital marketing

* SEO

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* CRM systems

* Sales automation

* Customer service automation



Furniture industry experience is **not required**.



## How We Will Measure Success



Your success will not be measured by how many AI tools you use.



It will be measured by results such as:



* Hours of manual work eliminated

* Faster response times

* Better lead follow-up

* More efficient employees

* Fewer repetitive tasks

* Better use of company data

* Improved marketing productivity

* Better customer experiences

title: Xactimate Restoration Estimator – Full-Time / Long-Term
description:
Restimate is a U.S.-based restoration estimating company that prepares professional Xactimate estimates for restoration contractors across the United States.



We are looking for an experienced Xactimate Estimator to join our team on a long-term basis. This is not a general virtual assistant position—we are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience preparing restoration and insurance-related estimates in Xactimate.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for reviewing documentation provided by our clients and preparing accurate, detailed Xactimate estimates.



Typical projects may include:



- Water mitigation estimates

- Fire and smoke damage estimates

- Mold remediation estimates

- Reconstruction estimates

- Contents-related estimates

- Xactimate Sketch

- Estimates created from Matterport or DocuSketch

- Estimates created from photos, measurements, scopes, and field documentation

- Revisions and supplements to existing estimates



You will be provided with documentation from the restoration contractor and will be expected to identify the appropriate Xactimate line items, quantities, notes, and scope necessary to produce a complete professional estimate.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



- Professional experience using Xactimate

- Experience with restoration, insurance claims, or property damage estimating

- Strong knowledge of Xactimate line items and estimating methodology

- Experience estimating water mitigation and/or reconstruction work

- Ability to create accurate Xactimate Sketches

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to recognize missing or conflicting information and ask appropriate questions

- Good written English communication

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Matterport

- DocuSketch

- Encircle

- MICA

- DASH

- Symbility

- Xactimate Level 1, 2, or 3 certification

- U.S. restoration contractors

- Insurance carrier or TPA estimating requirements

- Large-loss or commercial restoration estimating



Position



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our estimating team, not someone looking for a short-term project.



There will be consistent estimating work for the right candidate, with the opportunity to take on additional responsibility as our estimating volume grows.



We value accuracy and consistency over simply completing estimates as quickly as possible.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. How many years you have used Xactimate professionally

2. What types of Xactimate estimates you have experience preparing

3. Whether you primarily work with mitigation, reconstruction, contents, or a combination

4. Any Xactimate certifications you currently hold

5. Your experience with Matterport, DocuSketch, Encircle, MICA, or similar platforms

6. Approximately how many estimates you typically complete per week

7. Your current availability

8. Your expected monthly salary

9. Your preferred working hours and time zone

10. One or more redacted sample Xactimate estimates that demonstrate the quality of your work



Important



Please begin your application with the words "RESTIMATE XACTIMATE" so we know you have read the complete job description.



Candidates selected for the next stage will be asked to complete a paid Xactimate test estimate using a sample restoration project.



We are looking for talented estimators who want consistent work, clear processes, and the opportunity to grow with our team.

title: Short-Form video Editor for US Marketing Agency (Long-Term)
description:
We are a US marketing agency. We run the ads and the booking systems for

outdoor lighting companies across the United States. Our clients light up

homes at night, so the work is beautiful and it films well.



We need a full-time video editor who can turn raw phone footage into short

vertical videos that make people call a lighting company. This is not brand

film work. This is high volume, fast turnaround, direct response ad creative,

plus social content for our founder.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY WEEK



- Edit 12 to 20 short vertical ad videos (15 to 45 seconds) from client

  footage, stock, and screen recordings

- Cut 5 to 7 clips from our founder's raw recordings for LinkedIn and X

- Build before and after videos (a dark yard, then the same yard lit up at night)

- Add captions, hooks, text overlays, light sound design, and end cards

- Make size variants of every winning video (9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

- Build our template files, caption presets, and hook bank so every future

  video gets faster

- Turn our screen recordings into simple written checklists in Notion during

  your first 60 days. We give you the hours for this, it is part of the job

- Keep the asset library organized so nothing is lost or edited twice



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2 or more years editing short vertical video for social media or paid ads

- Strong with CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro. After Effects is a plus, not required

- You can cut a hook in the first 2 seconds and you know why that matters

- Good written English. You will get feedback in Loom videos and Slack messages

- Fast internet, a computer that can handle 4K footage, and a quiet place to work

- You can deliver 3 to 4 finished videos on a normal day without dropping quality



NICE TO HAVE



- You have edited ads for a US home services business (roofing, pools,

  landscaping, lighting, remodeling)

- You understand Meta ad specs and safe zones

- You can make simple static images and carousels in Canva

- You have used AI tools like HeyGen, ElevenLabs, or Descript in a real workflow

title: CS Retention Manager – $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.
