title: Meta and Google Ads Media Buyer for US Home Services Lead Generation
description:
We are a US marketing agency. We run Meta ads and booking systems for outdoor

lighting companies across the United States. Our job is simple to describe and

hard to do well. We get a homeowner to raise their hand, then we get that

homeowner onto the client's calendar for an estimate.



We need a media buyer who has run LOCAL LEAD GENERATION, not ecommerce. There

is no shopping cart here. Success is a booked estimate the client actually

shows up to. If you have only run purchase campaigns for dropshipping stores,

this role will frustrate you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build and launch Meta campaigns for client accounts (lead forms and landing

  page conversions)

- Check every account every morning. Catch dead ads, spend spikes, rejected

  creative, and broken forms before the client does

- Run the creative testing calendar with our video editor. New angles in,

  losers off, winners scaled

- Watch lead quality, not just cost per lead. Bad leads at a good price are a

  failure

- Keep the daily scorecard current so we always know cost per lead and cost per

  booked appointment by account

- Send one written weekly report per client account with what changed, what it

  cost, and what is next

- Manage pixels, conversion events, audiences, and exclusions across accounts

- Build our playbook. In your first 60 days you will turn our screen recordings

  and your own daily work into written SOPs in Notion, with screenshots. We

  give you the hours for this. It is a real part of the job, not extra credit



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- You will not talk to clients. Our founder owns every client relationship

- You will not set strategy alone for the first 90 days. Offer, angle,

  geography, and budget calls come from our founder. You own the build, the

  daily execution, and the recommendations

- You will not touch client money. Clients pay Meta directly on their own cards



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2 or more years buying Meta ads with real budget responsibility. Tell me the

  monthly spend you personally managed

- Direct experience with local service lead generation in the US. Home services

  is ideal

- You can explain the difference between an instant form lead and a landing

  page lead, and when you would use each

- You know how to set up the pixel and conversion events, and you can tell when

  tracking is lying to you

- You are comfortable working accounts in the $50 to $200 per day range. This

  is not a $10k per day ecom job

- Good written English. You will write client-facing reports our founder

  reviews and sends

- You can work 9am to 1pm US Eastern every weekday. Accounts break in the

  morning and we fix them in the morning



NICE TO HAVE



- Google Ads or Local Services Ads experience

- You have worked inside GoHighLevel or a similar CRM and understand what

  happens to a lead after the form

- You have run multiple client accounts at once at an agency

- You have opinions about creative and can brief an editor properly

title: Credit Repair Specialist – Personal & Business Credit (US)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Specialist who can handle both personal and business credit for our US-based clients. This is a long-term role that requires deep knowledge of the full credit repair and credit-building process — from disputing negative items on personal reports all the way through establishing and scaling business credit.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Analyzing personal credit reports (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) and identifying negative, inaccurate, or disputable items

- Drafting and sending dispute letters to bureaus, creditors, and collection agencies (goodwill letters, debt validation letters, 609/611 letters, CFPB complaints)

- Guiding clients through the process of rebuilding personal credit scores

- Transitioning clients from repaired personal credit to building strong business credit profiles (Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, Equifax Business)

- Setting up business credit foundations: EIN, business address, phone, DUNS/PAYDEX score, vendor tradelines, net-30 accounts, business credit cards

- Monitoring credit report progress and adjusting strategy as needed

- Keeping accurate records and updating clients on their progress



Who We're Looking For:

- Proven experience in US personal credit repair (must know FCRA, FDCPA, and dispute processes inside and out)

- Strong knowledge of business credit building — not just personal

- Understands the full pathway: repair personal ? establish business entity ? build business credit profile ? access business funding

- Knows which net-30 vendors, tradelines, and business credit cards to use at each stage

- Familiar with credit repair software platforms (DisputeBee, Credit Repair Cloud, ScoreCEO, DisputeFox, or similar)

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple client files simultaneously



Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential to grow into full-time. Must have availability during US business hours (Mountain Time preferred).



Please answer all 5 screening questions below in your application — applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Screening Questions:

1. A client has a collection account on their personal credit report that is 3 years old. The collection agency is reporting inaccurate information. Walk us through exactly what steps you would take and which letters you would send, and in what order.



2. After a client's personal credit score improves, what are the first 5 concrete steps you take to start building their business credit from scratch? Please be specific — what entities do you register with, in what order, and why?



3. What is a PAYDEX score, how is it calculated, and what are the best strategies to get a business to a PAYDEX score of 80 or higher as quickly as possible?



4. A client has a personal credit score of 620 and no business credit history. They want to qualify for business funding in 12 months. What is your month-by-month strategy to get them there?



5. What credit repair software do you prefer to use and why? What specific features does it have that make your work faster or more effective? Have you used any AI tools to assist with the dispute or credit-building process?



Compensation: DOE — please include your desired hourly rate in your application.

title: AR/AP  Virtual Assistant for U.S. Fire & Security Company | Full-Time | EST Hours | Long-Term Role
description:
About Us

Oversightt Fire & Security is a U.S.-based company providing fire alarm, video surveillance, access control, and security systems throughout New York.

We take pride in accuracy, accountability, and integrity — and we’re looking for a full-time Accounting & Collections Virtual Assistant to help manage invoicing, payments, and light customer service tasks.



Role Overview

You’ll play a key role in our accounting department — managing invoices, payments, reconciliations, and following up with customers who have past-due balances. You’ll also assist our Customer Service Representatives (CSRs) with billing questions and account-related customer calls when needed. This is a long-term position for someone reliable, honest, and detail-oriented who enjoys helping both customers and the company succeed.



Responsibilities

-Record invoices, expenses, and payments in QuickBooks Online

-Reconcile bank and credit card statements weekly

-Track accounts receivable and follow up with past-due customers by phone and

-Make professional collection calls to customers with outstanding balances

-Update aging reports and follow up on payment commitments

-Communicate with CSRs to resolve customer billing questions

-Prepare weekly financial summaries and aging reports for management

-Assist CSRs when they need help verifying customer payments or balances

-Maintain accuracy, confidentiality, and professionalism at all times



Requirements

-Fluent English (spoken + written) – you’ll speak directly with U.S. customers

-Proven experience in accounting, collections, or bookkeeping

-Experience using QuickBooks Online (required)

-Expert with Google Sheets / Excel (required)

-Available to work U.S. Eastern Time (9 AM–5 PM EST)

-Strong communication and interpersonal skills

-Reliable internet and power backup

-Integrity, self-motivation, and accountability are must-haves

-Preferred (but not required): experience with Slack, 
, or VoIP/CRM software.



What We Offer

Full-time, long-term position (not project-based)

Paid training and ongoing support

Opportunity to grow into senior accounting or admin roles

Stable U.S. company employment and respectful culture

100% remote – work from home with performance-based trust



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

?? Applications that don’t follow these steps will be automatically disqualified.



 Subject Line: Accounting & Collections VA – [Your Full Name]



In your message include:



A short introduction (2–3 sentences) about yourself

Your experience with accounting, collections, or customer contact

Your internet speed test link (from speedtest.net)

The software tools you’re familiar with (QuickBooks, Excel, VoIP, etc.)

Attach or link a 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your most difficult accounting or collections task so far (use Vocaroo or Loom)



Critical Thinking Test (Required)



Please answer these questions briefly in your message:



A customer insists they already paid their invoice from 3 months ago, but there’s no record in QuickBooks or the bank.

? What steps would you take to verify and resolve it?



You notice an invoice for $1,200 was marked “Paid” in QuickBooks, but the bank deposit is $1,000.

? Why might that happen, and how would you fix it?



You’re told to send payment reminders to 10 customers, but you see 2 have already paid.

? What would you do before sending the
s?



Bonus Step (Optional but Preferred)



Send a short Loom or Vocaroo video explaining:

“How would you approach a past-due customer politely but effectively to collect payment?”



Our Core Values

Integrity – Always do what’s right, even when no one is watching

Accountability – Own your work and communicate clearly

Accuracy – Every number matters

Professionalism – Treat every customer with respect and courtesy

Teamwork – Support both our customers and teammates



Apply today and join a company that values honesty, growth, and excellence.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Manager for Fast-Growing U.S. Home-Service Company
description:
Type: Full-Time

Starting Salary: $1,000–$1,300 USD per month, based on experience

Schedule: Flexible, with at least two hours of overlap with U.S. Central Time

Location: Remote

Paid Trial: 30 days



About Us



Septic Squad is a fast-growing septic pumping and repair company based in Austin, Texas. 



Our tagline is:



“Disgustingly Good Service.”



We operate multiple septic trucks and complete interesting, messy and highly visual jobs every day. We have more than 250 five-star Google reviews and want to become the most recognizable septic company in Texas.



We are looking for a talented short-form video editor and social media manager who can turn our raw jobsite footage into entertaining, educational and lead-generating content.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. Video editing, storytelling and social-media growth will be your primary responsibilities.



What You Will Do

Edit 25–30 short-form videos every month

Create content for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Turn raw jobsite footage into compelling stories

Write strong hooks that capture attention within the first two seconds

Add professional captions, music, sound effects and branded graphics

Write natural-sounding American English captions and calls to action

Schedule and publish content daily

Create thumbnails and cover images

Develop monthly content calendars

Monitor comments, messages and engagement

Direct potential customers to call or schedule service

Review analytics and identify the best-performing content

Create new versions of winning videos

Turn customer reviews into social-media content

Organize our raw footage and maintain a content library

Provide our advertising manager with the strongest videos for paid ads

Suggest new content ideas for our technicians to record

Content You Will Create



Examples include:



“The homeowner thought they only needed routine pumping. Then we opened the tank…”

Septic mistakes that can cost homeowners thousands

Before-and-after transformations

Satisfying pumping and cleaning footage

Unusual things found inside septic tanks

Technician explanations and system diagnoses

Customer testimonials

Funny technician moments

Septic myths and facts

Repair recommendations

Emergency job stories

Videos using our five-star customer reviews



We want content that is entertaining and occasionally funny while still making Septic Squad look professional, trustworthy and knowledgeable.



Requirements

Strong portfolio of short-form videos for Reels, TikTok or YouTube Shorts

Excellent understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

Advanced proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar software

Excellent written English

Ability to write captions that sound natural to an American audience

Experience scheduling and managing content across multiple platforms

Understanding of the difference between content that receives views and content that generates customers

Reliable internet connection and computer

Strong organization and communication

Ability to meet deadlines without constant supervision

Comfortable working with footage involving septic tanks, wastewater and dirty jobs



Experience creating content for American home-service businesses—HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping, construction, cleaning or similar companies—is strongly preferred.



Compensation and Benefits

Starting salary of $1,000–$1,300 USD per month

Performance-based salary increases

Bonuses for exceptional organic reach and measurable lead generation

13th-month pay after completing the trial period, prorated during the first year

Paid Philippine holidays

Paid vacation and sick days after the trial period

Long-term opportunity with a growing American company

Creative freedom once you demonstrate that you understand our brand

Consistent access to new and interesting footage

Our Hiring Process



We do not hire solely based on interviews.



Shortlisted applicants will receive the same collection of raw Septic Squad footage and complete one paid test project. We will pay $50 USD for the test regardless of whether you are hired.



The test will require you to produce:



One finished short-form video

A compelling opening hook

On-screen captions

A suggested post caption and call to action

A brief explanation of why you edited it that way



We will evaluate creativity, storytelling, English, attention to detail, speed and ability to follow instructions.



How to Apply



Use the subject line:



DISGUSTINGLY GOOD CONTENT – [Your Name]



Include the following:



A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience

Links to five short-form videos you personally edited

Examples of social-media accounts you have helped manage

Any measurable results you helped produce, including views, followers, leads or sales

The editing software you use

Your desired monthly salary

Your internet speed and computer specifications

Your availability and preferred working hours

Your favorite video from your portfolio and why you believe it performed well

Three short-form video ideas you would create for a septic pumping company



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become the creative engine behind Septic Squad—not someone looking for another generic VA position.

title: Business Development & Customer Success Representative
description:
No problem — here's a clean, copy-paste-ready version you can paste directly into a platform:



Business Development & Customer Success Representative



Location: Philippines (Remote)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: CMO, Australia

Market: Australia & New Zealand

Industry: Cybersecurity | SaaS | Technology



About the Role

Cybersecurity is one of the most important challenges facing businesses today. At Tautsec, we're building an ambitious Australian cybersecurity company with a simple goal: help businesses become more secure, resilient and better prepared for the threats they face.



We're looking for a Business Development & Customer Success Representative, based in the Philippines, to own the full front-end of the customer journey — from the very first conversation with a prospect, through to helping them get fully set up and confident using CyberPilot, our platform, once they've signed on.



This is a dual-focus role for someone who wants to build relationships, not just book meetings — equally comfortable opening a new conversation with a prospect and making sure an existing customer feels genuinely looked after.



The Role

Your mission has two halves. On the front end, you'll create high-quality sales conversations and build qualified pipeline for our commercial team — through your own outbound research as well as by qualifying inbound leads from our marketing, events and tradeshow activity. On the back end, once a deal closes, you'll take ownership of onboarding — making sure new customers are set up, scheduled, trained and confident using CyberPilot from day one.



You'll work across multiple channels —
, phone, LinkedIn, video calls and CyberPilot itself — and you'll be one of the few people at Tautsec with visibility across the entire customer lifecycle: from first hello to fully onboarded.



Part One: Business Development

Create the conversations that build our pipeline — across both outbound and inbound.



Outbound: you'll do your own research and proactively go find opportunities.



Research target companies across ANZ and identify where cybersecurity is a genuine business priority.

Build and maintain high-quality prospect lists and identify key decision-makers.

Run confident outbound calls, personalised
 campaigns and LinkedIn outreach.

Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand a prospect's priorities, risks and buying triggers.



Inbound: you'll follow up and qualify leads generated by our marketing engine.



Respond quickly to leads generated through digital marketing campaigns, webinars, events and tradeshows.

Qualify inbound interest with the same rigour as outbound — understanding real intent, timing and fit before it goes to the sales team.

Work closely with marketing to understand campaign context, so your follow-up feels informed, not generic.



Across both channels, your job is the same: qualify opportunities and hand the sales team clear context — not just a booking.



Support outbound campaigns, ABM initiatives, webinars and demand-gen programs.



Part Two: Customer Success & Onboarding

Once a customer signs, you become their trusted guide to getting real value from CyberPilot — and their advocate inside Tautsec.



Own the handover from sales to onboarding, and be the new customer's first point of contact after they sign.

Schedule and run structured onboarding calls, walking customers through setup and getting them fully live on CyberPilot.

Build a simple success plan for each new customer — clear onboarding milestones, timelines and what "live and confident" looks like for them.

Become a product SME on CyberPilot's core features, so you can answer setup and usage questions confidently without always escalating.

Run proactive check-ins and light-touch health checks during the first 30–90 days to confirm the customer is actually using CyberPilot, not just signed up to it.

Coordinate onboarding timelines and keep customers, and internal teams, on track to go-live.

Troubleshoot basic setup issues, and know when to loop in technical or support teams for anything more complex.

Flag early risk signals — low engagement, confusion, unmet expectations — to the commercial team before they become churn or renewal risk.

Be the voice of the customer internally — feed onboarding feedback and common questions back to the team to improve our onboarding materials, playbooks and even the product itself.

Spot early expansion or upsell signals during onboarding conversations and pass them to the commercial team.



You don't need to be a cybersecurity expert or a technical implementation specialist when you join us — you do need to be organised, empathetic, and genuinely motivated by seeing a customer succeed, not just sign.



What You'll Bring



Essential



3–5+ years' experience in a B2B customer-facing role — sales, business development, customer success, account management or onboarding — ideally within SaaS or technology.

A demonstrated track record of hitting targets or KPIs in a previous sales or customer success role, with results you can speak to.

Strong written and spoken English, and confidence engaging both prospects and existing customers, including senior stakeholders.

Comfortable switching between two mindsets: proactive outbound sales, and patient, structured customer support.

Excellent organisation — you can juggle a pipeline of prospects and a caseload of onboarding customers without dropping either.

Able to work independently with a remote Australian team, during Australian business hours.



Highly Desirable



Experience selling or supporting cybersecurity products specifically, ideally into Australia or another international market.

Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a CRM/customer success platform.

Experience running onboarding, training, implementation calls or health-check reviews with customers.

Understanding of B2B technology buying and basic cybersecurity concepts.



This is a role for someone who already knows how to do this well and wants real ownership — not a training-ground position. If you bring the experience and can show us the results to back it up, we want to hear from you.



The Tautsec Standard

You don't need to tick every box, but these qualities matter: driven, resilient, curious, coachable, commercially minded, confident without ego, disciplined, resourceful, and competitive but collaborative. We're building a high-performing team that shares knowledge and helps each other improve.



AI & Modern Sales

The best BDRs of the future combine human connection with intelligent technology. You'll be encouraged to use AI to research accounts, prepare for conversations, personalise outreach and improve productivity — as a tool to sharpen judgement, not replace it.



Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30 (Orient): Get up to speed on Tautsec, CyberPilot, our customers and sales process; start prospecting and taking inbound leads within your first couple of weeks, not after a long ramp.



Days 30–60 (Deliver): Own your full pipeline and onboarding caseload independently, applying the experience you already bring rather than still learning the basics.



Days 60–90 (Optimise): Be operating at full capacity across both sides of the role, and bringing your own ideas to improve how we prospect, qualify and onboard.



How We'll Measure Success



Business development: qualified meetings and opportunities generated, pipeline contribution, outbound campaign performance.

Customer success: onboarding completion rate and time-to-value, customer engagement in the first 90 days, onboarding satisfaction.



Numbers aren't the whole story — we'll also look at the quality of your conversations on both sides, how quickly you learn, and the value you bring to the team.



Why Join Tautsec?

This is a chance to join early — working directly with Australian leadership, with visibility across the entire customer journey and real influence over how we build our sales and customer experience engine, in one of the world's most important technology sectors.



Work remotely from the Philippines with senior AU marketing and commercial leadership.

Build rare, end-to-end experience spanning sales and customer success.

Develop deep expertise in cybersecurity and B2B technology, with ongoing coaching.

Grow into senior commercial or customer success leadership as we scale.



Your growth is part of our growth.

title: Remote Bookkeeper + Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: Outbound Sales Representative - US Small Business (Full-Time, US Day Shift)
description:
Finch Harbor places full-time Filipino professionals with American small businesses. We are hiring a full-time Outbound Sales Representative to call US small business owners and book them with our closer. You are not closing the deal.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call US small business owners from lists we build and give you

- Qualify the owner and book the meeting onto our closer's calendar

- Log what happened in our CRM

- Work callbacks and the people who didn't pick up the first time



We sell one thing at one price: a full-time, vetted Filipino assistant placed with a US small business at $1,450/month, all-in. No setup fee, no tiers. Most people you call will not have heard of us, so you need to be able to say what Finch Harbor is in one sentence.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year of cold calling experience. Please don't apply without it.

- Spoken English an American customer can follow easily. The interview is a phone call, conducted entirely in English. An accent is fine.

- Full-time US Central DAY shift: 9 AM to 5 PM CT, Monday to Friday. That is 10 PM to 6 AM Philippine time. Confirm you can sustain a night schedule.

- Your own laptop, stable internet, and a quiet place to take calls

- Reliable attendance: at your desk and dialing through the shift

- Background check before you start



PREFERRED

- College degree

- Experience selling to US small business owners



WHAT WE OFFER

- $5.00/hr (about $867/month), full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Central

- $100 for every deal that closes from a meeting you booked. A deal closes when the client signs and pays.

- Our target is 2 closes a month, which brings total pay to about $1,067/month

- A 60-day trial period applies

- 8 paid holidays per year: 7 days the company closes, plus 1 you choose

- 5 paid sick days per year, after 60 days

- 5 PTO days per year, starting after 90 days



TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your application with the word JUNIPER so we know you read this posting.



VOICE RECORDING (required)

Record yourself reading the passage below and include the link in your application. 
 is fine. Read it exactly as written, at the pace you would actually say it on a call. Do not add to it or change it.



"Hi, is this Dave? - Dave, my name is Maria, I'm calling from Finch Harbor. I'll be quick.



We place full-time assistants with contractors and small shops around Nashville. Admin, phones, scheduling, invoicing - the things that eat your evenings.



It's fourteen fifty a month, all in, and there's nothing up front. Same person, forty hours a week, and if they're not right we replace them free for as long as you're with us.



Does that sound like something worth fifteen minutes on Thursday?"

title: EXPERIENCED Cold Caller – Vacant Land Acquisitions
description:
Hi there,

We are looking for a motivated and professional, full-time Virtual Assistant Cold Caller to join our growing real estate investment company that specializes in buying and selling vacant land. You will contact vacant land owners via outbound cold calls to gauge their interest in receiving a cash offer for their property.



WHAT THE JOB ENTAILS



-Make high-volume outbound cold calls daily using Mojo Dialer to vacant land owners.

-Follow our provided cold calling script while naturally asking qualifying questions and handling objections.

-Accurately document call outcomes, owner details, and notes in our CRM/system.

-Identify motivated sellers and immediately schedule a follow-up call with our Acquisitions Manager using Calendly.

-Maintain a positive, professional, and confident demeanor on every call.

-Meet or exceed daily/weekly call and appointment-setting targets.



PREFERRED (Not Required)



-Native English speaker (or equivalent).

-Previously lived in the United States.

-Experience with Mojo Dialer (or similar power dialer) and Calendly is a big plus.



REQUIREMENTS



*****Proven cold calling or outbound sales experience in real estate.*****



-Fast, reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/upload with wired connection strongly preferred) and a reliable computer/headset – this is mandatory for Mojo Dialer.

-Work station consists of TWO monitors / screens so that you're able to navigate Mojo Dialer, Scripts, Calendly, etc.

-Mastery of the English language with excellent verbal communication skills and a clear, professional phone presence.

-Detail-oriented, reliable, and able to take accurate notes while multitasking on calls.

-Great attention to detail and ability to thrive with minimal supervision in a remote environment.

-Strong listening skills, comfortable handling rejection, and overcoming objections positively.

-Quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions and background noise.

-When you apply for the job using the form, you will have to answer one of the questions; "Tell us briefly about your previous VA experience." start your response with THE ANSWER to the math equation “6x2=___” .

-Self-motivated and organized with the ability to work independently during core U.S. business hours (10:00am to 7:00pm Central Standard Time).



HOW TO APPLY



1. Please prepare a NEW (not pre-recorded) voice recording - on why you think you’re a good fit for this cold calling role. Start the recording with "Hi, Jeff!". If you've previously lived in the United States, please be sure to mention that in your voice recording. 

2. Prepare Resume and/or Portfolio 

3. Prepare Link to your LinkedIn profile, website, or portfolio

4. FILL OUT this form and SEND the necessary details, including the above-mentioned: 



We review applications on a rolling basis and will respond only to candidates we feel are a strong match. Thank you for understanding and looking forward to hiring experienced cold callers with a positive attitude and strong work ethic!!!

title: META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – DROPSHIPPING
description:
META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – DROPSHIPPING

Starting Salary: $600 USD/month?Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM?Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a fast-growing Shopify dropshipping company specializing in men's clothing and apparel.

Every week, our Product Page Team prepares approximately 40 new products per store for testing.

Once a product page is ready, it is passed to our Meta Ads team.

Your job is to turn those product pages into accurate, fully prepared
 & Instagram campaigns.

This is a hands-on Meta Ads position.

We are NOT looking for someone who only knows the basics of
 Ads.

You must already have real experience creating Meta campaigns, researching interests, understanding audiences, and working inside Meta Ads Manager.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY

You will receive approximately 40 product links every week.

For each product, you will:

1. Open and review the Shopify product page.

2. Understand the product and who would buy it.

3. Check that the product page is correct.

4. Download the necessary product images.

5. Make sure the correct images are being used.

6. Research relevant Meta interests.

7. Determine appropriate targeting based on the product.

8. Build the campaign according to our internal structure.

9. Upload the correct creatives.

10. Check all campaign settings carefully.

11. Make sure everything is correct before submitting the campaign.

The goal:

40 products ? 40 properly prepared campaigns every week.



YOU MUST UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

This is not a job where you simply receive a product and choose a random interest.

You need to actually look at the product and understand:

What is it??Who would buy it??What type of person would be interested in it??What interests could represent that customer?

For example, a men's jacket, men's shoes, men's accessories, and men's casual clothing can all have completely different audiences.

We want someone who can think about the customer, not just follow a checklist.



META ADS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You should already be comfortable with:

* Meta Ads Manager

* Meta Business Manager

*
 Ads

* Instagram Ads

* Campaigns

* Ad Sets

* Ads

* ABO

* CBO

* Meta Pixel

* Audiences

* Interests

* Targeting

* Budgets

* Placements

* Ad creatives

You must know how to navigate Meta's advertising platform without needing basic training.

This is not a beginner position.



INTEREST RESEARCH

One of the most important parts of the job is finding relevant interests and audiences.

We don't want someone who always chooses the first obvious interest.

You should be able to research different angles based on the product, such as:

* Fashion

* Clothing

* Lifestyle

* Brands

* Hobbies

* Related products

* Customer interests

* Different audience types

You need to have an open mind when researching targeting and be willing to test different ideas.



ACCURACY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT

You will be working with real advertising campaigns and real advertising budgets.

Before submitting a campaign, you must check:

* Correct product

* Correct product page

* Correct images

* Correct URL

* Correct
 Page

* Correct Instagram account

* Correct Pixel

* Correct campaign structure

* Correct targeting

* Correct interests

* Correct budget

* Correct settings

Small mistakes can cost real money.

We need someone who naturally double-checks their work.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is:

Experienced

You have already created Meta advertising campaigns yourself.

Creative

You can think of different audiences and targeting angles.

Organized

You can manage approximately 40 products every week without losing track.

Fast

You can work efficiently while maintaining quality.

Detail-oriented

You catch mistakes before campaigns are submitted.

Analytical

You understand why certain audiences and interests make sense for different products.

Proactive

You don't wait for someone to tell you every step.

Adaptable

You understand that Meta changes constantly and you stay updated.

Responsible

You take ownership of your work.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

You must have:

* 2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience

* Experience creating
/Instagram campaigns

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager

* Experience with Meta Business Manager

* Experience researching Meta interests

* Experience with audience targeting

* Experience with Shopify or e-commerce

* Dropshipping experience strongly preferred

* Experience with men's clothing/apparel is a strong advantage

* Understanding of ABO/CBO

* Strong English communication

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable internet

* Ability to work full-time



IMPORTANT

If you have never personally created Meta advertising campaigns, DO NOT APPLY.

If you are looking for basic
 Ads training, DO NOT APPLY.

We need someone who already knows Meta Ads and can become productive quickly after learning our internal SOPs.



AD ACCOUNT REQUIREMENT

You must have experience working with Meta advertising accounts and understand how to operate them responsibly.

You should have experience working with advertising accounts that are in good standing and understand the importance of:

* Account quality

* Policy compliance

* Ad approvals

* Page quality

* Pixel/tracking

* Preventing unnecessary account problems



EQUIPMENT

You must have:

* Reliable computer/laptop

* Smartphone

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quiet workspace

* Your own
/Meta account in good standing

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM



SALARY & GROWTH

Starting salary: $600 USD/month

After your first 3 months, your performance will be reviewed.

Salary increases can be based on:

* Accuracy

* Speed

* Reliability

* Quality of campaigns

* Initiative

* Targeting knowledge

* Improvement

* Overall performance

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer ALL questions.

Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.

1. EXPERIENCE

How many years have you personally worked with Meta Ads?

What type of products or stores have you advertised?



2. CAMPAIGN SETUP

You receive a Shopify product page for a men's jacket.

Explain the exact steps you would take from receiving the product link until the campaign is completely ready to launch.



3. INTEREST RESEARCH

You receive a men's product that you have never advertised before.

How would you find relevant Meta interests for this product?

Explain your actual research process.



4. AUDIENCE THINKING

You are given a men's product and your first obvious interest doesn't look strong.

What would you do next?

Explain how you would find other potential audiences or interests.



5. QUALITY CONTROL

Before submitting a campaign, what are the most important things you check?



6. HIGH-VOLUME WORK

You receive 40 products to prepare in one week.

How would you organize your work to complete all 40 campaigns while keeping your error rate extremely low?



7. REAL EXPERIENCE

Tell us about one Meta campaign you personally created that performed well.

What product was it, what audience did you target, and what did you learn from it?



8. META KNOWLEDGE

What is one recent Meta Ads change or update that you have learned about?

How has it affected the way you create or manage campaigns?



WHO WE WANT

We are looking for someone who already knows Meta Ads and wants to become extremely good at it.

Someone who can look at a product, understand the customer, research the right interests, build the campaign correctly, and move quickly without making careless mistakes.

Experience + Speed + Creativity + Accuracy + Attention to Detail

If that describes you, we want to hear from you.

title: Assistant Estimator
description:
PRISTINE INDUSTRIAL ROOFING

Assistant Estimator

Internal Financials Build





Start Here

We are a commercial and industrial flat roofing company. We install two things and only two things: liquid-applied Conklin systems, meaning acrylic and urethane coating assemblies, and FLEXION 2.0 vinyl membrane, warranted 25 years / 300 months. No shingles. No torch, no heat, no open flame, ever.

Before any proposal goes to a client, we build an internal financials workbook. That workbook is where the job is actually won or lost. It holds every material line, every labor hour by task, the coverage math, the margin, and the sell price. Today one person builds all of it, and that person also owns the company, runs sales, and walks the roofs.

This role is that workbook. Not the client-facing document. Nobody needs help writing the proposal. We need someone who can build and defend the numbers underneath it.

You do not need roofing experience. You will not get it from a competitor and you do not need it. What you need is arithmetic you trust, spreadsheet discipline, and the patience to be trained slowly on a system that has a reason behind every step.



Plain and Simple

Working from photo sets, field measurements, and recorded voice walkthroughs, you build the internal financials workbook and hand it back for review. Every job. Every time.



1.Study the photo set in CompanyCam before you open a spreadsheet. Count the drains. Find the curbs. Read the side walls and estimate their height. Note the deck, the existing surface, the transitions, and anything that does not belong.



2.Break the roof into areas that get different treatment, because they almost always do.



3.Split material from labor, and calculate labor per task. Tear-off is one task. Insulation is another. Base sheet, membrane or coating, side walls, curbs, drains, edge metal, coping, cleanup. Each one gets its own hours.



4.Price labor at the current fully loaded installer rate against those task hours.



5.Build materials cost with every adjustable input visible on the sheet and never buried inside a formula: sales tax at 7 percent, freight at 8 to 12 percent, buffer at 5 to 10 percent. Freight drops to zero on Conklin orders above $35,000 raw.



6.Validate coverage. Gallons per hundred square feet, by product, by area, including the color upcharge where a premium color is specified.



7.Run the math forward only. Costs, then margin, then sell price. Never backward from a price we wish we could charge. There is no complexity multiplier in our system.



8.Cross-check the whole thing a second, independent way before you hand it off. If the two methods disagree, you find out why before anyone else sees it.



9.List what is missing. A workbook with an honest open question in it is useful. A workbook with a quietly skipped side wall is worse than no workbook at all.



The Tabs You Will Own

Every workbook is built from an uploaded template, and every template carries the same tabs. You will learn what each one is for and why it sits where it sits:

1.Dashboard

2.Line-Item Detail

3.Labor Detail

4.Coverage Validation

5.Pie Split

6.Competitive Position

7.Asterisk Items

8.Shopping List

9.Order Tracking

10.What We Learned



None of these are optional and none of these are decoration. The last one is how the company gets smarter.



Quick Keys

What actually determines whether you can do this work:

1.Arithmetic you trust. Areas, perimeters, linear feet, coverage rates, gallons per hundred square feet, unit conversions, percentages. No algebra beyond that. But it has to be right, and you have to know when it is not.



2.Spreadsheet discipline. You can build a clean tab, reference another tab, and keep inputs visibly separated from calculations. If a number can change, it lives in a cell, not in a formula.



3.Reading a roof from photographs. You can look at forty pictures and hold the building in your head. You can tell a parapet from a mechanical curb. You can estimate a wall height off a doorway and land close.



4.Following a written standard exactly. Our workbook structure, math direction, and input rules are documented. Deviation is not creativity here.



5.Working from spoken direction. Most of your input arrives as long voice recordings made from a truck between appointments. You listen, pull out what matters, and turn it into structure without needing it repeated.



6.Comfort being corrected. You will hand work back and get it marked up. Often, for months. That is the training working, not you failing.



7.Enjoyment of the process. The people who last at this like the building of it. If you only care whether the job closed, you will quit by the fourth workbook.



What This Job Is Not

1.Not client-facing documents. Someone else assembles the proposal. You build what it stands on.

2.Not sales. You will never be on the phone with a building owner.

3.Not insurance work. We rarely touch claims, and we do not price from insurance software.

4.Not roof walking. You do not climb anything. You read what the camera already captured.

5.Not a software operator role. There is no program that does this for us. Building it by hand is the reason our numbers hold up.

6.Not piecework. We pay for your hours, not your volume.



How We Train You

Every proposal built in this company has been screen-recorded from start to finish, narrated the whole way. That library is your classroom. You will watch builds, then shadow a build, then build one that gets torn apart, then build one that gets torn apart less.

We are not expecting competence in thirty days. We are expecting curiosity in thirty days and competence over the year. This is a trusted seat, and we intend to train it properly rather than hire it four times.



How We Work

Pristine is a Gospel business. Roofing revenue funds community outreach and worldwide missions, and that purpose shapes how we handle clients, each other, and our own mistakes. You will not be asked to share our convictions. You will be asked to be honest, including about your own errors, because every number downstream depends on the ones you report being real.



Hours and Pay

[TBD] per hour, capped at 20 hours per week. The cap moves with demonstrated accuracy, not with time served.

Fully remote. Recruited and onboarded through Better Delegation. Daily overlap with United States Central Time is required, because direction arrives verbally and questions get answered live.



How We Screen

We are not hiring from a resume. Resumes have not worked for this seat.

1.A short conversation, twenty minutes, to find out whether this kind of work sounds interesting to you or exhausting.



2.A paid aptitude task. We hand you a finished workbook from a real job with three errors planted in it. You find them and explain what each one does to the sell price.



3.A paid build task. One real roof: the photo set, the measurements, the template, and the recorded walkthrough. You produce the material and labor split by task, and you tell us plainly what you could not determine from what we gave you.

Both tasks are paid whether or not we hire you. What we are grading is not a perfect number. It is whether you found the side walls, whether you kept material separate from labor, whether another person can read your sheet, and whether you told us honestly what you did not know.



How to Apply

Send a short note. No cover letter. Answer three things:

1.Describe something you have built or maintained that required you to be exact. It does not have to be construction and it does not have to be a job.



2.Tell us about a time your own number was wrong and how you found it.



3.Tell us how you feel about being corrected every week for a year.



Attach a spreadsheet you built yourself, for anything at all, and you move to the front of the line.





Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

Proverbs 22:29

title: Website & Growth Manager (Shopify & Wix)
description:
Pet N Pet is looking for a hands-on Website & Growth Manager to take full ownership of our website performance—from technical execution and design to conversion optimization,
 marketing, AI integration, and data-driven growth strategy.



This role is ideal for someone who blends web development expertise with e-commerce growth thinking, and knows how to turn traffic into real revenue while aligning marketing, content, and social media efforts.



About the Role:

You will manage and continuously improve our Shopify and Wix websites, ensuring seamless functionality while optimizing the customer journey to drive conversions and sales.



Beyond execution, you’ll play a key role in analyzing data, identifying opportunities, and translating insights into actionable strategies that guide our marketing, content, and social media teams. This position bridges technical execution and strategic growth, helping ensure all efforts contribute directly to revenue.



Key Responsibilities:

- Website Management & Technical Oversight

- Manage and maintain Shopify and Wix websites

- Execute website updates, redesigns, and layout improvements

- Optimize site speed, performance, and mobile responsiveness

- Handle technical fixes and maintenance (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)



Conversion & Marketing Optimization:

- Build and optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout flows

- Increase conversion rates through UX/UI improvements and testing

- Set up and manage
 marketing flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back)

- Implement customer segmentation and automation strategies

- Optimize trust elements (reviews, badges, FAQs, policies)

- Integrate and manage analytics, tracking, and conversion tools

- Apply AI-driven personalization to improve user experience and sales



Data-Driven Strategy & Cross-Team Collaboration:

- Monitor website, sales, and marketing performance metrics

- Translate data into clear, actionable strategies

- Communicate insights to content, social media, and sales teams

- Align campaigns and initiatives with revenue goals

- Develop execution plans and ensure cross-team accountability



AI Integration & Innovation

- Explore and implement AI tools for personalization, automation, and support

- Improve marketing performance through AI-driven insights and workflows

- Identify opportunities to increase efficiency and conversion using AI



Social Media & Marketing Support:

- Provide data-backed insights to improve social media performance

- Collaborate with marketing teams to ensure traffic converts into sales

- Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns across channels



To apply, please submit your resume and a short cover letter, and answer the following:

1. What experience do you have managing and optimizing Shopify and Wix websites?

        -Include specific results (conversion rate, revenue growth, performance improvements)

2. How do you use data and analytics to turn insights into actionable strategies for marketing, content, and social media teams?

3. Describe a specific example where you helped turn website or campaign traffic into sales.

    - What actions did you take and what were the results?

4. What AI tools or automations have you used for websites, marketing, or customer support?

    - How would you apply them to improve Pet N Pet’s conversion performance?

5. How do you collaborate with content, social media, and sales teams to ensure alignment on data, goals, and execution?
